editor_note: No semantic drift or misleading content: the build steps, linker-path instructions, the Python-not-used-at-runtime caveat, and the warnings note are all rendered faithfully, and the informal singular register (يمكنك، لاحظ، اطلع، سير عملك) holds throughout with no formal-plural slips. The defects are editorial. (1) "observable" is left as bare Latin script inside the Arabic sentence in line 12 (المثال التالي يبني observable باستخدام C) with no Arabic rendering or transliteration — the only untranslated domain noun in the prose, and it sits awkwardly in an RTL sentence. (2) "header" is rendered as bare رأس (رأس C، ورأس qiskit.h، أنشئ الرأس) rather than the conventional ملف الترويسة / الترويسة; it is consistent but reads as a calque, and in line 140 (سيكتب هذا الرأس المتوافق مع MSVC في dist\c\include) the undiacritized رأس makes the sentence momentarily parse as "this header will write". (3) C "function declarations" becomes تعريفات الدوال (definitions) instead of تصريحات/إعلانات الدوال — in a C-API guide the declaration/definition distinction is real. (4) A stray closing parenthesis ends the footnote in line 69 (لم يفت الأوان.) with no opening one. (5) Minor added qualifier in line 58: "verifies that everything has been installed" becomes من تثبيت كل شيء بشكل صحيح ("correctly installed").

examples.source: The following example builds an observable with C:
examples.suggested: يبني المثال التالي مؤثرًا قابلًا للرصد (observable) باستخدام C:
examples.translation: المثال التالي يبني observable باستخدام C:
examples.why: The only domain term left as raw English inside Arabic prose; a native technical writer would give the Arabic term with the English in parentheses, or at minimum transliterate, rather than drop a Latin-script noun into an RTL sentence.

examples.source: a tool to create the C header / the `qiskit.h` header with all function declarations
examples.suggested: أداة لإنشاء ملف ترويسة C / وملف الترويسة `qiskit.h` الذي يضم جميع تصريحات الدوال
examples.translation: أداة لإنشاء رأس C / ورأس `qiskit.h` مع جميع تعريفات الدوال
examples.why: رأس alone is a calque of "header"; the conventional Arabic is ملف الترويسة. Separately, تعريفات renders "definitions", but a C header carries declarations (تصريحات) — the distinction matters in a C-API guide.

examples.source: This will write the MSVC-compatible header in ``dist\c\include``.
examples.suggested: سيكتب هذا الأمرُ ملفَّ الترويسة المتوافق مع MSVC في ``dist\c\include``.
examples.translation: سيكتب هذا الرأس المتوافق مع MSVC في ``dist\c\include``.
examples.why: Without an explicit subject the sentence first parses as "this MSVC-compatible header will write"; the parallel sentence two lines earlier does name its subject (سيولّد هذا الأمر), so the file is inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: This code verifies that everything has been installed:
examples.suggested: يتحقق هذا الكود من تثبيت كل شيء:
examples.translation: يتحقق هذا الكود من تثبيت كل شيء بشكل صحيح:
examples.why: بشكل صحيح ("correctly") is added; the version commands check presence, not correctness. Not misleading, but an unsourced qualifier.

editor_note: Prose is generally fluent and the informal register holds throughout (يمكنك، دوائرك، تأكد), but three renderings state something the English does not. (1) "Twirled Readout Error eXtinction (TREX)" becomes «إطفاء أخطاء القراءة بالتشابك» — "twirled" is rendered as *entanglement*, and التشابك is used for genuine entanglement elsewhere in this same file (line 56, «تحضير التشابك بعيد المدى»), so the learner is told TREX works by entanglement; the file itself leaves "Pauli-twirling" untranslated a few paragraphs later, so the concept is also split. (2) "Classical feedforward and control flow" becomes «التغذية الراجعة الكلاسيكية وتدفق التحكم» — feed*forward* rendered with the term for feed*back*, i.e. the opposite direction of classical information flow. (3) "capacity consumption" in the rep_delay note becomes «استهلاك الطاقة», which reads as *energy/power* consumption rather than consumption of the plan's allotted QPU capacity — a false claim about what rep_delay costs the user. Supporting non-fatal issues: "Our inventory is getting a makeover" → «قاموسنا يتجدد» ("our dictionary"); qubit split between Latin "Qubit/Qubits" (lines 169, 176, 199, 344) and «الكيوبت/الكيوبتات» (lines 107, 156, 401); backend split between «الخوادم الخلفية» and «الـ Backends»; observables as «المراقبات»; "circuit variants" as «متغيرات الدوائر» (reads as *variables*); "the analytics page has been moved" softened to «تمت إضافة».

examples.source: Twirled Readout Error eXtinction (TREX)
examples.suggested: إطفاء أخطاء القراءة بالتلفيف العشوائي (Twirling) (TREX)
examples.translation: إطفاء أخطاء القراءة بالتشابك (TREX)
examples.why: «بالتشابك» means "by entanglement", a different quantum concept that this same file uses for genuine entanglement (تحضير التشابك بعيد المدى). The learner forms the false belief that TREX is an entanglement-based technique. The file leaves Pauli-twirling in English elsewhere, so the concept is also inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: See Classical feedforward and control flow ... for more information
examples.suggested: التغذية الأمامية الكلاسيكية وتدفق التحكم
examples.translation: اطّلع على [التغذية الراجعة الكلاسيكية وتدفق التحكم]
examples.why: Feedforward is rendered with the Arabic term for feedback — the opposite direction of classical information flow. Teaching material naming a control-flow mechanism must not invert its direction.

examples.source: it will have a direct impact on your execution time and capacity consumption
examples.suggested: فسيؤثر ذلك مباشرةً على وقت التنفيذ واستهلاك السعة المخصّصة (حصتك من وقت QPU)
examples.translation: فسيؤثر ذلك مباشرةً على وقت التنفيذ واستهلاك الطاقة
examples.why: Bare «استهلاك الطاقة» reads as energy/power consumption in a computing context. The English is about consuming the plan's allocated capacity/quota, so the Arabic makes a claim the source does not — and hides the real cost of raising rep_delay.

examples.source: Our inventory is getting a makeover, and we will be retiring the following QPUs
examples.suggested: أسطولنا يتجدد، وسنوقف وحدات QPU التالية
examples.translation: قاموسنا يتجدد، وسنوقف وحدات QPU التالية
examples.why: «قاموسنا» means "our dictionary" — inventory mistaken for lexicon. The sentence becomes a non sequitur before a list of retiring QPUs; «أسطولنا/مخزوننا» is what is meant (the file already uses «أسطولنا» for the fleet).

examples.source: 120-qubit device ... 57 of 176 possible two-qubit gates / multi-qubit Pauli measurement
examples.suggested: Pick one convention — «كيوبت/كيوبتات» — and use it everywhere
examples.translation: جهاز بـ120 Qubit ... 57 بوابة ثنائية الكيوبت من أصل 176 ... قياس Pauli متعدد الكيوبتات ... عبر Qubits متعددة
examples.why: Qubit alternates between untranslated Latin "Qubit/Qubits" and Arabic «الكيوبت/الكيوبتات», sometimes within one sentence («قياس Pauli متعدد الكيوبتات ... عبر Qubits متعددة»). The same split affects backend («الخوادم الخلفية» vs «الـ Backends»). Recognizable, but a native technical editor would unify it.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads — the technical content (tensor/expand ordering, `A.compose(B)` = $B.A$, the `front=True` reversal, unitarity not being preserved by linear combinations, process fidelity's CP caveat) is all rendered correctly. The problem is glossary leakage: common nouns "circuit", "gate", "backend" are left in English, capitalized, and mostly undeclined inside Czech sentences — "výpočet výsledné unitární matice kvantového Circuit", "Pokud Circuit obsahuje", "volat Backend simulátoru", "nebo Gate, která nemá definici matice ani rozklad pomocí Gates", "složení dvouqubitového Gate", and headings "Použití Operators v Circuits" / "Kombinování Operators" / "Porovnání Operators". This produces two real grammatical errors — "který je přidán do obvod" (l.124) and "vložit do obvod samotného" (l.141), both needing genitive "obvodu" — plus a within-file split where "circuit" is sometimes "Circuit" and sometimes "obvod", and "Gate" is treated as feminine in one sentence ("Gate, která nemá") and masculine in another ("dvouqubitového Gate"). A native editor would decline everything to "obvod/obvodu/obvodech", "hradlo", "backend" and keep English only for the actual class names `Operator`, `QuantumCircuit`, `Pauli`.

examples.source: you can use the `Operator` class as a unitary simulator to compute the final unitary matrix for a quantum circuit, without having to call a simulator backend. If the circuit contains any unsupported operations… or a gate that does not have a matrix definition or decomposition in terms of gate with matrix definitions.
examples.suggested: …pro výpočet výsledné unitární matice kvantového obvodu, aniž bys musel volat simulátorový backend. Pokud obvod obsahuje nepodporované operace… nebo hradlo, které nemá definici matice ani rozklad na hradla s definicí matice.
examples.translation: třídu `Operator` lze použít jako unitární simulátor pro výpočet výsledné unitární matice kvantového Circuit, aniž bys musel/a volat Backend simulátoru. Pokud Circuit obsahuje nepodporované operace… nebo Gate, která nemá definici matice ani rozklad pomocí Gates s definicemi matic.
examples.why: 'circuit', 'backend' and 'gate' are ordinary nouns, not API identifiers; left in English and undeclined they break Czech agreement ('kvantového Circuit', 'Gate, která'). 'Backend simulátoru' also flips the modifier — it reads 'the simulator's backend' rather than 'a simulator backend'.

examples.source: This converts the `Operator` into a `UnitaryGate` object, which is added to the circuit. / the `Pauli` object may also be directly inserted into the circuit itself
examples.suggested: …který je přidán do obvodu. / …lze také přímo vložit přímo do samotného obvodu
examples.translation: Tím se `Operator` převede na objekt `UnitaryGate`, který je přidán do obvod. / objekt `Pauli` lze také přímo vložit do obvod samotného
examples.why: Outright case error: the preposition 'do' requires the genitive 'obvodu'. 'do obvod samotného' is additionally word-ordered like English ('the circuit itself'); Czech puts the intensifier before the noun.

examples.source: Convert classes to Operators / Use Operators in circuits / Combine Operators / Compare Operators
examples.suggested: Převod tříd na operátory / Použití operátorů v obvodech / Kombinování operátorů / Porovnávání operátorů
examples.translation: Převod tříd na Operators / Použití Operators v Circuits / Kombinování Operators / Porovnání Operators
examples.why: English plurals frozen into Czech headings where the body text already uses the declined Czech 'operátory / subsystémy / obvod'. 'v Circuits' in particular is not Czech at all, and the file elsewhere proves the translator knows 'obvod'.

examples.source: while `tensor`, `expand`, and `compose` preserves the unitarity of unitary operators, linear combinations do not
examples.suggested: …lineární kombinace ji nezachovávají
examples.translation: zatímco `tensor`, `expand` a `compose` zachovávají unitaritu unitárních operátorů, lineární kombinace to nezaručují
examples.why: 'nezaručují' (do not guarantee) softens a flat statement into a probabilistic one. The following clause repairs the meaning, so it does not mislead, but the parallelism with 'zachovávají' is lost.

examples.source: For a high-level overview of operator representations in Qiskit
examples.suggested: Obecný přehled reprezentací operátorů v Qiskitu najdeš v…
examples.translation: Pro přehled reprezentací operátorů v Qiskitu na vysoké úrovni
examples.why: Calqued word order: 'na vysoké úrovni' lands at the end of the clause where it can be read as modifying 'v Qiskitu' rather than 'přehled'. Czech puts the qualifier on the noun ('rámcový/obecný přehled').

examples.source: The code on this page was developed using the following requirements. / without having to call
examples.suggested: Kód na této stránce vznikl s následujícími verzemi balíčků. / aniž bys musel volat
examples.translation: Kód na této stránce byl vyvinut s použitím následujících požadavků. / aniž bys musel/a volat
examples.why: 's použitím následujících požadavků' is a literal calque — Czech docs say 'verze balíčků', which is what the accordion title already says. The slashed gendered form 'musel/a' is a form-field convention, not something a Czech technical writer puts in running prose.

editor_note: The body prose is accurate and the informal "ty" register holds throughout ("Chceš-li", "Pokud restartuješ", "Všimni si"), but the core domain term is handled badly: "circuit" is left as the bare English "Circuit", capitalized and completely undeclined, in every body sentence — "k uložení svého Circuit", "jednoduchý kvantový Circuit", "seznam Circuit", "Tento Circuit je nyní uložen". Czech has the established, universally used term "kvantový obvod", and the undeclined English noun reads as broken Czech (a genitive/accusative is required after "svého"/"seznam"); worse, the very last clause of the same sentence switches to the correct word — "i když jsi serializoval pouze jeden obvod" — so the file splits the same concept between "Circuit" and "obvod". Separately, the frontmatter is stale: title and description still translate the older upstream wording ("Ukládání a načítání objektů Qiskit", "na disk nebo do cloudu"), whereas current EN reads "Save circuits to disk" / "Store Qiskit objects to disk" — the surviving "nebo do cloudu" promises cloud storage this page never covers. Neither defect teaches a false quantum concept, so this stays MINOR.

examples.source: Use QPY serialization to save your circuit to file. … the following cell creates a simple quantum circuit. … You can also save a list of circuits.
examples.suggested: … k uložení svého obvodu do souboru. … jednoduchý kvantový obvod. … uložit seznam obvodů.
examples.translation: Použij [serializaci QPY] k uložení svého Circuit do souboru. … vytvoří následující buňka jednoduchý kvantový Circuit. … Můžeš také uložit seznam Circuit.
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English, capitalized and undeclined, where Czech has the standard domain term "kvantový obvod". After "svého" and "seznam" Czech requires genitive ("obvodu", "obvodů"); the frozen English noun makes the sentences ungrammatical and reads as untranslated placeholder text, not as prose a Czech quantum engineer wrote.

examples.source: Note that this always returns a list of circuits, even if you only serialized one circuit.
examples.suggested: Všimni si, že tato funkce vždy vrací seznam obvodů, i když jsi serializoval pouze jeden obvod.
examples.translation: Všimni si, že tato funkce vždy vrací seznam Circuit, i když jsi serializoval pouze jeden obvod.
examples.why: Within one sentence the same term appears twice, rendered two different ways: "seznam Circuit" and "jeden obvod". The concept stays identifiable, but the split is exactly the inconsistency a native editor would unify — and it shows "obvod" was the translator's own instinct everywhere the English-word convention slipped.

examples.source: description: "Store Qiskit objects to disk so you can continue where you left off"
examples.suggested: description: "Ukládej objekty Qiskit na disk, abys mohl pokračovat tam, kde jsi skončil"
examples.translation: description: "Ukládej objekty Qiskit na disk nebo do cloudu, abys mohl pokračovat tam, kde jsi skončil"
examples.why: "nebo do cloudu" (or to the cloud) is not in the current English and the page covers only local QPY files on disk — it is a leftover from the pre-9f2948310 upstream wording "on disk or in the cloud". The same staleness affects the title: "Ukládání a načítání objektů Qiskit" translates the retired "Save and retrieve Qiskit objects", not the current "Save circuits to disk".

examples.source: If you restart your Python kernel, you can re-load the circuit using the qpy.load function.
examples.suggested: Pokud restartuješ Python kernel, můžeš obvod znovu načíst pomocí funkce `qpy.load`.
examples.translation: Pokud restartuješ svůj Python kernel, můžeš Circuit znovu načíst pomocí funkce `qpy.load`.
examples.why: The possessive "svůj" is a calque of English "your"; Czech drops the possessive here, and keeping it is the classic tell of machine-translated technical prose. Grammatical and non-misleading, but a native technical writer would delete it.

editor_note: Content is faithful and the informal "du" register holds throughout ("wenn du einen Anbieter verwendest", "Scrolle nach rechts"); domain terms are correct and consistent (Qubits, Gate, Backend, Schaltkreise, Kantenliste, Auslesefehler/Ausleselänge, Transpilationsbeschränkungen). Nothing misleads, but a native technical editor would fix four things. The comparative in "kann es daher notwendig sein, tiefer zu schauen als nur der äquivalente Zugriff mit BackendV2" is grammatically broken (nominative dangling after "als nur"; needs e.g. "als nur den äquivalenten BackendV2-Zugriff zu nutzen"). "The only point of mismatch between interfaces" is flattened to "Der einzige Unterschied zwischen den Schnittstellen", which claims the interfaces are otherwise identical rather than that CouplingMap is the only non-direct correspondence ("Abweichung"/"Nichtübereinstimmung" is meant). Plus two grammatical-gender slips around the central Target/QPU concepts: "eine Darstellung des QPU" (should be "der QPU") and "aus dem Target konstruiert wurde, der ... zugänglich ist" (should be "das"), inconsistent with "Das Target kann jedoch ..." two lines later; and "will be removed from service" is calqued as "wird aus dem Dienst entfernt", which in German reads as removal from some service rather than from the library.

examples.source: So depending on your use case, it might be necessary to look deeper than just the equivalent access with BackendV2.
examples.suggested: Je nach Anwendungsfall kann es daher notwendig sein, über den äquivalenten BackendV2-Zugriff hinauszuschauen.
examples.translation: Je nach Anwendungsfall kann es daher notwendig sein, tiefer zu schauen als nur der äquivalente Zugriff mit BackendV2.
examples.why: The comparative clause is ungrammatical: "als nur der äquivalente Zugriff" leaves a bare nominative with no verb, a classic word-for-word carry-over of the English "than just the equivalent access". A German technical writer would recast it.

examples.source: The only point of mismatch between interfaces is in the CouplingMap.
examples.suggested: Die einzige Abweichung zwischen den Schnittstellen betrifft die CouplingMap.
examples.translation: Der einzige Unterschied zwischen den Schnittstellen liegt in der CouplingMap.
examples.why: "point of mismatch" means the only place where the two interfaces do not map directly onto each other; "Unterschied" states the interfaces differ in nothing else, which the following table (backend_version semantics, basis_gates -> operation_names) contradicts. Qualifier flattened, not inverted.

examples.source: a representation of the QPU ... constructed from the Target accessible in the BackendV2.target attribute
examples.suggested: eine Darstellung der QPU ... die aus dem Target konstruiert wurde, das über das Attribut BackendV2.target zugänglich ist
examples.translation: eine Darstellung des QPU ... die aus dem Target konstruiert wurde, der über das Attribut BackendV2.target zugänglich ist
examples.why: Grammatical gender is wrong on both central objects: QPU is feminine (die QPU / der QPU), and Target is treated as neuter elsewhere in the same paragraph ("Das Target kann jedoch Anweisungen enthalten") but masculine here. Inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: has been deprecated and will be removed from service
examples.suggested: wurde als veraltet markiert und wird künftig entfallen
examples.translation: wurde als veraltet markiert und wird aus dem Dienst entfernt
examples.why: "aus dem Dienst entfernt" is a calque that suggests removal from some running service; the English means the class will be dropped from the library. Recognizable but not what a German technical writer would put.

editor_note: The file is short on prose (5 sentences plus a Next-steps list) and is overwhelmingly sound: informal "du" holds throughout (Erzeuge, Nutze, Verwende, Führe … aus, Erkunde, Übe, Lies), and domain terms are correct and consistent (Circuit, Sampler, Job, QPU, transpilieren, Primitive, Quasi-Wahrscheinlichkeitsverteilungen). Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The lede adds a word the English does not have: "aus den Ausgaben von Quantum-Circuit-Messungen gesampelt" for "sampled from quantum circuit outputs" — "Messungen" is inserted, narrowing "circuit outputs" to "circuit measurements"; harmless in substance here but an unnecessary addition ("aus den Ausgaben von Quantum-Circuits"). (2) "counts" is rendered as "Zählungen" in both intro sentences ("als Bitstrings oder Zählungen"); German Qiskit material normally keeps "Counts" (or uses "Häufigkeiten") — "Zählungen" reads as census/tally rather than the per-bitstring occurrence counts, an imperfect but still recognizable term. Nothing here misleads a learner.

examples.source: Generate entire error-mitigated quasi-probability distributions sampled from quantum circuit outputs.
examples.suggested: … die aus den Ausgaben von Quantum-Circuits gesampelt werden.
examples.translation: Erzeuge vollständige fehlergemilderte Quasi-Wahrscheinlichkeitsverteilungen, die aus den Ausgaben von Quantum-Circuit-Messungen gesampelt werden.
examples.why: "Messungen" is added; the English says "quantum circuit outputs", not "outputs of quantum circuit measurements". A small unsourced narrowing of the noun.

examples.source: …return the measurement outcome as bitstrings or counts of a single circuit.
examples.suggested: …als Bitstrings oder Counts zurückzugeben.
examples.translation: …um das Messergebnis eines einzelnen Circuits als Bitstrings oder Zählungen zurückzugeben.
examples.why: "Zählungen" reads as tallies/censuses; the Qiskit result field is `counts`, normally kept in English (or "Häufigkeiten") in German quantum-computing prose. Recognizable but not the conventional term. Used consistently in both occurrences.

editor_note: The prose is faithful, natural and pedagogically equivalent to the English throughout — no semantic drift: the quantities ("seis puertas ECR", "como máximo tres puertas ECR", "solo dos puertas ECR", "127 qubits ... los qubits activos, que son dos"), the caveats ("aumentar el nivel de optimización no siempre marca la diferencia", "pero es un circuito aproximado") and the conditional ("si establecemos `approximation_degree` a un valor menor que 1") all survive intact, and the informal tú register holds consistently (puedes, Repite, Ten en cuenta, Prueba, consulta). The one thing a native technical editor would change is the transpiler-pass term in the optimization-level-3 table row: "Unitarity-breaking passes" is rendered "Pasadas que rompen la unitariedad", whereas the established Spanish convention in this same corpus is "pases" (ai-transpiler-passes.mdx: "pases de transpilador", DAG-representation.mdx: "pases del transpilador", build-noise-models.mdx: "pase del transpilador"). "Pasadas" is understandable and not misleading, just off-convention. Minor style notes not worth flagging as defects: "un unitario aleatorio" (calqued but current usage) and "mayor profundidad de búsqueda y pruebas de la función de optimización", which mirrors the English's own terse phrasing.

examples.source: - Unitarity-breaking passes:
examples.suggested: - Pases que rompen la unitariedad:
examples.translation: - Pasadas que rompen la unitariedad:
examples.why: Transpiler "pass" is rendered "pase" everywhere else in the es corpus ("pases de transpilador", "pase del transpilador"); "pasada" is understandable but breaks the established convention.

editor_note: The technical content is faithful — broadcasting/extrinsic-vs-intrinsic ("المحاور الجوهرية/الخارجية"), all shape tables, and the shots note (1024 × 10 = 10,240) are all correct, and the informal register (اعتدت، حذفت، وسِّع) holds throughout with no antum slips. But several word-level choices need an editor. "randomized" in "Each execution is still randomized by the samplex" is rendered "مُعشوشَبًا" — a real Arabic word meaning "grassy/verdant", nonsense here; the correct form is "يخضع للعشوائية / مُعشوَأ". "Observables" is rendered "المراقِبات" (= observers/monitors) instead of the conventional "المؤثرات القابلة للرصد / الكميات المرصودة", inverting the active/passive sense of a real QM distinction. "shots" is rendered "تشغيلات" (= runs/executions), which collides with "تنفيذ" used for circuit execution in the same file, blunting exactly the shots-vs-configurations point the admonition makes. Also: "circuit" is split between English "Circuit" (lines 15, 21, 78, 90, 143) and Arabic "الدائرة" (165, 174); two gender-agreement slips ("تحددها نوع البيانات"، "تحدده نوع المخرج" — نوع is masculine, should be يحددها/يحدده) plus "يُشير بقية هذا الدليل" (should be تُشير); and both bullets under "كيف يتفاعل shape" drop the qualifier "input" ("الأشكال" instead of "أشكال المدخلات"), which makes the input-vs-shape contrast ambiguous right before the note that says shape itself can have size-1 dimensions.

examples.source: Each execution is still randomized by the samplex, but with only a single random realization you don't benefit from averaging over multiple randomizations.
examples.suggested: لا يزال كل تنفيذ يخضع للعشوائية بواسطة الـ samplex، لكن مع تحقيق عشوائي واحد فقط لن تستفيد من المتوسط عبر عشوائيات متعددة.
examples.translation: لا يزال كل تنفيذ مُعشوشَبًا بواسطة الـ samplex، لكن مع تحقق عشوائي واحد فقط لن تستفيد من المتوسط عبر عشوائيات متعددة.
examples.why: ‘مُعشوشَب’ is a real word meaning ‘grassy/covered with grass’ — it has no connection to randomization and reads as a garbled coinage. The meaning is only recoverable from the following clause. Also ‘تحقق عشوائي’ for ‘random realization’ is a calque (تحقق = verification); ‘تحقيق عشوائي’ or ‘عيّنة عشوائية’ is the domain reading.

examples.source: | Observables (if applicable) | varies | Depends on observable type |
examples.suggested: | المؤثرات القابلة للرصد (إن وُجدت) | يتفاوت | يعتمد على نوع المؤثر القابل للرصد |
examples.translation: | المراقِبات (إن وُجدت) | يتفاوت | يعتمد على نوع المراقِب |
examples.why: ‘مراقِب’ is the active participle — ‘observer/monitor’, the person or device doing the watching — not ‘observable’, the measurable quantity. Observer vs observable is a live distinction in quantum mechanics, so the active form points the learner at the wrong concept.

examples.source: Each configuration runs the full shot count specified in the quantum program. Shots are not divided among configurations. For example, if you request 1024 shots and have 10 configurations, each configuration runs 1024 shots (10,240 total shots executed).
examples.suggested: كل تهيئة تنفِّذ عدد اللقطات (shots) الكامل المحدد في البرنامج الكمي. اللقطات لا تُوزَّع بين التهيئات. … كل تهيئة تُجري 1024 لقطة (ما مجموعه 10,240 لقطة).
examples.translation: كل تهيئة تشغِّل عدد التشغيلات الكامل المحدد في البرنامج الكمي. التشغيلات لا تُوزَّع بين التهيئات. على سبيل المثال، إذا طلبت 1024 تشغيلًا وكان لديك 10 تهيئات، كل تهيئة تشغِّل 1024 تشغيلًا (ما مجموعه 10,240 تشغيلًا).
examples.why: ‘shots’ is rendered ‘تشغيلات’ (runs/executions), the same family of words the file already uses for circuit execution (‘تنفيذ مستقل للدائرة’). The whole point of this note is that shots are per-configuration and configurations are separate executions; collapsing both onto ‘تشغيل’ makes ‘كل تهيئة تشغِّل 1024 تشغيلًا’ read as circular. Keep ‘لقطة/shots’ distinct.

examples.source:
- Input shapes with size-1 dimensions can expand to match `shape`.
- Input shapes must align from the right with `shape`.
examples.suggested:
- أشكال المدخلات ذات الأبعاد بحجم 1 يمكن أن تتوسع لتتطابق مع `shape`.
- يجب أن تتوافق أشكال المدخلات من اليمين مع `shape`.
examples.translation:
- الأشكال ذات أبعاد الحجم 1 يمكن أن تتوسع لتتطابق مع `shape`.
- يجب أن تتوافق الأشكال من اليمين مع `shape`.
examples.why: Both bullets drop the qualifier ‘Input’, leaving bare ‘الأشكال’ where the entire section is about the contrast between the input extrinsic shapes and the `shape` argument. The note two lines later says `shape` itself may hold size-1 dimensions that expand to the input dimensions — so an unqualified ‘الأشكال’ in bullet 1 leaves the learner unsure which side expands.

examples.source: Determined by the data type. / Determined by the output type. / The rest of this guide refers back to this example…
examples.suggested: يحددها نوع البيانات. / يحدده نوع المخرج. / تُشير بقية هذا الدليل إلى هذا المثال…
examples.translation: تحددها نوع البيانات. / تحدده نوع المخرج. / يُشير بقية هذا الدليل إلى هذا المثال…
examples.why: Gender-agreement slips a native technical writer would not make: نوع is masculine so the verb must be يحدد not تحدد, and بقية is feminine so it takes تُشير not يُشير. Grammatical noise only, no meaning lost, but it marks the prose as unedited.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout (negations, quantities and the 00/11 vs 01/10 contrasts all survive intact) and the informal "ty" register holds without a single Vy/Vám slip, so nothing here misleads a learner — but a native editor would change several things. The biggest is an untranslated English glossary leak: "circuit" is rendered "obvod" in most places yet left as capitalized "Circuit" seven times ("simulovat kvantový Circuit", "co Circuit dělá", "Tento Circuit nás seznamuje", "spustíme Circuit na simulátoru", "dvouqubitový Circuit"), and "backend" appears once as "instrukční sadě Backendu" — the concept stays identifiable, but the file contradicts itself. Two term choices are imprecise at teaching moments: "equal superposition" becomes "do stejné superpozice" (reads as "the same superposition — same as what?" instead of "rovnoměrné superpozice"), and "entangles the two states" is softened to the neutral "propojí dva stavy dohromady", dropping "provázat" exactly where CX's role is being introduced. Finally there are real non-native slips: the clitic order "kdy qubit přestává se chovat" (should be "kdy se qubit přestává chovat"), the ungrammatical opener "Nyní, co jsme si prošli, jak vytvořit..." (should be "Nyní, když jsme si prošli..."), and the coin analogy calqued as "500 hlav a 500 orlů" instead of the Czech idiom "panna, nebo orel".

examples.source: AerSimulator, allows us to simulate the quantum circuit on a classical computer. / This circuit introduces us to a few key features
examples.suggested: ...simulovat kvantový obvod na klasickém počítači. / Tento obvod nás seznamuje...
examples.translation: `AerSimulator` nám umožňuje simulovat kvantový Circuit na klasickém počítači. / Tento Circuit nás seznamuje s několika klíčovými vlastnostmi
examples.why: Untranslated English glossary leak. The file uses the correct Czech "obvod" in most places ("kvantových obvodech", "obvodu Bellova stavu", "Pomocná funkce pro spouštění obvodů") but leaves capitalized "Circuit" in seven sentences; the same leak hits "instrukční sadě Backendu" (line 153). Within-file inconsistency, not a comprehension blocker.

examples.source: we use an $H$ (Hadamard) gate to put the first qubit into an equal superposition
examples.suggested: ...k uvedení prvního qubitu do rovnoměrné superpozice (superpozice s rovnými amplitudami)
examples.translation: použijeme $H$ (Hadamardovo) hradlo k uvedení prvního qubitu do stejné superpozice
examples.why: "equal superposition" means equal-weight amplitudes; "stejná superpozice" in Czech reads as "the same superposition" and invites the question "same as what?". The qualifier is lost at the exact point where the Bell-state recipe is defined.

examples.source: Then we apply a $CX$ (controlled-NOT) gate, which entangles the two states together.
examples.suggested: Poté aplikujeme hradlo $CX$ (řízené NOT), které oba stavy vzájemně provázá.
examples.translation: Poté aplikujeme $CX$ (kontrolované-NOT) hradlo, které propojí dva stavy dohromady.
examples.why: "entangles" is softened to the neutral "propojí" (connects/links), dropping the key term "provázat" precisely where the reader is told what CX does. The surrounding sentences still say "provázaný stav", so the concept is recoverable — a weakening, not a false statement.

examples.source: Because measurement is the moment a qubit stops behaving like a quantum state
examples.suggested: Protože **měření** je okamžik, kdy se qubit přestává chovat jako kvantový stav
examples.translation: Protože **měření** je okamžik, kdy qubit přestává se chovat jako kvantový stav
examples.why: Wrong clitic placement — the reflexive "se" must sit in second position of the clause. A native writer would never produce "qubit přestává se chovat"; it is an immediate MT tell.

examples.source: even if there is an exact 50-50 chance of the coin landing on heads or tails, that doesn't mean you'll always get exactly 500 instances of heads and 500 of tails
examples.suggested: ...že padne panna, nebo orel, neznamená to, že vždy padne přesně 500× panna a 500× orel
examples.translation: i když je přesně 50% šance, že mince padne na hlavu nebo orel, neznamená to, že vždy dostaneš přesně 500 hlav a 500 orlů
examples.why: Calque of "heads": the Czech coin idiom is "panna, nebo orel", never "hlava". "500 hlav a 500 orlů" breaks the analogy's colloquial ring in the one paragraph that is meant to be everyday intuition.

examples.source: Now that we've walked through how to create the $\Phi^+$ Bell state, see if you can edit the code
examples.suggested: Nyní, když jsme si prošli, jak vytvořit Bellův stav $\Phi^+$, zkus upravit kód
examples.translation: Nyní, co jsme si prošli, jak vytvořit Bellův stav $\Phi^+$, zkus upravit kód
examples.why: "Now that" is rendered with "co" instead of "když", producing an ungrammatical clause. Meaning survives, but it is a visible grammar defect in the closing call to action.

editor_note: Overall a fluent, well-structured German rendering (Fehlerminderung/Fehlerunterdrückung are kept correctly and consistently apart; "logische Qubits", "fehlertolerante Quantenberechnung (FTQC)", "quantenzentriertes Supercomputing (QCSC)" are all right), but a native technical editor would change several things. The definitional criterion ii) renders "quantum separation" as "Quantenüberlegenheit" — importing the loaded, distinct field term *quantum supremacy* into the very passage whose job is to define *quantum advantage* precisely; "Quantenseparation"/"Quantentrennung" is what is meant. "not expected to be viable in the immediate near term" becomes "im unmittelbaren Nahbereich noch nicht realisierbar", where "Nahbereich" is a spatial word and a plain calque of "near term" (correct: "in unmittelbarer Zukunft"/"kurzfristig"), and the hedge "is not expected to" hardens into a flat statement of fact. Smaller items: the modal in "can outperform classical alone" is dropped ("übertrifft"), a case error ("um Rechenproblemen zu bewältigen" for "Rechenprobleme"), the malformed compound "im heterogenen Quantenklassischen Computing", English possessive apostrophes ("Algorithmiq's", "Qedma's") that German does not use, and "circuit" rendered as English "Quantum Circuits" in the opening recap but "Quantenschaltkreise/Schaltkreise" everywhere after. No du/Sie problem: the whole page is in the "wir" voice, so the informal convention is not at risk.

examples.source: It is performed with a quantum separation that demonstrably offers superior efficiency, cost-effectiveness, or accuracy than what is attainable with classical computation alone.
examples.suggested: Die Aufgabe wird mit einer Quantenseparation ausgeführt, die nachweislich eine höhere Effizienz, Kosteneffektivität oder Genauigkeit bietet, als mit klassischer Berechnung allein erreichbar wäre.
examples.translation: Die Aufgabe wird mit einer Quantenüberlegenheit ausgeführt, die nachweislich eine höhere Effizienz, Kosteneffektivität oder Genauigkeit bietet, als mit klassischer Berechnung allein erreichbar wäre.
examples.why: "Quantum separation" is a complexity-theoretic separation, not "Überlegenheit". "Quantenüberlegenheit" is the established German rendering of *quantum supremacy* — a different, contested term — and it appears inside the one paragraph that exists to pin down the definition of quantum advantage, exactly where the page is trying to keep utility / advantage / supremacy apart.

examples.source: the implementation of full fault-tolerance is not expected to be viable in the immediate near term
examples.suggested: ist mit der Implementierung vollständiger Fehlertoleranz in unmittelbarer Zukunft noch nicht zu rechnen
examples.translation: ist die Implementierung vollständiger Fehlertoleranz im unmittelbaren Nahbereich noch nicht realisierbar
examples.why: "Nahbereich" is a spatial term (close range) and a raw calque of "near term"; no German technical writer would use it for a time horizon. The hedge "is not expected to be viable" also hardens into a categorical "ist noch nicht realisierbar".

examples.source: this heterogeneous architecture—where "quantum plus classical" can outperform classical alone—is the most powerful path forward
examples.suggested: diese heterogene Architektur – bei der „Quanten plus Klassik" die rein klassische Berechnung übertreffen kann – der wirkungsvollste Weg nach vorn ist
examples.translation: diese heterogene Architektur – bei der „Quanten plus Klassik" die rein klassische Berechnung übertrifft – der wirkungsvollste Weg nach vorn ist
examples.why: The modal "can" is dropped, turning a statement of potential into an assertion of present fact — on a page whose whole argument is that this outperformance still has to be demonstrated by end of 2026.

examples.source: working alongside CPUs and GPUs to tackle computational problems that are intractable for classical computers
examples.suggested: die Seite an Seite mit CPUs und GPUs arbeiten, um Rechenprobleme zu bewältigen, die für klassische Computer praktisch nicht lösbar sind
examples.translation: die Seite an Seite mit CPUs und GPUs arbeiten, um Rechenproblemen zu bewältigen, die für klassische Computer unlösbar sind
examples.why: "um Rechenproblemen zu bewältigen" is a case error (bewältigen takes the accusative), and "unlösbar" overstates "intractable", which means practically infeasible rather than unsolvable in principle.

examples.source: quantum circuits … parallelize quantum circuits … low-latency quantum-circuit execution
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering — "Quantenschaltkreise" throughout — and use it in the opening recap too.
examples.translation: „Quantum Circuits" (opening recap) vs. „Quantenschaltkreisen" / „Quantenschaltkreisen mit geringer Latenz" later
examples.why: The same core term is left in English once and translated everywhere else within a single short page; the recap paragraph is precisely where a learner maps the course vocabulary.

editor_note: Mathematically faithful throughout — no semantic drift, no inverted conditions, correct core terminology (Purifikation, Spektralzerlegung, Schmidt-Zerlegung/Schmidt-Koeffizienten, Dichtematrix, reduzierter Zustand, vollständig gemischter Zustand, bindend/verbergend for binding/concealing, consistent du-register: "Betrachte zunächst", "Beachte jedoch"). What a native technical editor would change is a layer of visible translationese: the anglicism "Kollektion" for EN "collection" (lines ~223, 232, 532) where German math writes "Familie"/"Sammlung"/"Menge" — and the file already uses "Menge" for the very same objects two lines away; the calques "ist eine einfache Angelegenheit der Berechnung der partiellen Spur" (~69), "was eine andere Weise ist zu sagen" (~40), "scheitert das betrachtete hypothetische Protokoll vollständig, bindend zu sein" (~456), "In anschaulichen, operativen Begriffen" (~424) and "Bedingt auf das Messergebnis" (~472, ~490); "übergeordnete Zusammenfassung" for "high-level summary" (~429), where "übergeordnet" carries the wrong sense (superordinate, not coarse-grained). Two small slips: "der von Alice festgelegte Bit" (~422) should be "das Bit", and "in welchem Bell-Zustand er sich befindet" (~397) makes Bob rather than the qubit pair the thing in a Bell state. Also "über das gespurt werden kann" (~492) is an ad-hoc verb, while the same operation is rendered idiomatically as "wenn über Y die Spur gezogen wird" in the opening definition (~16).

examples.source: the uniquely determined collection {|z_0>,...,|z_{n-1}>} … a collection of positive semidefinite matrices
examples.suggested: die eindeutig bestimmte Familie … eine Familie (bzw. Sammlung) positiv semidefiniter Matrizen
examples.translation: die eindeutig bestimmte Kollektion {|z_0>,...} … eine Kollektion positiv semidefiniter Matrizen
examples.why: "Kollektion" is an anglicism — in German it reads as a fashion/product collection, never as a mathematical family of vectors or matrices. The file itself uses "Menge" for the same kind of object in adjacent sentences, so the rendering is also inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: Bob performs a measurement on the pair (A,B) to see which Bell state he holds.
examples.suggested: …um herauszufinden, welchen Bell-Zustand er hält (bzw.: in welchem Bell-Zustand sich das Paar befindet).
examples.translation: der dann eine Messung auf dem Paar (A,B) durchführt, um herauszufinden, in welchem Bell-Zustand er sich befindet.
examples.why: "das Paar" is neuter, so the masculine "er sich befindet" attaches to Bob — the sentence literally says Bob is in a Bell state rather than the qubit pair he holds. Not conceptually misleading enough to fail, but a native writer would never leave the antecedent this way.

examples.source: Verifying that this is indeed a purification of ρ is a simple matter of computing the partial trace…
examples.suggested: Dass es sich tatsächlich um eine Purifikation von ρ handelt, lässt sich einfach durch Berechnung der partiellen Spur überprüfen…
examples.translation: Zu überprüfen, dass es sich tatsächlich um eine Purifikation von ρ handelt, ist eine einfache Angelegenheit der Berechnung der partiellen Spur…
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of "a simple matter of computing"; the noun-chain "Angelegenheit der Berechnung der partiellen Spur" stacks three genitives and reads as machine output, not as German technical prose.

examples.source: …and so the hypothetical protocol being considered completely fails to be binding.
examples.suggested: …und damit ist das betrachtete hypothetische Protokoll überhaupt nicht bindend.
examples.translation: …und so scheitert das betrachtete hypothetische Protokoll vollständig, bindend zu sein.
examples.why: "scheitern, etwas zu sein" is not a German construction — it is English "fails to be X" transplanted whole. The conclusion of the whole bit-commitment argument lands on the stiffest sentence in the file, which weakens the punchline pedagogically.

examples.source: Here is a high-level summary of an argument that establishes this.
examples.suggested: Hier eine grobe Zusammenfassung eines Arguments, das dies zeigt.
examples.translation: Hier ist eine übergeordnete Zusammenfassung eines Arguments, das dies zeigt.
examples.why: "übergeordnet" means superordinate/higher-ranking in a hierarchy, not "coarse-grained/without full detail" — the wrong sense of "high-level" was selected, so the reader is told the summary outranks something rather than that it omits detail.

examples.source: …as a single, compound system that can be traced out to leave X…
examples.suggested: …als ein einziges zusammengesetztes System, über das die Spur gebildet werden kann, um X zu erhalten…
examples.translation: …als ein einziges zusammengesetztes System, über das gespurt werden kann, um X zu erhalten…
examples.why: "spuren" is not a German verb for taking a partial trace; the opening definition of the same file renders the identical operation correctly as "wenn über Y die Spur gezogen wird", so this is both non-idiomatic and inconsistent with the file's own earlier phrasing.

editor_note: No semantic drift: the physics (Trotter error vs. decoherence trade-off, ZNE/PEA description, Pauli-exclusion caveat, "2.880 puertas") is faithful, terminology for the core domain terms is correct and conventional (qubit, puertas, valores esperados, estado producto, gestor de pases, evolución temporal, Modelo de Ising de Campo Transversal), and the informal "tú" register holds throughout ("Mira este video", "Ten en cuenta", "Consulta la sección", "tómate un momento"). What a native editor would fix is a keep-English glossary leak: "circuit" is rendered "circuito" in most of the file but appears as capitalized English "Circuit"/"Circuits" in ~11 places, including the section headings "__5. Optimización del Circuit__", "__6. Ejecución del Circuit__" and "__Circuit trotterizado__", plus English-pluralized "para Circuits cuánticos", "requiere Circuits cuánticos más profundos", "la ejecución de Circuits cuánticos". The same leak hits "Backend" ("la elección del Backend del dispositivo", "puertas nativas del hardware del Backend") and "Transpiler" ("pases del Transpiler" instead of "pases del transpilador"), and the course/series title is left half-translated as "Quantum Computing en la Práctica" in two places. None of this misleads a learner — "Circuit" is transparently the English word next to "circuito" — but it is jarring, inconsistent, and ungrammatical as Spanish morphology.

examples.source: 5. Circuit optimization / 6. Circuit execution / Trotterized circuit
examples.suggested: __5. Optimización del circuito__ / __6. Ejecución del circuito__ / __Circuito trotterizado__
examples.translation: __5. Optimización del Circuit__ / __6. Ejecución del Circuit__ / __Circuit trotterizado__
examples.why: Untranslated English "Circuit" leaks into three sub-headings while the body text of those very sections uses "circuito" ("el paso de mapeo está completo y podemos proceder a la optimización del circuito"). Same term, two renderings, inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: can produce accurate expectation values for quantum circuits that lie beyond the reach of brute-force classical simulation methods, which attempt exact simulation of the same circuits
examples.suggested: …para circuitos cuánticos que están fuera del alcance de los métodos de simulación clásica por fuerza bruta, que intentan simular exactamente esos mismos circuitos
examples.translation: puede producir valores esperados precisos para Circuits cuánticos que están fuera del alcance de los métodos de simulación clásica por fuerza bruta, que intentan simular exactamente los mismos Circuits
examples.why: "Circuits" carries an English plural -s attached to what is being used as a Spanish noun; no Spanish technical writer would write "Circuits cuánticos". Recurs at lines 230, 265, 288.

examples.source: a sequence of steps known as transpiler passes / the pass manager produces an ISA circuit—a circuit expressed in terms of the backend's Instruction Set Architecture
examples.suggested: …conocidos como pases del transpilador … produce un circuito ISA —un circuito expresado en términos de la Arquitectura del Conjunto de Instrucciones (ISA) del backend
examples.translation: una secuencia de pasos conocidos como pases del Transpiler … produce un circuito ISA —un Circuit expresado en términos de la Arquitectura del Conjunto de Instrucciones (ISA) del Backend
examples.why: "Transpiler" and "Backend" are capitalized as if proper nouns, and "circuito ISA" and "un Circuit" sit in the same sentence — the split makes one clause read as machine output rather than authored Spanish.

examples.source: our Quantum Computing in Practice, episode 5 - Mapping / Since this series is titled Quantum Computing in Practice
examples.suggested: Either keep the title fully in English ("Quantum Computing in Practice") or translate it fully ("Computación cuántica en la práctica")
examples.translation: nuestro [Quantum Computing en la Práctica, episodio 5 - Mapeo] / Dado que esta serie se titula Quantum Computing en la Práctica
examples.why: Half-translated proper title mixes languages mid-name; a native editor would commit to one form, and the same choice should be used in both places.

editor_note: The concept-defining opening sentence mistranslates "norm-preserving": "تغييرًا يحافظ على القاعدة" uses القاعدة, which in Arabic linear algebra means *basis* (and colloquially "rule"), never the mathematical *norm* (المعيار / النظيم). A learner is thus told that a unitary operation "preserves the basis" — a false statement (unitaries are precisely basis-changing maps) — and loses the actual intuition that unitarity preserves vector length/probability, which is the whole point of the page's first paragraph. Secondary, non-misleading issues: "unitary" and "single-qubit" are both rendered أحادية, so "بوابات qubit الأحادية والثنائية" (line 66) can be misread as "unitary qubit gates"; "to find one" is calqued as "للعثور على واحد" (line 39); and `QuantumCircuit.decompose()` is called an أسلوب (a style/manner) rather than طريقة/دالة, with "visualize" flattened to "تمثيل" (line 88). Informal register (تعرف، تريد، اطّلع، زُر) holds correctly throughout.

examples.source: A unitary operation describes a norm-preserving change to a quantum system.
examples.suggested: العملية الأحادية (Unitary) تصف تغييرًا يحافظ على المعيار (norm) في نظام كمي.
examples.translation: العملية الأحادية (Unitary) تصف تغييرًا يحافظ على القاعدة في نظام كمي.
examples.why: القاعدة is the standard Arabic word for *basis* (or a rule), not the mathematical *norm*. As written, the defining sentence of the page asserts that a unitary preserves the basis — the opposite of what unitaries do — so the learner forms a false belief about the core concept instead of learning that unitarity preserves length/probability.

examples.source: a long series of single- and two-qubit gates … uses three two-qubit gates
examples.suggested: سلسلة طويلة من البوابات أحادية الكيوبت وثنائية الكيوبت … ثلاث بوابات ثنائية الكيوبت
examples.translation: سلسلة طويلة من بوابات qubit الأحادية والثنائية … تستخدم الدائرة التالية ثلاث بوابات ثنائية qubit
examples.why: أحادية is already carrying 'unitary' everywhere else in this file (العمليات الأحادية، المصفوفات الأحادية), so 'بوابات qubit الأحادية' is ambiguous between 'single-qubit gates' and 'unitary gates'; the arrangement of the noun phrase is also non-idiomatic.

examples.source: If no decomposition is available, the Qiskit SDK provides you with the tools to find one.
examples.suggested: إذا لم يتوفر أي تحليل، فإن Qiskit SDK يوفر لك الأدوات اللازمة لإيجاد واحد منها.
examples.translation: إذا لم يتوفر أي تحليل، يوفر لك Qiskit SDK الأدوات اللازمة للعثور على واحد.
examples.why: 'للعثور على واحد' is a word-for-word calque of English 'to find one'; Arabic does not use a bare عدد pronoun this way, and a native technical writer would repeat or resume the noun.

examples.source: (Here we use the QuantumCircuit.decompose() method to better visualize the gates used to re-synthesize the unitary.)
examples.suggested: (نستخدم هنا الدالة `QuantumCircuit.decompose()` لعرض البوابات المستخدمة في إعادة تركيب المصفوفة الأحادية بوضوح أكبر.)
examples.translation: (نستخدم هنا أسلوب `QuantumCircuit.decompose()` لتمثيل أوضح للبوابات المستخدمة في إعادة تركيب المصفوفة الأحادية.)
examples.why: أسلوب means 'style/manner', not a class *method* (طريقة/دالة/تابع), and 'تمثيل' (representation) flattens 'visualize', which here is about drawing the circuit for inspection.

examples.source: Synthesizing specific unitary operations into a set of quantum gates is a fundamental task…
examples.suggested: إن تركيب عمليات أحادية محددة إلى مجموعة من البوابات الكمية مهمةٌ أساسية تُستخدم…
examples.translation: تركيب عمليات أحادية محددة في مجموعة من بوابات الكم مهمةٌ أساسية تُستخدم…
examples.why: 'في مجموعة' calques English 'into a set' (Arabic needs إلى for the target of decomposition/synthesis), and the verbless nominal sentence without إن reads stiffly; بوابات الكم here also diverges from البوابات الكمية / بوابة CX used elsewhere.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the depolarizing-channel explanation, the $(1-p)^m$ reasoning, the "conservative estimate" caveat about the initial state, and the noise-model caveats are all rendered accurately, and the informal register (ستحصل عليها، كما ترى، يمكنك، أنشئ) holds with no formal slips. Nothing misleads, but a native technical editor would change four things: (1) "observable" is rendered as المؤثر ("operator") in both places it appears (lines 57, 86) rather than the conventional المؤثر القابل للقياس / الكمية المرصودة — recognizable in context but imperfect; (2) "two-qubit gates" becomes بوابات الـ Qubitين, an Arabic dual suffix bolted onto a Latin-script word, which no Arabic technical writer would produce (natural: البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت); (3) the opening sentence has a subject-verb agreement mismatch — يوضح [المحاكاة الدقيقة...] where the linked title is feminine (توضح, or insert يوضح مقال); (4) "sample from the noisy circuit" becomes الأخذ بالعينات, the wrong preposition idiom for sampling (standard: أخذ العينات من / أخذ عينات من). Also cosmetic: "depolarizing" is left in English with inconsistent casing (خطأ Depolarizing on line 113 vs خطأ depolarizing / قناة depolarizing on lines 84 and 119).

examples.source: compute the exact expectation value of the observable $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.suggested: لحساب القيمة المتوقعة الدقيقة للمؤثر القابل للقياس $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.translation: لحساب القيمة المتوقعة الدقيقة للمؤثر $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.why: المؤثر alone is 'operator'; 'observable' is the narrower concept (a Hermitian operator whose expectation value you measure). Consistently used, so recognizable in context, but it flattens the distinction the guide is teaching between the circuit's operators and the measured observable.

examples.source: the error arising from the two-qubit gates, which are CX gates here, are the dominant source of error
examples.suggested: الأخطاء الناشئة عن البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت، وهي بوابات CX هنا، هي المصدر المهيمن للخطأ
examples.translation: الأخطاء الناشئة عن بوابات الـ Qubitين، وهي بوابات CX هنا، هي المصدر الرئيسي للخطأ
examples.why: Qubitين attaches the Arabic dual ending to a Latin-script token — a calque no native technical writer would write. The standard construction is البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت (or ثنائية الـ Qubit if the file's keep-English convention is preserved).

examples.source: [Exact simulation with Qiskit primitives](...) demonstrates how to use the reference primitives
examples.suggested: يوضح مقال [المحاكاة الدقيقة باستخدام Qiskit primitives](...) كيفية استخدام الـ primitives المرجعية
examples.translation: يوضح [المحاكاة الدقيقة باستخدام Qiskit primitives](...) كيفية استخدام الـ primitives المرجعية
examples.why: The verb يوضح is masculine but its surface subject المحاكاة is feminine; the sentence needs either توضح or an explicit masculine head noun such as مقال/دليل. Grammatical mismatch in the very first line of body prose.

examples.source: how to use the Sampler primitive from Qiskit Aer to sample from the noisy circuit
examples.suggested: كيفية استخدام الـ Sampler primitive من Qiskit Aer لأخذ عينات من الدائرة ذات الضوضاء
examples.translation: كيفية استخدام الـ Sampler primitive من Qiskit Aer للأخذ بالعينات من الدائرة ذات الضوضاء
examples.why: الأخذ بالعينات uses the wrong preposition — أخذ بـ reads as 'to adopt/act upon', not 'to sample from'. The established Arabic collocation for statistical sampling is أخذ العينات من.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, informal imperatives ("Vytvoř", "Najdi", "Přidej", "Rozděl", "Vygeneruj") hold — but the file leaves "circuit" and "backend" untranslated AND undeclined inside Czech case constructions, which reads as raw glossary leakage rather than as a deliberate keep-English convention: "Diagram kvantového Circuit" (×5, needs "kvantového obvodu"), "na podcircuit"/"na podcircuity", "na Backend" (needs locative "na backendu"). "Qubit" is capitalized mid-sentence ("4 Qubitech", "ancilla Qubity") where Czech writes it lowercase. There is one outright grammatical error, "řezáním těchto hradlo a drátů" (genitive plural is "hradel"), and "cut" is rendered inconsistently within one heading — "řezu drátu" but then "přestřižením jednoho CRZGate", where the file's own term "řezem" was available. None of this misleads a learner; all of it is what a Czech technical editor would fix.

examples.source: Quantum circuit diagram
examples.suggested: Diagram kvantového obvodu
examples.translation: Diagram kvantového Circuit
examples.why: The English noun is kept but not declined, so the Czech genitive adjective 'kvantového' governs an invariant foreign word — ungrammatical and jarring. It also conflicts with the rest of the file, which happily translates 'wire'→'drát' and 'cut'→'řez'. Either keep 'circuit' consistently in a code-font/nominative slot or use the standard Czech 'obvod'.

examples.source: 4 qubits per subcircuit … partition the circuit and observables into subcircuits and subobservables
examples.suggested: 4 qubitech na podobvod … na podobvody a podobservably
examples.translation: 4 Qubitech na podcircuit … na podcircuity a podobservably
examples.why: 'podcircuit' is a Czech-English hybrid compound no native writer produces; 'podobvod' is the established rendering. 'Qubit' is also capitalized mid-sentence throughout ('4 Qubitech', 'ancilla Qubity'), whereas Czech usage is lowercase 'qubit'.

examples.source: Calculate the sampling overhead incurred from cutting these gates and wires.
examples.suggested: Vypočítej vzorkovací režii vzniklou řezáním těchto hradel a drátů.
examples.translation: Vypočítej vzorkovací režii vzniklou řezáním těchto hradlo a drátů.
examples.why: Genuine grammatical error: after 'těchto … a drátů' the noun must be genitive plural 'hradel', not the nominative singular 'hradlo'. Meaning survives, but it reads as unproofed machine output.

examples.source: by making a single wire cut and cutting one CRZGate
examples.suggested: pomocí jednoho řezu drátu a řezem jednoho `CRZGate`
examples.translation: pomocí jednoho řezu drátu a přestřižením jednoho `CRZGate`
examples.why: Within one sentence 'cut' is rendered twice differently — the technical 'řez' and then the colloquial 'přestřižení' (snipping through). The file's whole subject is 'řezání obvodů', so the term should stay 'řez' to keep 'wire cut'/'gate cut' visibly the same operation as the output block's 'Wire Cut'/'Gate Cut'.

examples.source: Steps 3 and 4 of a Qiskit pattern can then be performed as in the preceding tutorials.
examples.suggested: Kroky 3 a 4 [vzoru Qiskit] lze poté provést stejně jako v předchozích tutoriálech.
examples.translation: Kroky 3 a 4 [Qiskit vzoru] lze poté provést stejně jako v předchozích tutoriálech.
examples.why: 'Qiskit vzoru' copies English noun-noun premodification; Czech puts the invariant brand name after the head noun ('vzoru Qiskit'). Grammatical but audibly calqued.

editor_note: No semantic inversions or false claims — the physics is faithful and the informal "ty" register holds throughout (Uvažuj, chceš-li, ujisti se, můžeš). The real defect is a band of untranslated, undeclined English glossary leaks concentrated in Part I Steps 1–3, which produces ungrammatical Czech: "Nastavení Trotterových Circuit", "kvantové Circuit v Trotterově přiblížení", "optimalizované AQC Circuit", "Vybereme Backend", "odstraníme odlehlé qubit", "chybu dvouQubitové Gate", "fáze rozmístění Transpiler", "podmnožinu qubit", "1D řetězec 10 qubit", "jednoho gate XX+YY", "na páru Qubitů" — a native writer would decline these as obvod/obvodů, hradlo, qubity/qubitů, backend, transpiler. This leaves four core terms split within the file: circuit → obvod (Part I prose) / Circuit (leak) / okruh (Part II); observable → observabl(u)/observabilů / Observable / pozorovatelná / pozorovatelná veličina; product formula → undeclined "product formula" and even "Suzuki–Trotterovy formulas vyššího řádu" / "Trotterovy formulas" versus "produktový vzorec" in Part II; expectation value → střední hodnota (Part I) versus očekávaná hodnota (Part II). Smaller stiffness: the calque "Poznamenej, že" for "Note that" (twice), "kterou by člověk získal", "erratické chování", and "největší přínos" where the English means the largest *contribution* of an error term ("největší příspěvek").

examples.source: #### Set up the Trotter circuits … all that is left to do is to generate the Trotterized quantum circuits.
examples.suggested: #### Nastavení Trotterových obvodů … zbývá pouze vygenerovat trotterizované kvantové obvody.
examples.translation: #### Nastavení Trotterových Circuit … zbývá pouze vygenerovat kvantové Circuit v Trotterově přiblížení.
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English and undeclined, so the Czech noun phrase is grammatically broken in both the heading and the sentence; the file elsewhere correctly uses "obvod".

examples.source: we remove outlier qubits from the coupling map to ensure that the layout stage of the transpiler doesn't include them … qubits that either have measurement error or a two-qubit gate above a certain threshold
examples.suggested: odstraníme odlehlé qubity z mapy propojení, aby je fáze rozmístění v transpileru nezahrnula … odstraňujeme qubity, které mají buď chybu měření, nebo chybu dvouqubitového hradla nad určitou hranicí
examples.translation: odstraníme odlehlé qubit z mapy propojení, abychom zajistili, že fáze rozmístění Transpiler je nezahrne … odstraňujeme qubit, které mají buď chybu měření nebo chybu dvouQubitové Gate nad určitou hranicí
examples.why: Three undeclined leaks in one paragraph plus the mid-word capital "dvouQubitové Gate"; "odlehlé qubit" and "qubit, které mají" are ungrammatical (adjective/relative clause in plural against an undeclined singular-looking noun).

examples.source: All the terms in μ(t) use the same product formula S_χ(t) as its base. / a higher-order Suzuki–Trotter formula / the product formula with higher number of Trotter steps
examples.suggested: Pick one convention: keep "product formula (PF)" as an invariant English term used with a Czech head noun ("stejný vzorec product formula"), or translate consistently as "produktový vzorec"; and "Suzuki–Trotterovu formuli vyššího řádu".
examples.translation: Všechny členy v $\mu(t)$ používají stejnou product formula … / Suzuki–Trotterovy formulas vyššího řádu … / produktový vzorec s vyšším počtem Trotterových kroků
examples.why: "product formula" is undeclined in Part I, the English plural "formulas" is wedged into a Czech genitive ("Suzuki–Trotterovy formulas vyššího řádu", "Trotterovy formulas"), while Part II switches to "produktový vzorec" — the same core object under three renderings.

examples.source: observable / The observable that we will be measuring / observables with lower error
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout, e.g. "pozorovatelná (veličina)" (or consistently "observable" as an invariant), and decline it: "Pozorovatelná, kterou budeme měřit, je magnetizace na dvojici qubitů…"
examples.translation: nižší Trotterovy chyby u observablu … / Observable, který budeme měřit, je magnetizace na páru Qubitů … / produkuje pozorovatelné s nižší chybou … / Jako pozorovatelnou veličinu zvolíme
examples.why: The central measured quantity appears as observabl/observabilů, capitalized English "Observable", pozorovatelné and pozorovatelná veličina within one tutorial; "na páru Qubitů" also carries a stray capital.

examples.source: Note that in generating the circuits … / the Trotter error that one would obtain / starts to behave erratically
examples.suggested: Všimni si, že při generování obvodů … / kterou bychom získali pouhým použitím největší hodnoty $k_j$ / se začíná chovat nepravidelně (nevyzpytatelně)
examples.translation: Poznamenej, že při generování obvodů … / kterou by člověk získal pouhým použitím největší hodnoty $k_j$ / začíná vykazovat erratické chování
examples.why: "Poznamenej, že" is a literal imperative calque of "Note that" no Czech technical writer would use, "by člověk získal" calques the English impersonal "one", and "erratické" is an unnaturalized borrowing where Czech has "nepravidelně/nevyzpytatelně".

examples.source: To cancel the Trotter error for the first l−1 terms (these will give the largest contributions as they correspond to the lower number of Trotter steps)
examples.suggested: (ty budou mít největší příspěvek, protože odpovídají nižšímu počtu Trotterových kroků)
examples.translation: (ty budou mít největší přínos, protože odpovídají nižšímu počtu Trotterových kroků)
examples.why: "přínos" reads as a positive benefit; the English means these error terms contribute the most to the error, so the pedagogical point (why they are the ones worth cancelling) is slightly blurred.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift: the budget logic ("stoppen soll, wenn die Anzahl der qubit-weise kommutierenden Pauli-Gruppen im Operator 8 überschreitet"), the "6 der 8 zugeteilten Pauli-Gruppen" reasoning, and the truncation bound "(5e-3 Fehler/Scheibe) * (10 Scheiben) = 5e-2" all match the English, and du-register holds consistently (implementierst du, Beachte, Denke daran, findest du). What a native editor would still change: a real grammar slip in "die rückpropagieren Experimente ausführen" (missing adjective ending — must be "rückpropagierten"); the object-less calque "Um auf dem Backend auszuführen, für das die Experimente in Schritt 2 transpiliert wurden" (German needs "Um die Experimente auf dem Backend auszuführen …"); "einen zustandsvektorbasierten ``Estimator``-Primitiven", an awkward masculine weak declension where German Qiskit texts say "ein zustandsvektorbasiertes Estimator-Primitive"; and "Qiskit beschreibt Schichten im weiteren Sinne als Tiefe-1-Partitionen" for "loosely describes", where "im weiteren Sinne" ("in a broader sense") shifts the hedge — "grob/salopp" is what is meant. Terminology is otherwise correct and consistent (Qubit, Gates, Observable, Erwartungswert, transpilieren, Backend, Hamiltonian, slices→Scheiben/Schaltkreisscheiben, ansatze→Ansätze).

examples.source: Finally, we can run the backpropagated experiments and compare them with the full experiment
examples.suggested: Schließlich können wir die rückpropagierten Experimente ausführen …
examples.translation: Schließlich können wir die rückpropagieren Experimente ausführen und sie mit dem vollständigen Experiment … vergleichen
examples.why: Missing participle ending: "rückpropagieren" is a verb form, not an attributive adjective — a native writer would never leave "die rückpropagieren Experimente". Reads as an un-proofread MT artifact, though the meaning is still recoverable.

examples.source: To run on the backend to which the experiments were transpiled in Step 2, one would import the EstimatorV2 …
examples.suggested: Um die Experimente auf dem Backend auszuführen, für das sie in Schritt 2 transpiliert wurden, würde man den EstimatorV2 … importieren
examples.translation: Um auf dem Backend auszuführen, für das die Experimente in Schritt 2 transpiliert wurden, würde man den EstimatorV2 … importieren
examples.why: English "to run on the backend" allows the intransitive use; German "ausführen" requires an object. The object-less clause is a direct syntactic calque and reads distinctly non-native.

examples.source: We use a statevector-based ``Estimator`` primitive to illustrate the effect of truncation
examples.suggested: Wir verwenden ein zustandsvektorbasiertes ``Estimator``-Primitive, um …
examples.translation: Wir verwenden einen zustandsvektorbasierten ``Estimator``-Primitiven, um den Effekt des Abschneidens … zu veranschaulichen
examples.why: "Primitive" in the Qiskit sense is normally neuter in German usage (das Primitive / die Primitives); the masculine weak-declension "einen … Primitiven" evokes the unrelated noun "der Primitive" and jars for a German quantum engineer. Recognizable, so not misleading.

examples.source: Qiskit loosely describes layers as being depth-1 partitions of the circuit across all qubits.
examples.suggested: Qiskit bezeichnet mit Schichten grob gesagt Tiefe-1-Partitionen des Schaltkreises über alle Qubits.
examples.translation: Qiskit beschreibt Schichten im weiteren Sinne als Tiefe-1-Partitionen des Schaltkreises über alle Qubits.
examples.why: "loosely" here hedges the precision of the definition; "im weiteren Sinne" instead says "in a broader sense", implying a wider scope than the depth-1 definition. The hedge lands on the wrong axis, weakening the setup for the following slices-vs-layers contrast.

editor_note: Faithful overall — numbers (56 Qubits, vier Zeitschritte, 30 Tage, 1. November 2022), the QUBO objective list, and the `multiple_passmanager`/false caveat all survive intact, and the informal "du" convention holds throughout with no Sie-slips. Four editorial defects: (1) "objective cost" is split within one paragraph — "die Lösung mit den niedrigsten **Gesamtkosten**" (= total cost, wrong) followed immediately by the correct "den minimalen **Zielkosten**"; (2) the Qiskit primitive `Estimator` is over-translated to "Quantenschätzer" while its sibling `Sampler` is left in English in the same sentence ("die Quantenschätzer- und Sampler-Konfigurationen"), so the class name is no longer greppable; (3) the false friend "dates" → "Daten" in "alle Vermögenswerte auf denselben **Daten** ausgerichtet sind", which in German reads "aligned on the same *data*", not the same trading dates; (4) a relative-pronoun agreement slip in the Optimized Real Amplitudes sentence attaches "der speziell … entwickelt wurde" to "des Standard-Real-Amplitudes-Ansatzes" instead of to the feminine "Adaption", misattributing the finance-specific tailoring to the *standard* ansatz. Also mildly calqued: "multi-objektives Problem" (native: mehrkriteriell) and "hybriden Quanten-Klassik-Methode".

examples.source: we extract and display the solution with the lowest objective cost from the optimization results. Along with the minimum objective cost, we also present key metrics
examples.suggested: die Lösung mit den niedrigsten Zielkosten … Zusammen mit den minimalen Zielkosten
examples.translation: extrahieren und zeigen wir die Lösung mit den niedrigsten Gesamtkosten aus den Optimierungsergebnissen. Zusammen mit den minimalen Zielkosten präsentieren wir auch wichtige Kennzahlen
examples.why: 'objective cost' is rendered two different ways one sentence apart; 'Gesamtkosten' means total cost, a different quantity from the QUBO objective value plotted on the x-axis as 'Objective cost'.

examples.source: the primitive settings, such as `estimator_shots`, `estimator_precision`, and `sampler_shots`, define the quantum Estimator and Sampler configurations
examples.suggested: … die Konfigurationen der Quanten-Primitive Estimator und Sampler … fest
examples.translation: legen die Primitive-Einstellungen wie `estimator_shots`, `estimator_precision` und `sampler_shots` die Quantenschätzer- und Sampler-Konfigurationen … fest
examples.why: Estimator/Sampler are Qiskit primitive class names the German-speaking field keeps in English; translating only Estimator to 'Quantenschätzer' while leaving Sampler untranslated is both an over-translation and an in-sentence inconsistency.

examples.source: Any missing data (non-trading days) is handled appropriately, ensuring all assets are aligned on the same dates.
examples.suggested: … sodass alle Vermögenswerte auf dieselben Handelstage / dasselbe Datumsraster ausgerichtet sind.
examples.translation: Fehlende Daten (handelsfreie Tage) werden angemessen behandelt, sodass alle Vermögenswerte auf denselben Daten ausgerichtet sind.
examples.why: Classic dates→Daten false friend: in German 'Daten' reads as 'data', so the sentence appears to say the assets are aligned on the same data, right after a sentence that is about data — the date-alignment point is lost.

examples.source: the Optimized Real Amplitudes ansatz, a customized and hardware-efficient adaptation of the standard Real Amplitudes ansatz, specifically tailored to improve performance for this type of financial optimization problem
examples.suggested: …, die speziell für eine bessere Performance bei dieser Art von finanziellen Optimierungsproblemen entwickelt wurde
examples.translation: eine angepasste und hardware-effiziente Adaption des Standard-Real-Amplitudes-Ansatzes, der speziell für eine bessere Performance bei dieser Art von finanziellen Optimierungsproblemen entwickelt wurde
examples.why: Masculine 'der' agrees with 'Ansatzes', not with the feminine 'Adaption', so the tailoring is attributed to the standard Real Amplitudes ansatz rather than to the customized variant the tutorial uses.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, default value, range ([1, 10800], 3 horas) and incompatibility list matches the English, and the informal "tú" register holds throughout ("Puedes usar", "Haz clic", "Revisa"). The defects are lexical. (1) The core term "circuit" is left in English everywhere and inflected as if it were Spanish — "Circuits dinámicos", "circuits dinámicos", "el circuit cuántico subsiguiente" — an ungrammatical hybrid where "circuito(s)" is the only Spanish rendering; the same leak hits "gates" ("plegado de gates", "gates fraccionales", "gates personalizados"), which sits inconsistently beside fully translated neighbours like "mediciones terminales" and "entrelazadores no Clifford". (2) "primitive" is rendered as the masculine adjective-noun "el primitivo Executor" / "inicialización del primitivo"; the established Spanish computing term is "la primitiva". (3) "Feature compatibility" becomes "Compatibilidad de prestaciones" and the body then hedges with a translator's gloss absent from the source, "Ciertas prestaciones (características) de runtime" — "funcionalidades"/"características" alone is the natural choice and the parenthesis should go.

examples.source: Dynamic circuits / can be applied to dynamic circuits
examples.suggested: Circuitos dinámicos / puede aplicarse a circuitos dinámicos
examples.translation: Circuits dinámicos / puede aplicarse a circuits dinámicos
examples.why: "circuit" is not a term the field keeps in English in Spanish prose; "circuits dinámicos" is an English plural carrying a Spanish adjective, which no native technical writer would produce. Recognizable, so not misleading, but it must be "circuito(s)".

examples.source: The delay between a measurement and the subsequent quantum circuit.
examples.suggested: El retraso entre una medición y el circuito cuántico posterior.
examples.translation: El retraso entre una medición y el circuit cuántico subsiguiente.
examples.why: Same leak inside a definition sentence, where "medición" is correctly translated one word earlier — the mixed policy is visible in a single clause.

examples.source: customize the Executor primitive / primitive initialization
examples.suggested: personalizar la primitiva Executor / inicialización de la primitiva
examples.translation: personalizar el primitivo Executor / inicialización del primitivo
examples.why: In Spanish computing usage a "primitive" is "una primitiva"; "el primitivo" reads as the adjective "primitive/primeval" and is a direct calque of the English noun. Consistent within the file, so MINOR.

examples.source: Feature compatibility / Certain runtime features cannot be used together in a single job.
examples.suggested: Compatibilidad de funcionalidades / Ciertas funcionalidades del runtime no pueden usarse juntas en un mismo trabajo.
examples.translation: Compatibilidad de prestaciones / Ciertas prestaciones (características) de runtime no pueden usarse juntas en un solo trabajo.
examples.why: "prestaciones" is an unusual rendering of "features" in software docs, and the parenthetical "(características)" is a translator's self-gloss with no counterpart in the English — it breaks the voice of teaching prose.

examples.source: fractional gates / custom gates
examples.suggested: compuertas fraccionales / compuertas personalizadas (or a documented keep-English convention applied consistently)
examples.translation: gates fraccionales / gates personalizados
examples.why: Keeping "gate twirling" as a fixed term of art is defensible, but bare "gates" as a countable noun beside translated "mediciones"/"entrelazadores" makes the file's keep-English policy look arbitrary rather than chosen.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift: the sparsity condition ("لا يتزايد حجمها أُسّيًا مع حجم المسألة"), the "~16 mH vs 1.6 mH chemical accuracy" caveat, the "samples were pure noise / signal comes from a priori knowledge" warning, and the every-4th-orbital cross-spin connectivity all survive intact, and the informal singular register holds ("اختر", "شغّل", "دارتك", "اللذين تختارهما"). What a native editor would change is terminology hygiene. "hardware" is rendered as "العتاد الحديدي" ("iron hardware") in five places (lines 125, 159, 167, 169, 202) while the correct bare "العتاد" is used alongside it in the very same sentences — both wrong-sounding and internally inconsistent. Two glossary tokens leak into the Arabic noun phrases as untranslated doublets: "دارة Circuit كمية" (lines 13, 53, 56, 110 — literally "circuit Circuit quantum", while plain "الدارة/دارتنا" is used elsewhere) and "البوابات Gates" (lines 169, 171). Smaller: "spin-balanced variant" → "المتغير متوازن السبين" ("المتغير" reads as *variable* in Arabic technical prose), and "electronic structure" → "بنية الإلكترونات" instead of the standard "البنية الإلكترونية".

examples.source: As our target IBM hardware has a heavy-hex topology … we will optimize our circuit for a target hardware … make it hardware-compatible
examples.suggested: نظرًا لأن العتاد المستهدف من IBM … سنُحسّن دارتنا للعتاد المستهدف … وجعله متوافقًا مع العتاد
examples.translation: نظرًا لأن العتاد الحديدي المستهدف من IBM يتبع طوبولوجيا السداسي الثقيل … سنُحسّن دارتنا لعتاد حديدي مستهدف … وجعله متوافقًا مع العتاد الحديدي
examples.why: ‘hardware’ is rendered ‘العتاد الحديدي’ (‘iron hardware/ferrous gear’), an odd calque no Arabic technical writer uses; the correct bare ‘العتاد’ appears in the same sentences (‘للعتاد المستهدف’, ‘متوافقة مع العتاد’, ‘العتاد المستهدف’), so the file is also inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: a 36-qubit quantum circuit ansatz … a quantum circuit prepares the state … (quantum circuit) … The LUCJ ansatz is a parameterized quantum circuit
examples.suggested: نموذج دارة كمية مؤلفة من 36 qubit … تُحضّر دارة كمية الحالة … (دارة كمية) … هو دارة كمية مُعاملَة
examples.translation: نموذج دارة Circuit كمية مؤلفة من 36 qubit … تُحضّر دارة Circuit كمية الحالة … (دارة Circuit كمية) … هو دارة Circuit كمية مُعاملَة
examples.why: The English glossary token ‘Circuit’ is spliced inside the Arabic noun phrase, producing ‘دارة Circuit كمية’ (‘circuit Circuit quantum’) four times, while unmarked ‘الدارة/دارتنا/دارتك’ is used everywhere else in the file. A glossary-leak artifact, not a deliberate keep-English convention.

examples.source: an efficient hardware-compatible circuit with fewer gates … decompose gates into orbital rotations … resulting in fewer gates in the final circuit
examples.suggested: … بعدد أقل من البوابات … تُفكّك البوابات إلى دورانات مدارية … عددًا أقل من البوابات
examples.translation: دارة فعّالة ومتوافقة مع العتاد بعدد أقل من البوابات Gates … تُفكّك البوابات Gates إلى دورانات مدارية … مما يُنتج عددًا أقل من البوابات Gates
examples.why: Same doublet pattern: the Arabic ‘البوابات’ already carries the term, so the appended English ‘Gates’ is a redundant leak that reads as a tooling artifact rather than a bilingual gloss.
