"pustaka Circuit Qiskit") against the correct Malay "litar" in the large-scale and challenge sections. The capitalized English form reads as a glossary leak, not a deliberate keep-English convention.

examples.source: small deviations in the exact values of $f$ coming from noise can be tolerated
examples.suggested: sisihan kecil dalam nilai tepat $f$ yang berpunca daripada hingar boleh ditoleransi
examples.translation: penyelewengan kecil dalam nilai tepat $f$ yang datang dari hingar boleh ditoleransi
examples.why: "Penyelewengan" in Malay primarily means misappropriation/misconduct; the statistical sense of "deviation" is "sisihan". Also note "noise" appears here as "hingar" but as "berderau" in the Background section — pick one.

examples.source: projects the Hamiltonian onto a subspace ... and diagonalizes it
examples.suggested: memunjurkan Hamiltonian ke atas subruang ... dan mempepenjurukannya
examples.translation: memproyeksikan Hamiltonian ke atas subruang ... dan menyelesaikannya secara pepenjuru
examples.why: "Menyelesaikan secara pepenjuru" literally says "solves it diagonally", which is not what diagonalization means; the verb form "mempepenjurukan" is the established rendering. "Memproyeksikan" is also an Indonesian-leaning form next to Malay "memunjurkan".

examples.source: you can expect to understand / ensure that you have the following installed / If you found this work interesting
examples.suggested: Standardise on "anda" throughout; e.g. "Selepas melengkapkan tutorial ini, anda akan memahami perkara berikut"
examples.translation: kamu boleh menjangka untuk memahami / pastikan anda telah memasang / Jika anda mendapati kerja ini menarik
examples.why: The file alternates between "anda" and "kamu" for the same reader, and "boleh menjangka untuk memahami" is a word-for-word calque of "can expect to understand" that a Malay technical writer would render as "anda akan memahami".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the shot-accounting caveat ("Tembakan **tidak** dibahagikan antara konfigurasi … jumlah 10,240 tembakan"), the broadcast table, and the `shape`-vs-input-shape rules all match the English exactly, and "paksi intrinsik/ekstrinsik", "hingar", "rawakan" are correct and consistent. What a native editor would change: (1) register breaks twice — the file uses "anda" everywhere except "Kamu boleh menggunakan parameter `shape`" and "Kamu boleh menyusun rawakan"; (2) "measurements" is rendered "ukuran" (= size/dimension) instead of "pengukuran", which is actively unhelpful in a guide whose whole subject is array *sizes* — "data rentetan bit daripada ukuran" momentarily reads as "bitstring data from the size"; (3) "circuit" is left as capitalised English "Circuit" throughout ("mencipta Circuit berparameter", "menjalankan Circuit asas") where Malay technical writing has the settled term "litar", and "gate" likewise stays English inside Malay syntax ("menerapkan gate rawak"); (4) two calques a Malay technical writer would not produce: the relative "Paksi di mana `shape` melebihi bentuk tersirat" and the bare-noun heading "Indeks ke dalam keputusan". None of these misleads a learner.

examples.source: You can use the `shape` parameter to augment the extrinsic shape for the item… / You can organize randomizations into a multi-dimensional grid.
examples.suggested: Anda boleh menggunakan parameter `shape` … / Anda boleh menyusun rawakan …
examples.translation: Kamu boleh menggunakan parameter `shape` untuk menambah bentuk ekstrinsik bagi item tersebut… / Kamu boleh menyusun rawakan ke dalam grid berbilang dimensi.
examples.why: The rest of the file (including the immediately preceding and following paragraphs) uses "anda"; these two "Kamu" occurrences are the only casual-register slips and break the file's own convention.

examples.source: The most common output is bitstring data from measurements… | Bitstring data from measurements
examples.suggested: Output yang paling biasa ialah data rentetan bit daripada pengukuran… | Data rentetan bit daripada pengukuran
examples.translation: Output yang paling biasa adalah data rentetan bit daripada ukuran… | Data rentetan bit daripada ukuran
examples.why: "ukuran" is size/dimension; the process noun for quantum measurement is "pengukuran". In a guide saturated with shapes and sizes (bentuk, dimensi, bersaiz-1), "daripada ukuran" invites a wrong parse — recognizable in context, so MINOR rather than FAIL.

examples.source: a parametric circuit / if your circuit has three parameters / an independent circuit execution / running the base circuit
examples.suggested: litar berparameter / jika litar anda mempunyai tiga parameter / pelaksanaan litar yang bebas / menjalankan litar asas
examples.translation: Circuit berparameter / jika Circuit anda mempunyai tiga parameter / pelaksanaan Circuit yang bebas / menjalankan Circuit asas
examples.why: "litar (kuantum)" is the established Malay term and the rest of the prose is fully translated, so the capitalised English "Circuit" mid-sentence reads as an untranslated leak rather than a deliberate keep-in-English decision; the same applies to "gate rawak" (better: "get rawak").

examples.source: Axes where `shape` exceeds the implicit shape enumerate additional independent randomizations. / ### Index into results
examples.suggested: Paksi yang nilainya dalam `shape` melebihi bentuk tersirat akan menyenaraikan rawakan bebas tambahan. / ### Mengindeks keputusan
examples.translation: Paksi di mana `shape` melebihi bentuk tersirat menyenaraikan rawakan bebas tambahan. / ### Indeks ke dalam keputusan
examples.why: "di mana" as an English-style relative pronoun is textbook translationese in Malay (it is locative, not relative), and "Indeks ke dalam …" calques the English verb "index into" using a Malay noun; a native technical writer would use "Mengindeks keputusan".

examples.source: the following code runs 20 randomizations for each of 10 parameter configurations
examples.suggested: kod berikut menjalankan 20 rawakan bagi setiap satu daripada 10 konfigurasi parameter
examples.translation: kod berikut menjalankan 20 rawakan untuk setiap 10 konfigurasi parameter
examples.why: "untuk setiap 10 konfigurasi" can be read as "for every batch of 10 configurations" rather than "for each of the 10"; the accompanying code comment (20 × 10) resolves it, so this is an avoidable ambiguity rather than drift.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped numbers, the RZZ constraint ($0 < \theta \leq \pi/2$), the two workflows, and the fidelity definition all survive intact, and the informal "ty" register holds ("Jeśli masz pewność", "Będziesz potrzebować", "twój obwód"). What a native editor would change is terminology hygiene. "Circuit" is left in English and capitalized mid-sentence in ~7 places ("Circuit kwantowego jądra", "Cztero-Qubitowy Circuit", "transpilujemy Circuit") while the rest of the file correctly says "obwód/obwody"; likewise "qubit" appears as capitalized "Qubitami/Qubitów" but as "jednokubitowych" in line 558, and "Backend" is left undeclined in Polish case slots ("z użyciem Backend", "dla Backend", line 309/502), which is ungrammatical. "Transpiler pass" is rendered "przepustka transpilatora" / "menedżer przepustek" (przepustka = an access permit, the wrong sense of "pass") in the Overview and Step 2, but as "pass Transpilera" in Troubleshooting — the same concept split three ways. Line 556 opens "Transponujemy obwód" (= we transpose) where the source says "We transpile" and every other paragraph says "transpilujemy". Smaller: "prymityw" is dropped from "do Sampler lub Estimator" (source: "to the Sampler or Estimator primitive"), line 237 is a calqued dangling participle ("Dostarczając Backend ..., przepustka ... jest automatycznie dołączana"), and the link label "package" in line 544 was left untranslated.

examples.source: #### Quantum kernel circuit ... The four-qubit circuit is visualized below. ... We then transpile the circuit using the pass manager
examples.suggested: obwód kwantowego jądra / Poniżej przedstawiono obwód czterokubitowy / transpilujemy obwód
examples.translation: #### Circuit kwantowego jądra ... Cztero-Qubitowy Circuit jest zwizualizowany poniżej. ... Następnie transpilujemy Circuit przy użyciu menedżera przepustek
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English and capitalized in ~7 places while the rest of the file uses "obwód"; the same split affects "Qubitami/Qubitów" vs "jednokubitowych". Recognizable, so not misleading, but inconsistent within one file.

examples.source: a specialized transpiler pass called FoldRzzAngle ... the specialized transpiler pass FoldRzzAngle is not invoked
examples.suggested: wyspecjalizowany pass (przebieg) transpilatora ... — one rendering used throughout; "menedżer przepustek" → "pass manager" / "menedżer przebiegów"
examples.translation: specjalistyczną przepustkę transpilatora o nazwie FoldRzzAngle ... wyspecjalizowany pass Transpilera FoldRzzAngle nie jest wywoływany
examples.why: "Przepustka" is the permit/access-badge sense of "pass", not the compiler sense, and the file also uses the correct "pass" later — the compiler-stage concept is split across two incompatible renderings.

examples.source: We transpile the circuit using only fractional RX gates, excluding RZZ gates.
examples.suggested: Transpilujemy obwód, używając wyłącznie ułamkowych bramek RX, z wykluczeniem bramek RZZ.
examples.translation: Transponujemy obwód używając wyłącznie ułamkowych bramek RX, wykluczając bramki RZZ.
examples.why: "Transponować" is "to transpose" (a matrix operation), not "to transpile"; every other paragraph correctly says "transpilujemy"/"transpilacja", so context rescues it, but the verb itself names the wrong operation.

examples.source: parameter values are typically passed to the Sampler or Estimator primitive as part of a PUB
examples.suggested: ... przekazywane do prymitywu Sampler lub Estimator jako część PUB
examples.translation: wartości parametrów są zazwyczaj przekazywane do Sampler lub Estimator jako część PUB
examples.why: The qualifier "primitive" is dropped, losing the link to "prymitywów Qiskit" used in the Step 3 heading; a learner no longer sees that Sampler/Estimator are the primitives.

examples.source: By providing a backend that supports fractional gates to generate_preset_pass_manager, a specialized pass called FoldRzzAngle is automatically included.
examples.suggested: Po podaniu Backendu obsługującego bramki ułamkowe do generate_preset_pass_manager automatycznie dołączany jest wyspecjalizowany pass FoldRzzAngle.
examples.translation: Dostarczając Backend obsługujący bramki ułamkowe do generate_preset_pass_manager, specjalistyczna przepustka o nazwie FoldRzzAngle jest automatycznie dołączana.
examples.why: Calqued English absolute construction: the Polish gerund "Dostarczając" has no shared subject with the passive main clause, which a Polish technical writer would never produce.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats; the Premium/Open Plan note, the $b_i = 0$ vanishing-linear-coefficients passage, and the COBYLA noise explanation are all rendered accurately, and the informal "ty" register holds ("użyjesz", "przeskalujesz", "możesz"). The defects are all glossary-leak / declension damage. First, "circuit" is split within the file: it is correctly "obwód" in some places ("Od klasycznej optymalizacji do obwodów kwantowych", "obwodu ansatz", "Schemat obwodu") but left as an untranslated, capitalized English "Circuit" in at least seven others — "kwantowe **Circuit** i operatory", "sparametryzowany Circuit QAOA", "abstrakcyjnego Circuit", "lepsze parametry dla Circuit", "optymalizacji Circuit". Second, and worse for readability, several English nouns are dropped in undeclined base form where Polish requires a case ending, producing ungrammatical phrases: "ze 127 lub większą liczbą qubit" and "ponad 100 qubit" (needs "kubitów"/"qubitów"), "mapowanie qubit", "zbyt mała liczba shots", "wybranego Backend sprzętowego", "Na podstawie optymalnego bitstring". Third, minor calques: "Post-przetwarzanie" / "Post-przetwórz" for post-process (native: "przetwarzanie końcowe" / "przetwórz końcowo") and "możesz dwukrotnie sprawdzić wyniki" for "double-check" (native: "zweryfikować"). None of this teaches a false concept, so it stays MINOR — but a native technical editor would fix every instance.

examples.source: the code selects a backend with 127 or more qubits and executes the circuit there
examples.suggested: kod wybiera backend z co najmniej 127 kubitami i tam wykonuje obwód
examples.translation: kod wybiera Backend ze 127 lub większą liczbą qubit i tam wykonuje Circuit
examples.why: "circuit" is rendered as "obwód" elsewhere in the same file ("obwodów kwantowych", "obwodu ansatz", "Schemat obwodu") but left as capitalized English "Circuit" here and in six other places — a within-file split. "Backend" is likewise capitalized mid-sentence as if it were a proper noun.

examples.source: 127 or more qubits / too few shots per evaluation / over 100 qubits / the selected hardware backend
examples.suggested: większą liczbą kubitów / liczba pomiarów (shotów) / ponad 100 kubitów / wybranego backendu sprzętowego
examples.translation: większą liczbą qubit / liczba shots / ponad 100 qubit / wybranego Backend sprzętowego
examples.why: English nouns are inserted in undeclined base form where Polish grammar requires genitive/locative endings. "liczbą qubit", "100 qubit" and "wybranego Backend" are outright ungrammatical, not merely stiff — a Polish technical writer would either decline the borrowing (kubitów / backendu / shotów) or use the native term.

examples.source: Post-process and return result in desired classical format / map, transpile, execute, post-process
examples.suggested: Przetwarzanie końcowe i zwrócenie wyniku w pożądanym formacie klasycznym / odwzoruj, dokonaj transpilacji, wykonaj, przetwórz końcowo
examples.translation: Post-przetwarzanie i zwrócenie wyniku w pożądanym formacie klasycznym / odwzoruj, dokonaj transpilacji, wykonaj, post-przetwórz
examples.why: "Post-przetwarzanie" and especially the invented verb "post-przetwórz" are direct calques of the English prefix; Polish uses "przetwarzanie końcowe" or "obróbka końcowa". The verb form in particular reads as machine-coined.

examples.source: so you can double-check the results by comparing the QAOA result against the exact answer
examples.suggested: więc możesz zweryfikować wyniki, porównując rezultat QAOA z dokładną odpowiedzią
examples.translation: więc możesz dwukrotnie sprawdzić wyniki, porównując rezultat QAOA z dokładną odpowiedzią
examples.why: "dwukrotnie sprawdzić" is a literal word-for-word rendering of "double-check" and reads as translationese — it says "check twice", not "verify". Meaning survives, but no native writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: This section walks through each step of the QAOA workflow
examples.suggested: Ta sekcja przeprowadza Cię przez każdy krok przepływu pracy QAOA
examples.translation: Ta sekcja przeprowadza przez każdy krok przepływu pracy QAOA
examples.why: The transitive verb "przeprowadzać" is left without its object; Polish needs "Cię" here. The English "walks [you] through" implies the reader, and the file elsewhere addresses the learner directly with "ty", so dropping the pronoun is an inconsistency as well as a grammatical gap.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout, register is consistently informal "você", and the domain vocabulary is right and stable ("primitivas", "supressão de erros" / "mitigação de erros", "preenchimento automático" for auto-complete, "atualizações em massa" for bulk updates); the `Unset` / server-defaults sentence and the "cópia … não afeta as opções que a primitiva possui" passage both preserve the English exactly. Two things a native technical editor would still change. First, "Ao criar uma instância da classe primitiva" (line 40) reads adjectivally in Portuguese ("a class that is primitive") instead of "a classe da primitiva" (the primitive's class, e.g. Estimator) — and it is inconsistent with line 99, which correctly writes "A classe de opções da primitiva". Second, the frontmatter description flattens "for building with Qiskit Runtime primitives" to "para usar com as primitivas", dropping the build/develop sense. Neither would mislead a learner about how options work.

examples.source: When creating an instance of the primitive class, you can pass in an instance of the `options` class.
examples.suggested: Ao criar uma instância da classe da primitiva, você pode passar uma instância da classe `options`.
examples.translation: Ao criar uma instância da classe primitiva, você pode passar uma instância da classe `options`.
examples.why: "classe primitiva" parses as "a primitive (basic) class"; the English means the class of the primitive (Estimator/Sampler). It also splits with line 99, which uses the correct genitive form "A classe de opções da primitiva".

examples.source: description: Available options for building with Qiskit Runtime primitives
examples.suggested: description: Opções disponíveis para desenvolver com as primitivas do Qiskit Runtime
examples.translation: description: Opções disponíveis para usar com as primitivas do Qiskit Runtime
examples.why: "building with" (developing applications with) is flattened to plain "usar com"; a small loss of the development framing, not a misleading change.

editor_note: One genuine semantic inversion makes this FAIL: in the "18 de junho de 2024" entry, EN "will be removed no sooner than 30 September 2024" is rendered "será removida no máximo em 30 de setembro de 2024" — "no máximo em" means "at the latest by", the exact opposite temporal bound of "no sooner than" (= "não antes de"). A reader is told the `optimization_level` option is guaranteed gone by that date when the English guarantees it will NOT go before it. Beyond that, the file is broadly fluent and correctly uses "você" throughout, but "mid-circuit measurement" is rendered two different ways — the correct "no meio do circuito" (Store entry) and the mis-parsed "medições de circuito intermediário" (four occurrences, which reads as "measurements of an intermediate circuit"); "stretch" is split between "duração elástica" and the untranslated "usando stretch" in the adjacent link; and "the representative ISA circuit" comes out with garbled word order as "execução do Circuit ISA representativo" instead of "circuito ISA representativo".

examples.source: The `optimization_level` option is deprecated for Estimator V2 and will be removed no sooner than 30 September 2024.
examples.suggested: ... e não será removida antes de 30 de setembro de 2024.
examples.translation: A opção `optimization_level` está depreciada para o Estimator V2 e será removida no máximo em 30 de setembro de 2024.
examples.why: "no sooner than" is a lower bound (earliest date); "no máximo em" states an upper bound (latest date). The deprecation timeline is inverted — a user planning a migration would read a hard deadline that the English explicitly does not set.

examples.source: mid-circuit measurements
examples.suggested: medições no meio do circuito (or: medições intermediárias no circuito) — used consistently
examples.translation: medições de circuito intermediário (4x) vs. "no meio do circuito" (Store entry, line 53)
examples.why: "medições de circuito intermediário" mis-parses the English compound: it reads as "measurements of an intermediate circuit" rather than measurements performed partway through a circuit. The file already gets it right once, so the same concept appears under two unrelated renderings.

examples.source: Support for stretch duration in delay instructions ... Deferred timing resolution using stretch
examples.suggested: Suporte para duração `stretch` em instruções de atraso (keep the Qiskit keyword, as the link title does)
examples.translation: Suporte para duração elástica em instruções de atraso ... Resolução de temporização diferida usando stretch
examples.why: `stretch` is a literal Qiskit language keyword. Translating it as "elástica" in the bullet while leaving it as "stretch" in the very next sentence's guide title breaks the link between the feature description and the API name the reader must type.

examples.source: then manage synthesis, optimization, and execution of the representative ISA circuit
examples.suggested: ... e execução do circuito ISA representativo
examples.translation: em seguida, gerenciam a síntese, otimização e execução do Circuit ISA representativo
examples.why: "Circuit ISA" is an untranslated fragment left in English word order inside otherwise Portuguese prose; the noun "circuito" simply went missing. A native technical writer would write "circuito ISA representativo".

examples.source: while maintaining similar fleet-leading coherence
examples.suggested: mantendo uma coerência igualmente líder da frota
examples.translation: mantendo coerência semelhante como líder de frota
examples.why: Calqued syntax: the PT reads as if the QPU is "similar, as a fleet leader" rather than "maintaining coherence that is similarly fleet-leading". Grammatical but stiff, and the attributive force of "fleet-leading" on "coherence" is lost.

editor_note: The prose is fluent and faithful overall, but it carries a visible layer of glossary-substitution artifacts that no Romanian technical writer would produce: "gate" appears as the non-word plural "poartă-uri" ("trei straturi de poartă-uri fracționale", "straturi de poartă-uri") in the Background yet as "Gate-uri" in the QESEM workflow list ("fidelitățile Gate-urilor", "redefinește Gate-urile native"), and "circuit" alternates between the natural Romanian "circuite / circuitul" (lines 49, 161, 676) and the pseudo-anglicism "Circuit-uri / Circuit-ului" (lines 617–618, 663), with "Qubiți" and "Backend" needlessly capitalized mid-sentence. The one substantive meaning slip is "the closely-related kicked Ising model" rendered as "modelul Ising cu «kicks» periodic corelat" — the justification "closely-related" (to the continuous-time dynamics) is replaced by a fabricated attribute "periodic corelat", so the learner loses why the kicked model is a legitimate stand-in. Secondary: OBP is introduced as "retropropagarea operatorilor" but later called "backpropagation de operator"; "observable" flips gender across the file ("mai mulți observabili" / "observabilul de magnetizare" vs "toate observabilele"); and formal "Rețineți că…", "Observați că…" sit next to the file's otherwise consistent informal "tu" ("reține", "vei vedea", "cheia ta API") — in line 99 both registers appear in a single sentence. Calques to clean up: "te simți liber să schimbi" (feel free to), "o trecere de transpilare" (a transpilation pass), "experimente la scară utilitate", "propagare prin credințe", and "atenuarea erorilor cuasi-probabilistice eficiente și nebiasate", where the adjectives grammatically attach to the errors rather than to the mitigation.

examples.source: Instead of simulating continuous-time dynamics, we adopt the closely-related kicked Ising model.
examples.suggested: În loc să simulăm dinamica în timp continuu, adoptăm modelul Ising cu impulsuri (kicked Ising), strâns înrudit cu aceasta.
examples.translation: În loc să simulăm dinamica în timp continuu, adoptăm modelul Ising cu „kicks" periodic corelat.
examples.why: „closely-related" (înrudit îndeaproape cu dinamica în timp continuu) este înlocuit de un atribut inventat, „periodic corelat". Se pierde exact motivul pedagogic pentru care modelul cu impulsuri poate înlocui evoluția continuă.

examples.source: three layers of fractional two-qubit gates … / maps gate fidelities … redefines native gates
examples.suggested: trei straturi de porți fracționale pe doi qubiți … / cartografiază fidelitățile porților … redefinește porțile native
examples.translation: trei straturi de poartă-uri fracționale cu doi Qubiți … / cartografiază fidelitățile Gate-urilor … redefinește Gate-urile native
examples.why: „poartă-uri" nu este un cuvânt românesc (pluralul corect este „porți"), iar același termen apare în altă parte ca „Gate-uri". Termenul de bază al domeniului este redat inconsecvent și într-o formă malformată; „Qubiți" nu se scrie cu majusculă la mijloc de frază.

examples.source: the backpropagation reduced two layers of the circuit … We analyze four circuits with 5, 7, and 9 Trotter steps
examples.suggested: retropropagarea a redus două straturi ale circuitului … Analizăm patru circuite cu 5, 7 și 9 pași Trotter
examples.translation: backpropagation a redus două straturi ale Circuit-ului … Analizăm patru Circuit-uri cu 5, 7 și 9 pași Trotter
examples.why: „circuit" are plural natural în română („circuite"), folosit corect la liniile 161 și 676; forma hibridă „Circuit-uri/Circuit-ului" cu majusculă este un artefact de substituție. La fel, OBP este „retropropagarea operatorilor" la linia 41, dar „backpropagation de operator" la linia 556.

examples.source: (Note that for security, it is best to save your account credentials … if you are on a trusted machine)
examples.suggested: (Reține că, pentru securitate, este recomandat să salvezi acreditările contului tău … dacă ești pe o mașină de încredere)
examples.translation: (Rețineți că, pentru securitate, este recomandat să salvezi acreditările contului tău … dacă ești pe o mașină de încredere)
examples.why: Formal „Rețineți" în aceeași frază cu „salvezi… tău… ești". Aceleași alunecări la „Rețineți că pentru circuite mari" (161) și „Observați că conectivitatea" (445), în timp ce restul fișierului folosește consecvent „tu" („Reține că", „vei vedea").

examples.source: feel free to change to your favorite subgraph / a transpilation pass / utility-scale experiments
examples.suggested: poți schimba cu subgraful tău preferat / o etapă (pas) de transpilare / experimente la scară de utilitate
examples.translation: te simți liber să schimbi cu subgraful tău preferat / o trecere de transpilare / experimente la scară utilitate
examples.why: Calcuri directe din engleză. „te simți liber" este un anglicism recunoscut ca stângaci, „trecere" nu este termenul folosit pentru „pass" în lanțul de transpilare, iar „la scară utilitate" îi lipsește prepoziția care o face frază românească.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, the Clifford setup ($0$ for the first two Rx layers, $\pi$ for the last, ideal $-1$ / $+1$) and the $6^{num\_reps}$ subexperiment count are all correct, and the informal "tu" register holds consistently (asigură-te, consultă, Reține că). What a native technical editor would change is terminological consistency and two small slips. "Sampling overhead" is rendered two ways: "supraîncărcarea de eșantionare" (line ~222, an overload/overcharge word, not the right sense) versus "supracostul de eșantionare" (lines ~289, ~348) — the latter is the correct one. Transpiler "passes" also splits within three adjacent paragraphs: "pași de transpilare" (~361, twice) then "pasele ```BasisTranslator```" / "aceste două pase" (~363). There is a straight typo in the Step 3 output bullet: "Distribuții de cvasiprobabiitate" (missing "l"), while the Step 4 bullet correctly reads "cvasi-probabilitate". Minor further: "entangler map" becomes "hartă de conectare", which drops the entanglement sense and sits uncomfortably next to "hartă de cuplare" for coupling map; "long range" alternates between "de lungă distanță" and "cu rază lungă"; and "Circuit-ul TwoLocal" (capitalized, hyphenated article) is not how a Romanian writer would set it — "circuitul TwoLocal".

examples.source: Since the sampling overhead increases exponentially with the number of cuts ... The sampling overhead of gate cutting is 6.
examples.suggested: Use "supracostul de eșantionare" in both places ("Deoarece supracostul de eșantionare crește exponențial...").
examples.translation: Deoarece supraîncărcarea de eșantionare crește exponențial cu numărul de tăieri ... Supracostul de eșantionare al tăierii porților este 6.
examples.why: The same key concept (sampling overhead) is named two different ways in one file; "supraîncărcare" means overload, not the multiplicative cost the tutorial is quantifying.

examples.source: we can use specific transpilation passes ... We shall apply BasisTranslator and then Optimize1qGatesDecomposition passes ... Using these two passes is faster
examples.suggested: Pick one form and keep it — e.g. "pasele de transpilare" throughout, or "pașii de transpilare" throughout.
examples.translation: putem folosi pași de transpilare specifici ... Vom aplica pasele ```BasisTranslator``` și apoi ```Optimize1qGatesDecomposition``` ... Utilizarea acestor două pase este mai rapidă
examples.why: "pași" and "pase" are two different nouns for the same Qiskit concept in consecutive paragraphs; a learner may not realize they refer to the same thing.

examples.source: Output: Quasi-probability distributions
examples.suggested: Ieșire: Distribuții de cvasi-probabilitate
examples.translation: Ieșire: Distribuții de cvasiprobabiitate
examples.why: Plain typo ("cvasiprobabiitate"), and it also disagrees with the correctly spelled "cvasi-probabilitate" in the Step 4 input bullet a few lines later.

examples.source: We consider a hardware-efficient `entangler map` for the TwoLocal circuit ... Build the entangler map for the TwoLocal circuit
examples.suggested: Keep `entangler map` in English (it is the code identifier `entangler_map`) or render it as "hartă de întrepătrundere/entanglement"; and write "circuitul TwoLocal" without the capital and hyphen.
examples.translation: Considerăm o `hartă de conectare` eficientă hardware pentru Circuit-ul TwoLocal ... Construirea hărții de conectare pentru Circuit-ul TwoLocal
examples.why: "hartă de conectare" erases the entanglement meaning and reads as a near-synonym of "hartă de cuplare" (coupling map), which the same section uses for a different object; "Circuit-ul TwoLocal" is non-native typography.

editor_note: No factual drift: every number, date, formula reference and caveat matches the English (56 qubits, four 30-day steps from 1 Nov 2022, `(num_generations + 1) * population_size`, the DOCPlex dashed-line benchmark, the "temporarily disabled" reason for `multiple_passmanager: False`), and the register is correctly casual with no ครับ/ค่ะ. The main defect is that "optimization" is rendered two different ways within the file: การปรับแต่ง ("tuning/adjusting") in the title and Background/Steps 1–2, then การปรับปรุง ("improvement") from Step 3 onward (ผลลัพธ์การปรับปรุง, อัลกอริทึมการปรับปรุง, การปรับปรุงทางคณิตศาสตร์) — neither is the standard math sense (การหาค่าเหมาะที่สุด / การทำให้เหมาะที่สุด), and การปรับแต่ง additionally does double duty for the genuine "adapt/customize" senses at lines 48 and 180, so the two ideas blur. Related: the product name Quantum Portfolio Optimizer, kept in English everywhere else, is suddenly translated as ตัวปรับปรุงพอร์ตโฟลิโอควอนตัม in the closing line. Smaller items: "candidate solutions" calqued as โซลูชันผู้สมัคร (ผู้สมัคร = a human applicant); "solution" alternating between โซลูชัน and ผลลัพธ์; อัลกอริธึม vs อัลกอริทึม spelt both ways; and three dropped qualifiers — "often", "expected" (return), and "default" local Qiskit pass manager.

examples.source: Dynamic portfolio optimization … / Analyze the optimization results / optimization algorithm / the quantum portfolio optimizer
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "optimization" throughout (e.g. การหาค่าเหมาะที่สุด / การทำให้เหมาะที่สุด) and keep the product name as Quantum Portfolio Optimizer in the final sentence, as at lines 26 and 66.
examples.translation: การปรับแต่งพอร์ตแบบไดนามิก … / วิเคราะห์ผลลัพธ์การปรับปรุง / อัลกอริทึมการปรับปรุง / ตัวปรับปรุงพอร์ตโฟลิโอควอนตัม
examples.why: The same core concept is split across การปรับแต่ง (tuning) and การปรับปรุง (improvement), and การปรับแต่ง is also used for the genuine "adapt/customize" senses at lines 48 and 180, so a reader cannot tell which sense is meant where.

examples.source: `population_size` for the number of candidate solutions per generation … the recombination rate
examples.suggested: จำนวนคำตอบที่เป็นไปได้ต่อรุ่น … อัตราการรวมยีนใหม่ (recombination)
examples.translation: `population_size` สำหรับจำนวนโซลูชันผู้สมัครต่อรุ่น … อัตราการรวมกัน
examples.why: ผู้สมัคร means a human applicant/candidate for a job or election; "โซลูชันผู้สมัคร" is a word-for-word calque no Thai engineer would write. อัตราการรวมกัน is likewise too vague for the genetic-algorithm sense of recombination.

examples.source: aims to find the optimal investment strategy over multiple time periods to maximize the expected portfolio return …, often under certain constraints such as budget, transaction costs, or risk aversion
examples.suggested: … เพื่อให้ได้ผลตอบแทนคาดหวังของพอร์ตสูงสุด … ซึ่งมักอยู่ภายใต้ข้อจำกัดบางอย่างเช่น …
examples.translation: มีเป้าหมายเพื่อค้นหากลยุทธ์การลงทุนที่เหมาะสมที่สุดในหลายช่วงเวลา เพื่อให้ได้ผลตอบแทนพอร์ตสูงสุดและลดความเสี่ยงให้น้อยที่สุด ภายใต้ข้อจำกัดบางอย่างเช่น …
examples.why: Two qualifiers are dropped: "expected" (ผลตอบแทนคาดหวัง is the standard finance term and is what the model actually maximizes) and "often", which turns a hedged statement into an unconditional one.

examples.source: including the default local Qiskit pass manager and the Qiskit AI-powered transpiler service
examples.suggested: รวมถึง pass manager ในเครื่องของ Qiskit ที่เป็นค่าเริ่มต้น และบริการ transpiler …
examples.translation: รวมถึง pass manager ในเครื่องของ Qiskit และบริการ Transpiler ที่ขับเคลื่อนด้วย AI ของ Qiskit
examples.why: "default" is dropped, so the reader loses the fact that the local pass manager is the baseline the AI service is compared against.

examples.source: The graph shows how the quantum portfolio optimizer consistently returns optimized investment strategies.
examples.suggested: กราฟแสดงให้เห็นว่า Quantum Portfolio Optimizer ให้กลยุทธ์การลงทุนที่ผ่านการหาค่าเหมาะที่สุดอย่างสม่ำเสมอ
examples.translation: กราฟแสดงให้เห็นว่าตัวปรับปรุงพอร์ตโฟลิโอควอนตัมส่งคืนกลยุทธ์การลงทุนที่ผ่านการปรับปรุงแล้วอย่างสม่ำเสมอ
examples.why: ส่งคืน is the programming sense of "return" (a function returning a value) and reads as a calque in prose; combined with the newly-translated product name it makes the concluding takeaway the stiffest sentence in the file.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, no dropped caveats; the AQC narrative in "การ optimize ด้วย AQC-Tensor เกิดขึ้นใน step 1 ของ Qiskit pattern … ansatz นั้นจะถูกนำเข้าใกล้ target state แบบ iterative" teaches exactly what the English does, and register is correctly casual (no ครับ/ค่ะ). What a native editor would fix is consistency. Roughly half the section headings were left untranslated ("Optimize the final circuit for execution", "Exit early if using dry run mode", "Execute the circuit on hardware", "Save the output", "Deploy the function to IBM Quantum Platform", "Run the function template remotely") while the other half were translated ("รวบรวมและตรวจสอบ inputs", "ตรวจสอบ inputs", "เตรียม function outputs", "Map ปัญหาและ pre-process circuit ด้วย AQC", "ขั้นตอนถัดไป") — the page reads as half-finished. Three core terms are also split within the file: "expectation values" is kept in English at lines 14/20/30/392 but rendered "ค่าความคาดหวัง" once at line 546; "hardware" alternates between English (lines 34, 536) and "ฮาร์ดแวร์" (lines 309, 336); "Hamiltonian simulation" alternates with "การจำลอง Hamiltonian". Finally line 150 loses the English sentence boundary so "…คือการตรวจสอบ input code ต่อไปนี้เป็นตัวอย่าง…" garden-paths as "input code".

examples.source: ### Optimize the final circuit for execution / #### Exit early if using dry run mode / ## Run the function template remotely
examples.suggested: ### ปรับ final circuit ให้เหมาะสมสำหรับการ execution / #### ออกก่อนกำหนดเมื่อใช้โหมด dry run / ## รัน function template จากระยะไกล
examples.translation: ### Optimize the final circuit for execution {#optimize-the-final-circuit-for-execution} (heading text left entirely in English)
examples.why: Six headings are untranslated while the sibling headings ("รวบรวมและตรวจสอบ inputs", "เตรียม function outputs", "ขั้นตอนถัดไป") are translated, so the page's own heading convention is inconsistent and the TOC reads half-English.

examples.source: These include the domain-level output of Hamiltonian simulation (expectation value) and useful metadata.
examples.suggested: ซึ่งรวมถึง output ระดับ domain ของการจำลอง Hamiltonian (expectation value) และ metadata ที่มีประโยชน์
examples.translation: ซึ่งรวมถึง output ระดับ domain ของการจำลอง Hamiltonian (ค่าความคาดหวัง) และ metadata ที่มีประโยชน์
examples.why: "ค่าความคาดหวัง" is a defensible Thai rendering on its own, but every other mention in this file keeps "expectation values" in English; the lone translated instance breaks the file's own convention and makes the reader re-map the term.

examples.source: the `final_circuit` is transpiled for the hardware as usual … before deciding to execute on hardware
examples.suggested: Pick one — either keep "hardware" in English throughout, or transliterate as "ฮาร์ดแวร์" throughout.
examples.translation: `final_circuit` จะถูก [transpile สำหรับฮาร์ดแวร์] ตามปกติ … ก่อนตัดสินใจรันบนฮาร์ดแวร์จริง (but line 34 "สำหรับการรันบน hardware", line 536 "ที่จะรันบน hardware")
examples.why: The same everyday term flips between English and Thai transliteration within a few paragraphs; a native technical editor would normalize it in one pass.

examples.source: An important aspect of ensuring that the template can be reused across a range of inputs is input validation. The following code is an example of verifying…
examples.suggested: สิ่งสำคัญที่ทำให้ template นำกลับมาใช้กับ inputs ได้หลากหลายคือการตรวจสอบความถูกต้องของ input   code ต่อไปนี้เป็นตัวอย่างการตรวจสอบว่า…
examples.translation: ด้านสำคัญของการทำให้ template สามารถนำกลับมาใช้ได้กับ inputs หลากหลายคือการตรวจสอบ input code ต่อไปนี้เป็นตัวอย่างการตรวจสอบว่า…
examples.why: With only a single space at the sentence boundary, "การตรวจสอบ input code ต่อไปนี้" first parses as "validating the following input code"; "ด้านสำคัญของ…" is also a stiff calque of "An important aspect of…" that a Thai writer would open as "สิ่งสำคัญ…".

editor_note: Nothing here misleads: all numbers (30 shots vs 170,000, 99% confidence, 10,000 shots/circuit, the accuracy table, the 30-day deprecation) are intact, the error suppression vs. error mitigation contrast is preserved, and domain terms are consistently kept in English (qubit, gate, circuit, shot, backend, observable, expectation value, Sampler/Estimator, primitive, error suppression), with informal register held throughout (no po/opo). What a native technical editor would still change is phrasing. "rough guide" is calqued as "magaspang na gabay" (the texture sense of rough), while two sentences later the same idea is correctly rendered "tantiyang mga threshold" — an internal inconsistency plus a literal-but-wrong word choice. The Description sentence "kaya madali mong mapapalitan ng Q-CTRL Sampler at Estimator" leaves the object dangling (replace WHAT with them?), and "Sinusupress" is an awkward hand-made verb where "Pinipigilan"/"Sinusugpo" is the natural Tagalog. Smaller slips: the doubled word in "Subukan ang tutorial na [...] tutorial" (twice, Next steps), the tense slip "na nagresulta" for the ongoing "resulting in", and the stiff "anuman ang itaas o ibaba mo ang hanay..." where "kahit itaas o ibaba mo..." is the idiomatic construction.

examples.source: The following table provides a rough guide on accuracy and runtimes ... represents rough thresholds where you can expect extremely consistent solution accuracy.
examples.suggested: ... nagbibigay ng pangkalahatang/tantiyang gabay sa katumpakan at mga runtime ...
examples.translation: Ang sumusunod na talahanayan ay nagbibigay ng magaspang na gabay sa katumpakan at mga runtime ... kundi kumakatawan sa tantiyang mga threshold ...
examples.why: "magaspang" is the physical coarse/rough-textured sense, not "approximate"; the same word "rough" is correctly rendered "tantiya" later in the same paragraph, so the file is internally inconsistent about it.

examples.source: ... two options for execution that are similar to the Qiskit Runtime primitives, so you can easily swap in the Q-CTRL Sampler and Estimator.
examples.suggested: ... kaya madali mong mapapalitan ang mga ito ng Q-CTRL Sampler at Estimator.
examples.translation: ... may dalawang opsyon para sa pagpapatakbo na katulad ng mga Qiskit Runtime primitives, kaya madali mong mapapalitan ng Q-CTRL Sampler at Estimator.
examples.why: The object of "mapapalitan" is missing, so the clause dangles — the reader has to guess what is being swapped out. Calqued English word order, not something a Tagalog technical writer would leave as is.

examples.source: Performance Management suppresses errors and increases the probability of getting the correct answer on noisy hardware.
examples.suggested: Pinipigilan/Sinusugpo ng Performance Management ang mga error at ...
examples.translation: Sinusupress ng Performance Management ang mga error at pinapataas ang posibilidad na makuha ang tamang sagot sa maingay na hardware.
examples.why: "Sinusupress" is an ad-hoc Tagalog affixation of English "suppress" that no native technical writer would spell this way; the noun "error suppression" is (correctly) kept in English elsewhere, so the verb should use the natural Tagalog form.

examples.source: Try the [Transverse-Field Ising Model with Q-CTRL's Performance Management](/tutorials/transverse-field-ising-model) tutorial.
examples.suggested: Subukan ang tutorial na [Transverse-Field Ising Model with Q-CTRL's Performance Management](/tutorials/transverse-field-ising-model).
examples.translation: Subukan ang tutorial na [Transverse-Field Ising Model with Q-CTRL's Performance Management](/tutorials/transverse-field-ising-model) tutorial.
examples.why: "tutorial" appears twice around the link (in both bullets) — a leftover from moving the head noun before the link; reads as an editing artifact.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner: the technical content is faithful, the negation in "Hindi nangangailangan ng authentication ang Qiskit MCP Server at Qiskit Docs MCP Server" is preserved correctly, domain terms are sensibly kept in English per Tagalog technical convention (quantum circuit, transpile → "pag-transpile"/"mag-transpile", backend, job, authentication, reinforcement learning), and the register is consistently informal (no po/opo). What a native technical editor would still change: (1) the identical English frame "This server enables AI assistants to…" is rendered two different ways in the same section list — "Nagbibigay-daan ang server na ito sa mga AI assistant na…" (Qiskit Runtime, Qiskit Docs, Qiskit Gym) versus the weaker "Tinutulungan ng server na ito ang mga AI assistant na…" (Qiskit MCP Server, Qiskit IBM Transpiler), which both breaks parallelism across four sibling headings and softens "enables" to "helps"; (2) "ay maaaring magmukha tulad nito" is a stiff calque of "might look like this" that a native writer would phrase as "maaaring ganito ang hitsura"; (3) the wordy "sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng MCP Inspector" / "sa pamamagitan ng pagpapatakbo ng sumusunod na command" where plain "gamit ang" / "sa pagpapatakbo ng" is the natural Tagalog. All three are style/consistency, not accuracy.

examples.source: This server enables AI assistants to create, manipulate, and transpile quantum circuits
examples.suggested: Nagbibigay-daan ang server na ito sa mga AI assistant na lumikha, magbago, at mag-transpile ng mga quantum circuit
examples.translation: Tinutulungan ng server na ito ang mga AI assistant na lumikha, magbago, at mag-transpile ng mga quantum circuit
examples.why: The same English frame "This server enables…" is rendered "Nagbibigay-daan" in the Runtime, Docs and Gym entries but "Tinutulungan" (= helps) in the Qiskit MCP Server and IBM Transpiler entries. Within-file inconsistency across four parallel sibling sections, and "tinutulungan" is a mild softening of "enables".

examples.source: For example, an MCP client configuration file might look like this:
examples.suggested: Halimbawa, maaaring ganito ang hitsura ng configuration file ng MCP client:
examples.translation: Halimbawa, ang isang configuration file ng MCP client ay maaaring magmukha tulad nito:
examples.why: "maaaring magmukha tulad nito" is a word-for-word calque of "might look like this"; the verb "magmukha" does not take "tulad nito" this way in natural Tagalog. A native technical writer would use "ganito ang hitsura".

examples.source: You can test the MCP servers interactively by using the MCP Inspector:
examples.suggested: Maaari mong subukan ang mga MCP server nang interactive gamit ang MCP Inspector:
examples.translation: Maaari mong subukan ang mga MCP server nang interactive sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng MCP Inspector:
examples.why: "sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng" is a heavy nominalized rendering of "by using" where "gamit ang" is the idiomatic Tagalog; the same padding appears in line 64 ("sa pamamagitan ng pagpapatakbo ng sumusunod na command"). Stiff but not misleading.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, the QUBO→cost-Hamiltonian derivation, the Premium-Plan/session caveat, and the COBYLA noise discussion all land correctly, and the informal "ти" register holds with no Ви slips. The main defects are terminological. (1) "Background" is rendered "Передумови", the exact same heading as "Prerequisites" two sections above, so the file has two identically-titled sections and the in-text cross-references "як описано в розділі [Передумови](#background)" / "дивись [Передумови](#background)" look like they point at the prerequisites list; "Background" should be "Загальні відомості" / "Теоретичні відомості". (2) "circuit" is split within the file between the Ukrainian "контур" (headings, "Основи квантових контурів", "Діаграма контуру", "контур-ансац") and a bare capitalized English "Circuit" in running prose ("абстрактний Circuit", "параметризований Circuit QAOA", "параметри для Circuit"), and the same English-leak pattern hits "qubit" ("зі 127 або більше qubit", "відображення qubit" — should be "кубіт", declined) and "Gate" ("розкладання Gate" — should be "вентилів"). (3) "shots" is calqued as "пострілів" ("замало пострілів на одну оцінку"), and "upstream" as the literal "щось вище за течією потребує уваги"; also "sets" of nodes are "набори" rather than the mathematical "множини", "sampled distribution" becomes "вибраний розподіл" (reads as "selected"), and there is an agreement slip in "Усі чотири кроки показані нижче … та розділена на чотири комірки" (should be "розділені").

examples.source: ## Background  …  As described in the [Background](#background) …
examples.suggested: ## Загальні відомості {#background}  …  Як описано в розділі [Загальні відомості](#background) …
examples.translation: ## Передумови {#background}  …  Як описано в розділі [Передумови](#background) …
examples.why: "Background" gets the identical heading as "Prerequisites" (## Передумови {#prerequisites}, line 25), so the tutorial has two sections with the same name and the two back-references appear to point at the prerequisites list instead of the theory section.

examples.source: Transpile the abstract circuit into hardware-native instructions. … better parameters for the circuit
examples.suggested: Транспілюй абстрактний контур у нативні для обладнання інструкції. … кращі параметри для контуру
examples.translation: Транспілюй абстрактний Circuit у нативні для обладнання інструкції. … кращі параметри для Circuit
examples.why: "circuit" is rendered as Ukrainian "контур" in headings and links but left as bare capitalized English "Circuit" in prose in the same file — an untranslated glossary leak plus a within-file inconsistency for the single most-used term of the tutorial.

examples.source: the code selects a backend with 127 or more qubits … devices with over 100 qubits … This step handles qubit mapping, gate decomposition
examples.suggested: код обирає бекенд зі 127 або більше кубітами … пристроїв із понад 100 кубітами … обробляє відображення кубітів, розкладання вентилів
examples.translation: код обирає Backend зі 127 або більше qubit … пристроїв із понад 100 qubit … Цей крок обробляє відображення qubit, розкладання Gate
examples.why: "qubit", "Gate" and "Backend" are left in English, capitalized mid-sentence and undeclined, so the Ukrainian noun phrases lose case agreement ("зі 127 або більше qubit") — these all have settled Ukrainian renderings (кубіт, вентиль/гейт, бекенд).

examples.source: A noisy, non-monotonic curve usually indicates that something upstream needs attention; common causes are too few shots per evaluation (high estimator variance)
examples.suggested: Шумна, немонотонна крива зазвичай вказує на те, що проблема виникла на попередніх етапах; поширені причини — замало вимірювань (шотів) на одну оцінку (висока дисперсія Estimator)
examples.translation: Шумна, немонотонна крива зазвичай вказує на те, що щось вище за течією потребує уваги; поширені причини — це замало пострілів на одну оцінку (висока дисперсія Estimator)
examples.why: "вище за течією" is a literal river-calque of "upstream" no Ukrainian engineer would write in this context, and "постріл" is the firearm sense of "shot" rather than the measurement-repetition sense (вимірювання/шоти).

examples.source: partition the nodes into two sets … which set it belongs to … Extract the most likely bitstring from the sampled distribution
examples.suggested: розбити вузли на дві множини … до якої множини він належить … із отриманого вибіркою розподілу
examples.translation: розбити вузли на два набори … до якого набору він належить … Витягни найбільш імовірний бітовий рядок із вибраного розподілу
examples.why: In mathematics a "set" is "множина", not "набір"; and "вибраний розподіл" reads as "the selected distribution" rather than "the distribution obtained by sampling", slightly blurring what the Sampler produced.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic inversion, no swapped quantity, no dropped caveat, and the informal register (znáš, Uvažuj, Všimni si) holds with no Vy/Vám slips. The defects are terminological and mechanical. (1) The word "qubit" is broken apart by stray spaces in three places — "na jednom qubit u", "na více qubit ech", "počet qubit ů" — and once left uninflected ("na stejném qubit" instead of "qubitu"); this looks like a glossary-substitution artifact and reads as corrupted text. (2) The same word is capitalized inconsistently as a proper noun: "n-Qubitové Pauliho operace", "na více Qubitech", "řídicí Qubity" alongside correct lowercase "řídicí qubit" and "qubitové Pauliho operaci" — Czech never capitalizes this common noun. (3) "circuit" and "gate" are left in English and then Czech-declined ("Zde je Circuit založený na odhadu fáze", "diagram Circuitu", "menší Circuity", "řízené unitární Gate ... řízené jednotkové Gate jsou prostě jednotkové Gate"), where established Czech domain usage is "obvod"/"schéma obvodu" and "hradlo"; recognizable, but no Czech quantum author writes this. (4) A few calqued/stiff sentences remain, notably "Máme také zde uvedená pravidla pro násobení." and "V této množině je 16 různých matic, která se běžně nazývá *Pauliho grupa*." where the relative clause dangles off the wrong noun. (5) "respectively" is dropped from the projection-sets sentence. Core physics terminology is otherwise correct and consistent: nejednotkové Pauliho matice, antikomutují, hermitovské, spektrální rozklad, pozorovatelná, projektivní měření, hodnost 2^(n-1), překlopení bitu / překlopení fáze.

examples.source: operations on a single qubit — and by tensoring them together we obtain operations on multiple qubits / the number of qubits on which it acts non-trivially / on the same qubit
examples.suggested: na jednom qubitu — ... operace na více qubitech / počet qubitů, na kterých působí netriviálně / na stejném qubitu
examples.translation: na jednom qubit u — a jejich tenzorovým součinem získáme operace na více qubit ech / počet qubit ů, na kterých působí netriviálně / na stejném qubit
examples.why: The stem is split from its Czech case ending by a stray space (three occurrences) and once left uninflected. Reads as corrupted text, almost certainly a glossary-substitution artifact rather than a translator choice.

examples.source: Here's a circuit based on phase estimation ... the following circuit diagram illustrates ... lower weight Pauli observables require smaller circuits ... these phase-estimation circuits ... the circuit can be simplified
examples.suggested: Zde je obvod založený na odhadu fáze ... následující schéma obvodu ilustruje ... vyžadují menší obvody ... tyto obvody pro odhad fáze ... lze obvod zjednodušit
examples.translation: Zde je Circuit založený na odhadu fáze ... následující diagram Circuitu ilustruje ... vyžadují k implementaci tímto přístupem menší Circuity ... tyto Circuity odhadu fáze ... lze Circuit zjednodušit
examples.why: 'Circuit' is a term Czech does translate — 'obvod' / 'kvantový obvod' is the universal convention. Keeping the English word and declining it (Circuitu, Circuity) is an over-keep-English glossary error; recognizable, so not misleading, but no native technical writer would produce it.

examples.source: we only need to include controlled-unitary gates for non-identity tensor factors ... controlled-identity gates are simply identity gates and can therefore be omitted
examples.suggested: potřebujeme zahrnout řízená unitární hradla pouze pro nejednotkové tenzorové faktory ... řízená jednotková hradla jsou prostě jednotková hradla, a proto je lze vynechat
examples.translation: potřebujeme zahrnout řízené unitární Gate pouze pro *nejednotkové* tenzorové faktory ... řízené jednotkové Gate jsou prostě jednotkové Gate, a proto je lze vynechat
examples.why: 'Gate' left in English and used as an indeclinable neuter plural; Czech uses 'hradlo/hradla' without exception. It also breaks agreement ('řízené ... Gate' vs correct 'řízená hradla').

examples.source: Pauli operations on multiple qubits / n-qubit Pauli operations ... on qubits / the control qubits were drawn on the top
examples.suggested: na více qubitech / n-qubitové Pauliho operace ... na qubitech / byly řídicí qubity nakresleny nahoře
examples.translation: Pauliho operace na více Qubitech / $n$-Qubitové Pauliho operace ... na Qubitech / byly řídicí Qubity nakresleny nahoře
examples.why: Capitalized 'Qubit' is used as if it were a proper noun in most of the second half of the file, while the same word appears correctly lowercase elsewhere ('řídicí qubit je v tomto diagramu dole', line ~228). Within-file inconsistency plus a capitalization Czech orthography does not allow for a common noun.

examples.source: We also have the multiplication rules listed here. / There are 16 different matrices in this set, which is commonly called the Pauli group.
examples.suggested: Dále platí následující pravidla pro násobení. / Tato množina obsahuje 16 různých matic a běžně se nazývá Pauliho grupa.
examples.translation: Máme také zde uvedená pravidla pro násobení. / V této množině je 16 různých matic, která se běžně nazývá *Pauliho grupa*.
examples.why: The first is a word-order calque that a Czech technical writer would never produce. In the second the relative pronoun 'která' dangles — its nearest plausible antecedent is 'matic' (gen. pl.), not the intended 'množina', which is buried in a locative prepositional phrase; the reader has to re-parse to see that it is the set, not the matrices, that is called the Pauli group.

examples.source: are therefore the projective measurements defined by the following sets of projections, respectively.

examples.translation: jsou tedy projektivní měření definovaná následujícími množinami projekcí.
examples.why: 'respectively' is dropped, so the explicit pairing of X/Y/Z with the three listed projection sets is left implicit. Recoverable from the display, so not misleading, but a dropped qualifier the editor would restore.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing here would mislead a learner: the v1.0 upgrade caveat keeps its bolded negation ("**no puedes** usar `pip install -U qiskit`"), the tier structure is rendered consistently as "Nivel 1/2/3", and the informal tú register holds everywhere ("Instala Python", "Consulta la sección", "Usa `pip list`"). What a native technical editor would still change is a small set of calques and one unsourced addition: "si tu entorno Python se corrompe en el camino" is a literal transfer of "somewhere along the way" (natural Spanish would be "en algún momento"); "consulta la documentación del paquete que falló al instalar" calques "the package that failed to install" and reads as if the package failed *while* installing something else (native: "que no se pudo instalar"); and both Tier-3 blocks gloss "best effort only" as "se ofrece solo en la medida de lo posible (sin garantías)", where the parenthetical is an addition the English does not make (defensible in sense, but not in the source). The bullet "Windows 64-bit (Windows 10 y versiones posteriores compatibles)" also parses awkwardly as a dangling adjective; "(se admiten Windows 10 y versiones posteriores)" is the natural order.

examples.source: if your Python environment becomes corrupted somewhere along the way, you can easily delete the virtual environment and start over!
examples.suggested: si en algún momento tu entorno de Python se corrompe, ¡puedes eliminar fácilmente el entorno virtual y empezar de cero!
examples.translation: si tu entorno Python se corrompe en el camino, ¡puedes eliminar fácilmente el entorno virtual y comenzar de nuevo!
examples.why: 'en el camino' is a literal transfer of 'along the way' and reads as translationese in Spanish technical prose; it also drops the 'somewhere/at some point' temporal sense that 'en algún momento' carries.

examples.source: please check the documentation of the package that failed to install (in the example code, ``SOME_PACKAGE``)
examples.suggested: consulta la documentación del paquete que no se pudo instalar (en el código de ejemplo, ``SOME_PACKAGE``)
examples.translation: consulta la documentación del paquete que falló al instalar (en el código de ejemplo, ``SOME_PACKAGE``)
examples.why: 'que falló al instalar' calques the English intransitive 'failed to install'; in Spanish it reads as the package failing *while it was installing something*, i.e. an active subject, rather than the package that could not be installed.

examples.source: Support for these operating systems are best effort only.
examples.suggested: El soporte para estos sistemas operativos se ofrece solo en la medida de lo posible.
examples.translation: El soporte para estos sistemas operativos se ofrece solo en la medida de lo posible (sin garantías).
examples.why: '(sin garantías)' is an explanatory addition with no counterpart in the English. The gloss is compatible with 'best effort', but a support page should not introduce a stronger, unsourced disclaimer; the same addition appears in both the v2.x and v1.x Tier 3 blocks.

examples.source: Windows 64-bit (Windows 10 and later supported)
examples.suggested: Windows de 64 bits (se admiten Windows 10 y versiones posteriores)
examples.translation: Windows 64-bit (Windows 10 y versiones posteriores compatibles)
examples.why: The trailing adjective 'compatibles' dangles: Spanish does not form a parenthetical the way English stacks 'supported' at the end, so the phrase reads as an unfinished fragment. A verbal construction ('se admiten…') is the idiomatic rendering, and 'de 64 bits' matches the '64 bits'/'32 bits' wording already used later in the same file.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats: the `--qpu` fallback ("la spécification sera ignorée"), the `{}` environment case, the Open-Plan `QRMI_IBM_QRS_SESSION_MODE="batch"` workaround, the allocator-node exception and the "pas besoin de redémarrer le cluster Slurm" note all land exactly as in English, and the informal "tu" convention holds everywhere (ton hôte, tu peux, consulte, ajoute) with no vous/veuillez slip. HPC terminology is idiomatic and consistent (nœuds de calcul, nœuds de connexion, script de job, bibliothèque partagée, compilation croisée, journalisation). Two small editorial points: the Logging section adds a gloss absent from the source — "Ce plugin s'appuie sur le système de journalisation de Slurm (le logger Slurm)" for plain "This plugin uses the Slurm logger for logging" — a redundant doublet a native technical editor would trim; and "API endpoint" is rendered "le point d'accès API", recognizable but not the conventional French term ("le point de terminaison de l'API", or simply keeping "endpoint").

examples.source: This plugin uses the Slurm logger for logging.

examples.translation: Ce plugin s'appuie sur le système de journalisation de Slurm (le logger Slurm).
examples.why: Adds a parenthetical gloss that is not in the source and restates the same idea twice ('système de journalisation' + 'le logger'); a French technical writer would keep the single term.

examples.translation: Les implémentations actuelles supposent que le point d'accès API et les identifiants sont spécifiés via des variables d'environnement
examples.why: 'point d'accès' reads as 'access point'; the established French rendering of an API endpoint is 'point de terminaison' (or the field simply keeps 'endpoint'). Recognizable, not misleading.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift, no inverted condition, no dropped caveat, and the migration tables/claims (V1→V2 primitives, `n'incluent pas le suffixe -V2`, `BasicAer` global-instance caution, `2\pi` phase note) all match the English; the informal "tu" convention holds with zero vous/votre/veuillez slips. What a native technical editor would change is naturalness: "fake backends/fake providers" is rendered with post-posed adjectives throughout ("les backends faux", "les classes de fournisseur faux", tab labels "Backends faux"/"Fournisseurs faux") where French wants "faux backends" or, better, "backends fictifs/simulés"; and several sentences are word-order calques of the English ("cette fonction n'a plus de but" for "no longer serves a purpose", "analyse tes fichiers OpenQASM 2 dans un `QuantumCircuit`" for "parse ... into", "pour les buts spéciaux de test" for "for special testing purposes", "nous nous référerons à l'interface ... comme «primitives V1»", "Alternativement" for "Alternatively"). Smaller mechanical slips: "En Qiskit 1.0" (should be "Dans Qiskit 1.0"), "décale un cycle complet" (missing "d'"), a stray capital in "différents Circuits", and "le transpiler pass `NoiseAdaptiveLayout`" left as a raw English noun phrase instead of "la passe de transpilation". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: the fake provider classes, all of the device-specific fake backends ... The fake backend classes for special testing purposes

examples.translation: les classes de fournisseur faux, tous les backends faux spécifiques aux appareils ... Les classes de backend faux pour les buts spéciaux de test
examples.why: 'faux' is an anteposed adjective in French; 'backends faux' / 'fournisseur faux' reads as machine word-order, and 'pour les buts spéciaux de test' is a direct calque of 'for special testing purposes'. Consistent, so not confusing, but no native technical writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: this function no longer serves a purpose. Instead, parse your OpenQASM 2 files into a QuantumCircuit

examples.why: 'En Qiskit 1.0' is ungrammatical ('Dans Qiskit 1.0'), 'le support pour exécuter' calques the English gerund, and 'travaux de pulse' is an over-translation of the Qiskit term 'job', which the French community keeps as 'job' (or renders 'tâche').

examples.translation: Le transpiler pass `NoiseAdaptiveLayout` a été remplacé par [...] le plugin d'étage de disposition `"noise_adaptive"`
examples.why: 'Le transpiler pass' leaves the whole English noun phrase untranslated in otherwise French prose (used twice, also for CrosstalkAdaptiveSchedule), while 'layout' is translated as 'disposition' — an inconsistent half-translated pairing. Recognizable, so not misleading, but an editor would unify it.

editor_note: Physics content is faithful — every uncertainty relation, commutator discussion, curve description ("העקומה האדומה ... תמיד גדולה יותר מהעקומה הכתומה") and Q&A answer matches the English, so nothing here misleads a learner. But "observable" is rendered four different ways within one file: transliterated "אובסרבבלים" (intro), "אובייקט נצפה"/"אובייקטים נצפים" (Calculating-uncertainty section — literally "observed object", wrong noun class for a measurable quantity), and bare English "observables" (PUB paragraph, Challenge line, Critical-concepts bullet); "eigenstate" likewise splits between "מצב עצמי" (answers a/b) and English "eigenstate" (lines about rotating to a Y eigenstate and in Critical concepts), and "projection" between "השלכה" and "היטל". Two prose renderings are simply the wrong word: "we simply visualize the counts" → "אנחנו פשוט מדמיינים את הספירות" (= "we imagine the counts") and "visualize the results of each measurement separately" → "לדמות את תוצאות כל מדידה" (= "to simulate"), and "linear momentum" is "תנע הקו" in the intro but correctly "תנע ליניארי" in the T/F questions. Discussion question 3 of the English ("What additional experiments would you like to do…") is missing entirely from the Hebrew. Style-wise the file leans on the calqued English possessive ("מצב עם תנע מוגדר היטב ... יש לו מיקום מאוד לא-וודאי", "מצבים עצמיים של מטריצות פאולי יש להם יחס מעניין") instead of the Hebrew ל- construction, drops into literary register with "אין אנחנו יודעים", and switches address form mid-document (שים לב / כתוב קוד vs שימו לב / בחרו).

examples.source: there are certain physical observables that have an incompatibility … the uncertainty for some observable $S$ … Pick any observables you like.
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering and keep it, e.g. "גודל נמדד" / "אופרטור נצפה" throughout (or consistently keep the English term).
examples.translation: ישנם אובסרבבלים פיזיקליים מסוימים … אי-הודאות של אובייקט נצפה $S$ … בחרו כל observables שתרצו
examples.why: Four renderings of the same core term in one file — a transliteration, a literal "observed object" (an observable is a quantity, not an object), and bare English twice. Recognizable in context, but a reader cannot tell they are the same concept.

examples.source: we simply visualize the counts … you can use ```marginal_counts``` to visualize the results of each measurement separately
examples.suggested: …אנחנו פשוט מציגים את הספירות בצורה גרפית … כדי להציג בנפרד את תוצאות כל מדידה
examples.translation: אנחנו פשוט מדמיינים את הספירות … ניתן להשתמש ב-```marginal_counts``` לדמות את תוצאות כל מדידה בנפרד
examples.why: "לדמיין" means "to imagine" and "לדמות" means "to simulate"; neither is "to visualize". In a post-processing step "to simulate the results of each measurement" is actively the wrong operation, though the plot_histogram call right below rescues the reader.

examples.source: 3. What additional experiments would you like to do to convince yourself of the results obtained here?
examples.suggested: 3. אילו ניסויים נוספים הייתם רוצים לבצע כדי לשכנע את עצמכם בתוצאות שהתקבלו כאן?

examples.suggested: למצב עם תנע מוגדר היטב … יש מיקום לא-וודאי מאוד … למצבים עצמיים של מטריצות פאולי יש יחס מעניין

editor_note: Line 44 carries an injected, untranslated English bullet — "  - To simulate circuits with Qiskit Aer, see [Exact and noisy simulation with Qiskit Aer primitives](/guides/simulate-with-qiskit-sdk-primitives)." — spliced into the running body immediately before the "[סימולציה מדויקת ורועשת...] מציג כיצד..." paragraph; the English has no such line there, it is a duplicate of the Next-steps recommendation at line 165, and it renders to the reader as a stray English cross-reference mid-Hebrew-article. Terminology is also damaged in two places: "observable" is rendered "האובייקטבל" (a transliteration of *object*, not *observable*; the field uses "אופרטור נצפה"/"גודל נצפה"), and "gate" is never given its standard Hebrew term "שער" but appears as the hybrid "Gateים" / "Gate סיבוב Pauli" / "Gate CX", which no native technical writer would produce. Smaller defects: "up to global phase" becomes "עד פאזה גלובלית" (missing "כדי" — reads as "until a global phase" rather than "up to a global phase"), "bit" is misspelled "סיביה" instead of "סיבית", and "is parameterized by" is calqued as "הוא מפרמטר על ידי".

examples.source: (no corresponding line — English line 45 begins directly with "[Exact and noisy simulation with Qiskit Aer primitives](simulate-with-qiskit-aer) shows how to use ...")

examples.source: compute the expectation value of the observable $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.suggested: לחשב את ערך התצפית/ערך הציפייה של האופרטור הנצפה $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.translation: לחשב את ערך הציפייה של האובייקטבל $ZZ \cdots Z$
examples.why: "אובייקטבל" is the transliteration of *object*, not *observable* — the learner is pointed at the wrong concept (an object rather than a measurable operator) at the exact point where the Estimator's role is being taught. The conventional Hebrew rendering is "אופרטור נצפה" / "גודל נצפה".

examples.source: a quantum circuit that consists solely of the following gates ... any Pauli rotation gate ... angles on $R_y$ and $R_z$ gates ... to each CX gate
examples.suggested: המורכב אך ורק מהשערים הבאים ... כל שער סיבוב Pauli ... זוויות של שערי $R_y$ ו-$R_z$ ... לכל שער CX
examples.translation: המורכב אך ורק מ-Gateים הבאים ... כל Gate סיבוב Pauli ... זוויות על Gate $R_y$ ו-$R_z$ ... לכל Gate CX
examples.why: "שער" is the settled Hebrew term for a quantum gate; keeping the English noun and bolting on the Hebrew plural suffix ("Gateים") plus the hybrid construct "Gate סיבוב Pauli" reads as unedited machine output and is used inconsistently against "מעגל", "רעש", "שגיאה" which are all translated.

examples.source: that has an angle contained in the set $\{0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}\}$ (up to global phase)
examples.suggested: (עד כדי פאזה גלובלית)
examples.translation: שיש לו זווית הכלולה בקבוצה $\{0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}\}$ (עד פאזה גלובלית)
examples.why: Without "כדי", "עד פאזה גלובלית" reads as the temporal/limit sense "until a global phase" rather than the mathematical "up to a global phase" (equivalence modulo global phase) — the qualifier that makes the Clifford-set claim correct is garbled.

examples.source: the efficient_su2 circuit is parameterized by angles on $R_y$ and $R_z$ gates ... readout error that flips each measured bit with 5% probability
examples.suggested: שמעגל efficient_su2 מפורמטר בזוויות של שערי $R_y$ ו-$R_z$ ... שגיאת קריאה שהופכת כל סיבית נמדדת בהסתברות של 5%
examples.translation: שמעגל efficient_su2 הוא מפרמטר על ידי זוויות על Gate $R_y$ ו-$R_z$ ... שגיאת readout שהופכת כל סיביה שנמדדת עם הסתברות של 5%
examples.why: "הוא מפרמטר על ידי" is a word-for-word calque of the English passive (redundant copula plus "על ידי" where Hebrew takes a plain instrumental), and "סיביה" is a misspelling of "סיבית" (bit); both mark the sentence as translated rather than written.

editor_note: No semantic drift found — every claim, condition, quantity and caveat matches the English (the measure-0/measure-1 branch, ZZ(θ+π), "kedalaman pengukuran 1", the "tiga job" wording, and the closing tradeoff sentence are all faithful), and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. The defects are terminological/consistency-level: "We entangle the ancilla with each data qubit" is rendered "Kita **mengaitkan** ancilla dengan setiap qubit data" — "mengaitkan" means "to link/associate" and is used elsewhere in the id corpus only in that sense, while entanglement is conventionally "menjerat/terjerat/keterjeratan"; the quantum concept is flattened to a generic "link". The same term is also split within the file: "perangkat keras" (8×, Steps 1–2) vs "hardware" (5×, Steps 3–4), and the verb "mentranspile" (6×) vs "mentranspilasi" (3×); head-noun order flips between "qubit data / qubit ancilla" and English-order "data qubit / ancilla qubit / unitary ideal circuits". Finally "kicks from the local magnetic field" becomes "tendangan dari medan magnet lokal" — "tendangan" is a football kick; a physicist would write "sentakan/hentakan" or keep "kick", especially since the title itself keeps "Kicked Ising".

examples.source: We entangle the ancilla with each data qubit using CX gates from the data qubit to the ancilla qubit.
examples.suggested: Kita menjerat (entangle) ancilla dengan setiap qubit data menggunakan gate CX ...
examples.translation: Kita mengaitkan ancilla dengan setiap qubit data menggunakan gate CX dari qubit data ke qubit ancilla.
examples.why: 'mengaitkan' = link/associate; the id corpus uses it only in that generic sense (e.g. 'mengaitkan probabilitas dengan ...') and renders entanglement as terjerat/keterjeratan (61+ hits). The entanglement concept is weakened to a generic connection, though CX context keeps it recognizable.

examples.source: hardware (throughout)
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering and use it file-wide.
examples.translation: 'perangkat keras' 8× (Steps 1–2) vs 'hardware' 5× (Steps 3–4)
examples.why: Within-file split of the same term across the two halves of the tutorial; reads like two passes merged.

examples.source: transpile / transpiling
examples.suggested: Standardize on one verb form (mentranspilasi, matching the section headings 'Transpilasi untuk ...').
examples.translation: 'mentranspile circuit ke perangkat keras' vs 'saat mentranspilasi unitary circuits'
examples.why: Two different Indonesian verb formations for the same operation, including headings vs body text.

examples.source: as well as kicks from the local magnetic field on each site
examples.suggested: serta sentakan (kick) dari medan magnet lokal di setiap situs
examples.translation: serta tendangan dari medan magnet lokal di setiap situs
examples.why: 'tendangan' is the everyday word for a football kick; for the kicked-Ising drive a native technical writer would use 'sentakan/hentakan' or keep 'kick' — the title already keeps 'Kicked Ising', so the literal rendering is also internally inconsistent.

examples.source: the pre-computed MPS simulation results for the unitary ideal circuits
examples.suggested: ... untuk circuit unitary ideal
examples.translation: hasil simulasi MPS yang sudah dihitung sebelumnya untuk unitary ideal circuits
examples.why: English adjective order carried over untouched into Indonesian prose; a calque a native editor would reorder (head noun first).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveat, no wrong domain term; register is consistently informal ("kamu", "akunmu", "IBM Cloud-mu") and terms like "nilai ekspektasi", "penekanan error", "primitif", "mode eksekusi" are correct. The one real defect is within-file inconsistency on "circuit": the prose uses capitalized English "Circuit" in most places ("Circuit kuantum", "Circuit dinamis", "Circuit terparameterisasi", "Circuit dan observabel", "Circuit *instruction set architecture (ISA)*") but switches to Indonesian "sirkuit" in section 2 ("Buat sebuah sirkuit", "setidaknya satu sirkuit"). The capitalization itself is unnatural — a native technical writer would not capitalize a common noun mid-sentence, and the same habit hits "Gunakan Transpiler". Minor stiffness elsewhere: "contoh-contoh detail" reads as calqued word order, and "mode yang ingin dijalankan" drops the English agent ("the mode you want it to run in").

examples.source: quantum circuits / Create a circuit / The circuit and observable need to be transformed
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering and keep it — e.g. "sirkuit" throughout ("sirkuit kuantum", "sirkuit dinamis", "sirkuit terparameterisasi", "sirkuit dan observabel")
examples.translation: Circuit kuantum … Buat sebuah sirkuit … Circuit dan observabel perlu ditransformasi
examples.why: The same core term is split between capitalized English "Circuit" and Indonesian "sirkuit" inside one short page; the concept stays identifiable, so this is MINOR, but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: Use the transpiler to do this.
examples.suggested: Gunakan transpiler untuk melakukan ini.
examples.translation: Gunakan Transpiler untuk melakukan ini.
examples.why: Mid-sentence capitalization of a common noun is an English-typography carryover; Indonesian technical prose lowercases "transpiler" (and "sirkuit") unless it names a specific class/API object.

examples.source: Review detailed examples.
examples.suggested: Tinjau [contoh terperinci](sampler-examples).
examples.translation: Tinjau [contoh-contoh](sampler-examples) detail.
examples.why: "contoh-contoh detail" mirrors English adjective placement awkwardly around the link; the reduplicated plural plus trailing "detail" is not how a native writer would phrase it.

examples.source: use the `mode` parameter to specify the mode you want it to run in
examples.suggested: gunakan parameter `mode` untuk menentukan mode yang kamu inginkan untuk menjalankannya
examples.translation: gunakan parameter `mode` untuk menentukan mode yang ingin dijalankan
examples.why: The agent ("you want it to run in") is elided, leaving a slightly impersonal passive that is weaker than the English instruction; not misleading, just flatter pedagogically.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, informal "tu" holds consistently ("Ti consigliamo di usare queste versioni o versioni più recenti", "segui le istruzioni", "quando invii un job"), and the core terms are right and stable ("valore/valori di aspettazione", "primitive", "osservabile", "QPU", "job", "batch", Estimator kept in English). The one real defect is a glossary leak on the generic noun "circuit": it is left untranslated and capitalized as if it were a Qiskit class in "coppia Circuit-osservabile" (line ~43), "più coppie Circuit-osservabile" (line ~87) and the heading "Esegui Circuit parametrizzati" (line ~141), while the very next sentence correctly writes "la riusabilità del circuito" — so the file splits the same word between "Circuit" and "circuito". Secondary: the opening lead sentence "Calcola e interpreta in modo efficiente i valori di aspettazione degli operatori quantistici richiesti da molti algoritmi con Estimator" strands "con Estimator" at the end, where it can be misread as attaching to "algoritmi"; a native technical writer would front it as "Usa Estimator per calcolare e interpretare…". Nothing here would teach a learner a false concept.

examples.source: Use Estimator to determine the expectation value of a single circuit-observable pair.
examples.suggested: Usa Estimator per determinare il valore di aspettazione di una singola coppia circuito-osservabile.
examples.translation: Usa Estimator per determinare il valore di aspettazione di una singola coppia Circuit-osservabile.
examples.why: "circuit" here is the generic noun, not the Qiskit class; leaving it untranslated and capitalized as "Circuit" makes it look like an API identifier and clashes with "circuito" used correctly elsewhere in the same file (line ~143 "la riusabilità del circuito").

examples.source: ## Run parameterized circuits
examples.suggested: ## Esegui circuiti parametrizzati
