examples.translation: ## Esegui Circuit parametrizzati
examples.why: Same untranslated-noun leak, now in a section heading and with an Italian plural adjective agreeing with an English singular noun ("Circuit parametrizzati"), which no native technical writer would produce.

examples.source: Efficiently calculate and interpret expectation values of the quantum operators required for many algorithms with Estimator.
examples.suggested: Usa Estimator per calcolare e interpretare in modo efficiente i valori di aspettazione degli operatori quantistici richiesti da molti algoritmi.
examples.translation: Calcola e interpreta in modo efficiente i valori di aspettazione degli operatori quantistici richiesti da molti algoritmi con Estimator.
examples.why: Word-order calque: "con Estimator" trails at the end of a long noun chain and reads as modifying "algoritmi" rather than the verbs; fronting the instrument restores the English emphasis.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift: the shots caveat ("Gli shot **non** vengono divisi tra le configurazioni … 10.240 shot totali"), the broadcastable-from direction, and every table row (including "l'1 si espande a 4") match the English exactly, and the informal "tu" register holds consistently (ti aiuterà, ometti, puoi, richiedi). The defects are cosmetic glossary leakage and stiffness: "circuit" is rendered as the capitalized English "Circuit" in two places ("hai definito Circuit appropriati", "se il tuo Circuit ha tre parametri") while the rest of the file correctly says "circuito"/"circuito parametrico", and "gates" appears as capitalized "Gate casuali" in the twirling note while the same paragraph area uses lowercase "il twirling dei gate". Two phrasings read as calque rather than native technical Italian: "può contenere dimensioni di dimensione 1" (tautological rendering of "size-1 dimensions"; a native editor would write "assi di dimensione unitaria") and "non benefici della media su più randomizzazioni" (stiff; "non trai vantaggio dalla media su più randomizzazioni"). None of this would mislead a learner.

examples.source: They assume you have defined appropriate circuits … if your circuit has three parameters
examples.suggested: … che tu abbia definito circuiti appropriati … se il tuo circuito ha tre parametri
examples.translation: Assumono che tu abbia definito Circuit appropriati … se il tuo Circuit ha tre parametri
examples.why: Glossary leak: 'circuit' is left as the capitalized English class-like token 'Circuit' in exactly these two spots, while the rest of the file correctly uses 'circuito' (lines 22, 94, 148, 170). Within-file inconsistency for a core domain term; the capitalization also falsely suggests a Qiskit class name rather than the generic noun.

examples.source: A single randomization (the default when `shape` is omitted) applies random gates but typically offers no advantage
examples.suggested: … applica gate casuali ma in genere non offre alcun vantaggio
examples.translation: Una singola randomizzazione (il valore predefinito quando `shape` è omesso) applica Gate casuali ma tipicamente non offre alcun vantaggio
examples.why: 'Gate' is capitalized mid-sentence as if a proper noun, whereas line 170 correctly writes lowercase 'il twirling dei gate'. Same term, two renderings within the file.

examples.source: Note that `shape` can contain size-1 dimensions that expand to match input dimensions
examples.suggested: Nota che `shape` può contenere assi di dimensione unitaria che si espandono fino a corrispondere alle dimensioni dell'input
examples.translation: Nota che `shape` può contenere dimensioni di dimensione 1 che si espandono per corrispondere alle dimensioni di input
examples.why: 'dimensioni di dimensione 1' is a tautological calque no Italian technical writer would produce; note the same concept is rendered as 'assi di dimensione 1' at lines 243 and 311, so the file is also internally inconsistent here.

examples.source: but with only a single random realization you don't benefit from averaging over multiple randomizations
examples.suggested: ma con una sola realizzazione casuale non trai vantaggio dalla media su più randomizzazioni
examples.translation: ma con una sola realizzazione casuale non benefici della media su più randomizzazioni
examples.why: 'non benefici della media' is grammatical but stiff, calqued word-for-word from 'you don't benefit from averaging'; 'trarre vantaggio da' is the idiomatic construction in Italian technical prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; "base primitives" → "기본 Primitive", "increase circuit reusability" → "재사용성을 높입니다", and the Next-steps list all track the English exactly, and the 합니다체/~하세요 register matches the rest of the ko corpus. The one real defect is that "circuit" is never translated: the file writes "Circuit-Observable 쌍" (twice), "매개변수화된 Circuit 실행" (H2), "Circuit 재사용성", and "QPU에서 Circuit 성능" — five English-capitalized leaks, while translation/glossary/ko.json explicitly sets circuit → preferred "회로" and lists "Circuit"/"Circuits" under leaked_en. Korean quantum writing universally uses 양자 회로, so a native editor would rewrite all five to 회로 (e.g. "회로-관측가능량 쌍", "매개변수화된 회로 실행"). Secondarily, "Observable" is also left in English inside "Circuit-Observable 쌍" where 관측가능량 is the conventional Korean term. Neither can mislead a learner — both are recognizable — but both are house-glossary violations, not defensible style choices.

examples.source: Use Estimator to determine the expectation value of a single circuit-observable pair.
examples.suggested: Estimator를 사용하여 단일 회로-관측가능량 쌍의 기댓값을 구합니다.
examples.translation: Estimator를 사용하여 단일 Circuit-Observable 쌍의 기댓값을 구합니다.
examples.why: translation/glossary/ko.json sets circuit → "회로" as preferred and flags bare "Circuit" as leaked_en; 회로 and 관측가능량 are the standard Korean domain terms, and the file never uses either.

examples.source: ## Run parameterized circuits / ... to increase circuit reusability.
examples.suggested: ## 매개변수화된 회로 실행 ... 매개변수 값을 활용하여 회로 재사용성을 높입니다.
examples.translation: ## 매개변수화된 Circuit 실행 ... 매개변수 값을 활용하여 Circuit 재사용성을 높입니다.
examples.why: Same glossary leak reaches an H2 heading, where an untranslated English noun inside otherwise-Korean prose is most visible to the reader.

examples.source: Explore the batch execution mode and advanced options to optimize circuit performance on QPUs.
examples.suggested: 배치 [실행 모드](/guides/execution-modes)와 고급 옵션을 살펴보고 QPU에서 회로 성능을 최적화해 보세요.
examples.translation: 배치 [실행 모드](/guides/execution-modes)와 고급 옵션을 탐색하여 QPU에서 Circuit 성능을 최적화합니다.
examples.why: "Circuit 성능" mixes scripts mid-compound where 회로 성능 is idiomatic; the English is an invitation to explore, so a ~해 보세요 ending matches the surrounding section intros better than the flat declarative.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, the math/setup sentences (좌 코셋 정의, $N(N+1)/2$개의 고유 항목, 샷 노이즈를 제외하면 정확하며) all track the English, and 준확률 분포 / 충실도 / 특성 맵 / 프리미티브 are the right domain terms. The real defect is a glossary leak: "circuit" is left as bare English "Circuit" 15 times in Korean prose ("양자 Circuit을 통해 수행되며", "추상 Circuit", "오버랩 Circuit") with 회로 used zero times, although `translation/glossary/ko.json` sets circuit→회로 and lists "Circuit" explicitly as leaked_en; "Backend" is likewise untranslated twice ("특정 Backend에 최적화되지 않은") where 백엔드 is the field's normal Korean, and qubit is cased inconsistently — "Qubit에 대해" once vs "7 qubit"/"2 qubit 게이트" elsewhere, against the glossary's keep_lowercase rule. Second inconsistency: "group" is split between 그룹 and 군 within adjacent sentences — "그룹과 부분군으로 형성된 두 코셋", "그룹 구조" vs 부분군 / 군론 / 특수 유니타리 군 — where a Korean mathematician would keep 군 throughout. Finally two stiff spots: line ~205 "…위치(행 15, 열 20)에 값을 채워 커널 행렬을 채웁니다" repeats 채우다 twice in one clause, and line ~218 "데모를 짧게 유지하고 깔끔한 비교를 위해" is grammatically non-parallel (verb phrase + noun phrase joined by -고). Register (합니다체) is within the project's stated "polite (합니다/해요), not overly formal" allowance, so I am not counting it as a defect.

examples.source: In the case of quantum kernels, feature mapping is performed by a quantum circuit, and the kernel is estimated using the measurement probabilities sampled from the circuit.
examples.suggested: 양자 커널의 경우, 특성 매핑은 양자 회로를 통해 수행되며 커널은 회로에서 샘플링된 측정 확률을 사용하여 추정됩니다.
examples.translation: 양자 커널의 경우, 특성 매핑은 양자 Circuit을 통해 수행되며 커널은 Circuit에서 샘플링된 측정 확률을 사용하여 추정됩니다.
examples.why: Bare English "Circuit" inside Korean prose (15×, 회로 0×) is exactly the leak the project glossary defines: ko.json maps circuit→회로 and lists "Circuit"/"Circuits" under leaked_en. 회로 is the standard Korean term; the English noun with a Korean particle reads as untranslated MT.

examples.source: The group is taken to be $G = SU(2)^{\otimes n}$ for qubits … Input: Abstract circuit, not optimized for a particular backend.
examples.suggested: 군은 qubit에 대해 $G = SU(2)^{\otimes n}$으로 두며 … 입력: 특정 백엔드에 최적화되지 않은 추상 회로.
examples.translation: 그룹은 Qubit에 대해 $G = SU(2)^{\otimes n}$으로 취하며 … 입력: 특정 Backend에 최적화되지 않은 추상 Circuit.
examples.why: "Qubit" is capitalized here but lowercase "qubit" at lines 116/218 (glossary keep_lowercase), and "Backend" is left in English twice where 백엔드 is the conventional Korean. Same-file casing/term inconsistency.

examples.source: The input training dataset contains a group structure, consisting of two cosets formed by a group and subgroup. The group is taken to be … the special unitary group …
examples.suggested: 입력 훈련 데이터셋에는 군과 부분군으로 형성된 두 코셋으로 구성된 군 구조가 포함되어 있습니다. 군은 … 특수 유니타리 군으로 …
examples.translation: 입력 훈련 데이터셋에는 그룹과 부분군으로 형성된 두 코셋으로 구성된 그룹 구조가 포함되어 있습니다. 그룹은 … 특수 유니타리 군으로 …
examples.why: "group" alternates between 그룹 and 군 within the same sentence pair (그룹과 부분군, 그룹 구조 vs 부분군/유니타리 군/군론). In a group-theory passage the mathematical term 군 should be used consistently; the mix reads as two translation passes merged.

examples.source: …populate the kernel matrix in the position corresponding to the samples… / To keep the demo short and to make a clean comparison, we therefore run the same seven-qubit instance…
examples.suggested: …해당하는 위치(행 15, 열 20)에 커널 행렬 값을 채웁니다. / 데모를 짧게 유지하고 깔끔하게 비교하기 위해, 소규모 예제와 동일한 7 qubit 인스턴스를…
examples.translation: …이 특정 오버랩 Circuit이 나타내는 샘플에 해당하는 위치(행 15, 열 20)에 값을 채워 커널 행렬을 채웁니다. / 데모를 짧게 유지하고 깔끔한 비교를 위해, 소규모 예제에서와 동일한 7 qubit 인스턴스를…
examples.why: First sentence repeats 채우다 twice in one clause (채워…채웁니다), which no Korean technical writer would leave; second joins a verb phrase (짧게 유지하고) to a noun phrase (깔끔한 비교를 위해) with -고, a calque of the English "to keep… and to make…" that breaks Korean parallelism. Also the English bold emphasis on **same** is not carried over.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads: the meaning tracks the English closely, "nilai jangkaan" (expectation value), "primitif", and the PUB gloss "blok bersatu primitif" are all correct, and no condition, quantity or caveat is inverted or dropped. What a native technical editor would change is terminology hygiene. "Circuit" is left in English AND capitalized mid-sentence throughout ("Circuit kuantum", "Cipta Circuit dan boleh pantau", "Circuit dan boleh pantau perlu ditransformasi") where established Malay is "litar (kuantum)" — the capitalization reads as glossary leakage, not a decision; the same happens with "Backend" and "Transpiler". "Observable" is rendered "boleh pantau" (lit. "monitorable") consistently, recognizable but not the conventional physics rendering ("boleh cerap"/"kebolehcerapan"). "Transpile" splits three ways in one bullet list: the coined verb "mentransail", the noun "Transpil", and "Transpiler". Two calques remain: "pertukaran kos dan ketepatan" for "cost and accuracy tradeoff" and the sentence-initial "Kerana Qiskit Runtime adalah perkhidmatan terurus". Register is consistently "anda"; no "kamu" slips.

examples.source: The Estimator primitive computes the expectation values ... with respect to states prepared by quantum circuits.
examples.suggested: ... berkenaan keadaan yang disediakan oleh litar kuantum.
examples.translation: Primitif Estimator mengira nilai jangkaan untuk satu atau lebih boleh pantau berkenaan dengan keadaan yang disediakan oleh Circuit kuantum.
examples.why: 'circuit' is left untranslated and capitalized as if a proper noun, in every prose occurrence ('Circuit kuantum', 'Cipta Circuit dan boleh pantau', 'Circuit dan boleh pantau perlu ditransformasi'). Malay has the settled term 'litar'; the stray capital reads as an unresolved glossary entry rather than a deliberate keep-in-English convention. Same pattern for 'Backend' (line 55) and 'Transpiler' (line 98).

examples.source: expectation values for one or more observables
examples.suggested: nilai jangkaan untuk satu atau lebih kebolehcerapan (boleh cerap)
examples.translation: nilai jangkaan untuk satu atau lebih boleh pantau
examples.why: 'boleh pantau' is a literal 'monitorable'; the physics sense of observable in Malay uses 'cerap' (observe/measure), not 'pantau' (monitor/supervise). It is used consistently and a learner will still identify the object, so it is imperfect-but-recognizable rather than misleading.

examples.source: Learn how to transpile locally in the [Transpile] section. / Try the [Compare transpiler settings] guide.
examples.suggested: Ketahui cara melakukan transpilasi secara tempatan dalam bahagian [Transpil]. / ... tetapan transpiler.
examples.translation: Ketahui cara mentransail secara tempatan dalam bahagian [Transpil]. / Cuba panduan [Bandingkan tetapan Transpiler].
examples.why: Three renderings of one root in two consecutive bullets: the coined verb 'mentransail' (a malformed borrowing — neither 'mentranspil' nor 'transpilasi'), the noun 'Transpil', and capitalized 'Transpiler'. Within-file inconsistency; concept still identifiable.

examples.source: It also supports a `resilience_level` option that allows you to easily configure the cost and accuracy tradeoff.
examples.suggested: ... yang membolehkan anda melaraskan keseimbangan antara kos dan ketepatan dengan mudah.
examples.translation: Ia juga menyokong pilihan `resilience_level` yang membolehkan anda mengkonfigurasi pertukaran kos dan ketepatan dengan mudah.
examples.why: 'pertukaran' means an exchange/swap of one thing for another; as a rendering of 'tradeoff' it is a calque a Malay technical writer would replace with 'keseimbangan antara' or 'timbal balik antara'. Grammatical, but stiff.

examples.source: Because Qiskit Runtime is a managed service, you first need to initialize your account.
examples.suggested: Memandangkan Qiskit Runtime ialah perkhidmatan terurus, anda perlu memulakan akaun anda terlebih dahulu.
examples.translation: Kerana Qiskit Runtime adalah perkhidmatan terurus, anda perlu memulakan akaun anda terlebih dahulu.
examples.why: Sentence-initial 'Kerana' mirrors English 'Because ...' word order; native Malay prose opens a causal clause with 'Memandangkan' or 'Oleh sebab'. Also 'adalah' before a noun phrase should be 'ialah'. Translationese, not an error of meaning.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the precedence list (1–5), the twirling failure caveat, and the "semakin rendah ketepatan, semakin banyak masa QPU" note all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native editor would change: (a) the second person switches mid-file — "kamu" runs from the Admonition bullets through "Kelas pilihan `EstimatorV2` ... jika kamu menetapkan pilihan" (~L39–115) while the opening line and everything from "Kaedah Run()" onward use "anda"; (b) OOP "instance" is rendered "contoh" ("menghantar contoh kelas pilihan", "mencipta contoh kelas `EstimatorV2`"), which collides with the very next line's "Contoh:" meaning "Example:", and "instantiated" becomes "tidak perlu dipasang" ("does not need to be installed"); (c) "job" splits into "tugas" (L203) versus "kerja" (L406/698/738) inside the same file; (d) "pilihan mereka tidak sama" uses animate "mereka" for the primitives' options — a straight English calque. Also "Probabilistic error cancellation" → "pembatalan ralat berkemungkinan" reads as "possible", not "probabilistic".

examples.source: You can see the available options... / The only values you can pass to run()...
examples.suggested: Use "anda" consistently throughout (convert the ~8 "kamu" instances in L39–L115).
examples.translation: Kamu boleh melihat pilihan yang tersedia... / Satu-satunya nilai yang boleh anda hantar kepada `run()`...
examples.why: The document swaps second-person pronoun halfway through; the standard doc register is "anda" and the mixture reads as two different translators.

examples.source: you can pass in an instance of the options class ... does not need to be instantiated
examples.suggested: ...menghantar instans (tika) kelas pilihan ...; ... tidak perlu diinstansiasikan / tidak perlu dicipta sebagai instans
examples.translation: kamu boleh menghantar contoh kelas pilihan ... tidak perlu dipasang
examples.why: "contoh" means "example" and clashes with the literal "Contoh:" heading two lines later; "dipasang" means "installed/fitted", not "instantiated". Recognizable in context but not the OOP term.

examples.source: While the interface of the primitives' run() method is common across all implementations, their options are not.
examples.suggested: ...pilihannya tidak sama.
examples.translation: Walaupun antara muka kaedah `run()` primitif adalah sama merentasi semua pelaksanaan, pilihan mereka tidak sama.
examples.why: "mereka" is the animate third-person plural; a Malay technical writer would use the enclitic -nya for the options of an object. Straight calque of English "their".

examples.source: the job fails if twirling is enabled ... / Limits how long a job can run ... / cannot be used together in a single job
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of Runtime "job" ("kerja" is used 3×, so use it in L203 too).
examples.translation: tugas akan gagal jika `twirling` diaktifkan ... / Mengehadkan tempoh masa sesuatu kerja boleh berjalan ... / tidak boleh digunakan bersama dalam satu kerja
examples.why: Same runtime concept named two ways in one file; "tugas" additionally reads as a generic "task" rather than the submitted job.

examples.source: Probabilistic error cancellation mitigation options.
examples.suggested: Pilihan mitigasi pembatalan ralat probabilistik (kebarangkalian).
examples.translation: Pilihan mitigasi pembatalan ralat berkemungkinan.
examples.why: "berkemungkinan" means "possible/likely", so the phrase reads "possible error cancellation". Recoverable from the PEC acronym context, but it is not the term for probabilistic.

examples.source: Choices: List of basis gate names to unroll to
examples.suggested: Senarai nama get asas yang menjadi sasaran penguraian (untuk diurai kepadanya)
examples.translation: **Pilihan**: Senarai nama gate asas untuk diurai
examples.why: The English names the target basis the circuit is unrolled *to*; the Malay reads as if the gates themselves are the thing being decomposed, dropping the direction of the operation.

editor_note: No semantic drift: conditions, negations ("jest używany tylko wtedy, gdy `target` nie jest podany"), quantities ("co najwyżej 3 Qubity") and caveats all survive intact, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a Polish editor would change is terminology hygiene. First, "plugin" is rendered two ways in the same file: "wtyczka" in the transpiler-stage and high-level-synthesis sections, but "plugin/pluginu/pluginów" throughout the entire unitary-synthesis section (heading "Przykład: tworzenie pluginu syntezy unitarnej", "interfejs i kontrakt dla pluginów syntezy unitarnej"), and the same link is labelled "Wtyczki transpilera", "Pluginy Transpilatora" and "Wtyczki Transpilatora" at three different places. Second, a glossary leak drops undeclined capitalized English nouns into Polish prose, producing agreement errors a native would never write: "opis Circuit kwantowego realizującego tę macierz unitarną", "synteza jest wykonywana na fizycznym Circuit", "przykłady transpilacji i uruchamiania Circuit kwantowych", "informacje o docelowym Backend", "do syntezy Gate'a", "obsługiwany zestaw Gate'ów" — while the very same concepts are correctly Polonized elsewhere ("bramki bazowe", "mapa sprzężeń"). Third, "pass" alternates between "przejście" ("menedżer przejść", "wbudowanego przejścia transpilacji") and "przebieg" ("przebieg Transpilatora"), and "layout" is rendered "układ", a word Polish readers normally read as "circuit".

examples.source: unitary synthesis plugin / plugin interface / your plugin
examples.suggested: Use "wtyczka" throughout: "Przykład: tworzenie wtyczki syntezy unitarnej", "interfejs wtyczki", "twoja wtyczka".
examples.translation: plugin syntezy unitarnej / interfejs pluginu / twój plugin — while the rest of the file consistently uses "wtyczka" ("wtyczka etapu transpilera", "wtyczka syntezy wysokiego poziomu")
examples.why: The file splits one concept across two labels along a section boundary, so the unitary-synthesis section reads as if it were translated by a different hand. Recognizable, hence not misleading, but a Polish editor would unify it.

examples.source: outputs a description of a quantum circuit implementing that unitary / representing the circuit synthesized from that unitary matrix / in case the synthesis is done on the physical circuit
examples.suggested: zwraca opis obwodu kwantowego realizującego tę macierz unitarną / reprezentujący obwód zsyntetyzowany z tej macierzy unitarnej / gdy synteza jest wykonywana na obwodzie fizycznym
examples.translation: zwraca opis Circuit kwantowego realizującego tę macierz unitarną / reprezentujący Circuit zsyntetyzowany z tej macierzy unitarnej / w przypadku gdy synteza jest wykonywana na fizycznym Circuit
examples.why: An undeclined English "Circuit" is glued into Polish noun phrases, leaving the adjective ("kwantowego", "fizycznym", "kwantowych") agreeing with nothing. It is grammatically broken Polish and reads as an untreated glossary leak, not as prose a Polish engineer wrote.

examples.source: its coupling map and basis gates / to synthesize a gate / the supported gate set
examples.suggested: …do syntezy bramki … obsługiwany zestaw bramek
examples.translation: mapa sprzężeń i bramki bazowe / do syntezy Gate'a / obsługiwany zestaw Gate'ów
examples.why: "gate" is correctly Polonized as "bramka" in one paragraph and then kept as apostrophized English "Gate'a"/"Gate'ów" two paragraphs later; the apostrophe-declension of an English noun is exactly the register a Polish technical writer avoids.

examples.source: pass manager / transpilation pass / transpiler pass
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "pass" (e.g. "przebieg": "menedżer przebiegów", "przebieg transpilacji", "przebieg transpilatora") and apply it everywhere.
examples.translation: menedżer przejść / przejście transpilacji … but "przebieg Transpilatora" for "transpiler pass"
examples.why: The core transpiler noun "pass" is split between "przejście" and "przebieg" inside a single page whose whole subject is pass managers; the concept is still identifiable, but the split forces the reader to re-map it mid-article.

examples.source: A value of ``None`` indicates that the layout has not yet been chosen
examples.suggested: …że rozmieszczenie (layout) nie zostało jeszcze wybrane
examples.translation: Wartość ``None`` oznacza, że układ nie został jeszcze wybrany
examples.why: "układ" is the ordinary Polish word for a circuit, and this very file leaves "circuit" untranslated as "Circuit" — so the one place a Polish noun appears, it names the wrong concept for the reader. The stage itself is referred to as `layout` in code throughout, which makes the mismatch more visible.

examples.source: Changes to the plugin interface, such as adding additional optional inputs, will be done in a backward compatible way
examples.suggested: …takie jak dodanie kolejnych opcjonalnych danych wejściowych…
examples.translation: Zmiany w interfejsie pluginu, takie jak dodanie opcjonalnych danych wejściowych, będą wprowadzane w sposób zapewniający wsteczną kompatybilność
examples.why: "additional" is dropped, so the promise reads as "optional inputs will be added" rather than "further optional inputs will be added to the existing ones". A dropped qualifier only, meaning substantially preserved.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ty" register holds consistently ("Wystarczy, że podasz", "Uwierzytelnij się", "Zdefiniuj problem"), with good core renderings such as "hamiltonian Isinga", "Wskaźnik Sharpe'a" and "kroki czasowe". The defects are terminology-hygiene, not meaning. English glossary tokens leak in undeclined and break Polish grammar: "liczbą Qubitów w Circuit", "wymaga więcej uruchomień Circuit" and "różnych konfiguracjach Qubitów rozdzielczości, Circuit ansatzu" — "circuit" should be declined as "obwodzie/obwodów", and "qubit" is capitalized mid-sentence everywhere ("cztery Qubity rozdzielczości", "112 Qubitów") where Polish writes lowercase "kubitów/qubitów". QUBO is expanded as "kwadratowej niezwiązanej optymalizacji binarnej", where "unconstrained" should be "bez ograniczeń" ("niezwiązana" reads as "unbound/unrelated"), and the same source word "manuscript" is rendered twice differently: "opublikowanym artykule naukowym" (line 31) vs. the false-friend "manuskrypt" (line 117). One calqued sentence opener, "Jako przybliżona zasada praktyczna zaleca się...", is stiff for a native technical writer.

examples.source: a linear relationship between the population_size and the number of qubits in the circuit / requires more circuit executions / configurations of resolution qubits, ansatz circuits
examples.suggested: ...a liczbą kubitów w obwodzie / wymaga większej liczby uruchomień obwodu / konfiguracjach kubitów rozdzielczości, obwodów ansatz
examples.translation: liniową zależnością pomiędzy ``population_size`` a liczbą Qubitów w Circuit / wymaga więcej uruchomień Circuit / konfiguracjach Qubitów rozdzielczości, Circuit ansatzu
examples.why: The English noun 'circuit' is left in the Polish sentence undeclined, producing ungrammatical case agreement ('w Circuit', 'uruchomień Circuit', 'Circuit ansatzu'). Polish has a settled term (obwód/układ kwantowy); a glossary keep-English rule has leaked into running prose.

examples.source: four resolution qubits, resulting in a total requirement of 112 qubits
examples.suggested: cztery kubity rozdzielczości, co w sumie wymaga 112 kubitów
examples.translation: cztery Qubity rozdzielczości, co w sumie wymaga 112 Qubitów
examples.why: 'Qubit' is capitalized mid-sentence throughout (Qubity, Qubitów, Qubitami, table header 'Qubity'). Polish is not a noun-capitalizing language; this reads as an untouched English token rather than a Polish common noun.

examples.source: a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem
examples.suggested: problemu kwadratowej optymalizacji binarnej bez ograniczeń (QUBO)
examples.translation: problemu kwadratowej niezwiązanej optymalizacji binarnej (QUBO)
examples.why: 'Unconstrained' is rendered as 'niezwiązanej' ('unbound', 'unrelated'), not the optimization sense 'bez ograniczeń'. The acronym keeps the concept identifiable, so it misleads only mildly, but it is not the conventional Polish expansion.

examples.source: published manuscript … (see the manuscript)
examples.suggested: use "artykuł" (or "praca") in both places
examples.translation: opublikowanym artykule naukowym … (zob. [manuskrypt])
examples.why: The same source word is rendered two ways in one file, and the second rendering 'manuskrypt' is a false friend: in Polish it denotes an old handwritten codex, not a preprint/paper.

examples.source: As an approximated rule of thumb, it is recommended to use a minimum population_size ~ 0.8 * n_qubits
examples.suggested: W przybliżeniu, jako regułę kciuka, zaleca się przyjmowanie minimalnego ``population_size ~ 0.8 * n_qubits``
examples.translation: Jako przybliżona zasada praktyczna zaleca się stosowanie **minimalnego** ``population_size ~ 0.8 * n_qubits``
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of the English adverbial opener; the nominative 'Jako przybliżona zasada praktyczna' does not agree with anything in the clause and a Polish technical writer would recast it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities — and the terminology convention is consistent and defensible (gates, qubits, jobs, benchmarking, crosstalk kept in English; "leitura" for readout, "deriva" for drift, "sistemas de dois níveis (TLS)"), with informal "você" held in both places it appears. The one real terminology defect is "quantum limited amplifiers" → "amplificadores quânticos limitados", which reattaches the modifier and reads as "limited quantum amplifiers"; the field term is "amplificadores limitados pelo ruído quântico / limitados quanticamente". Beyond that, three stiffness/calque spots a native technical editor would rewrite: the tautological "em grupos agrupados" for "in batched groups", the anglicism "pode experimentar estabilidade efetiva reduzida" for "may experience reduced effective stability", and the stranded "possível" in "permaneça o mais estável, previsível e disponível para os usuários possível". Also note "sx, x, rx (fracionais)" pluralizes a qualifier the English attaches only to rx.

examples.source: This includes the operational parameters of our quantum limited amplifiers.
examples.suggested: Isso inclui os parâmetros operacionais de nossos amplificadores limitados pelo ruído quântico.
examples.translation: Isso inclui os parâmetros operacionais de nossos amplificadores quânticos limitados.
examples.why: "quantum limited" is a single compound modifier (amplifier operating at the quantum noise limit). Splitting it into "amplificadores quânticos limitados" reads as "limited quantum amplifiers", a different and non-existent category.

examples.source: Randomized benchmarking (RB) in batched groups
examples.suggested: Randomized benchmarking (RB) executado em lotes
examples.translation: Randomized benchmarking (RB) em grupos agrupados
examples.why: "grupos agrupados" is a tautology no Portuguese technical writer would produce; "batched" is already carried by "lotes", which the file itself uses correctly at line 48 ("em lotes de qubits").

examples.source: the quantum computer may experience reduced effective stability due to delayed or infrequent recalibration
examples.suggested: o computador quântico pode apresentar estabilidade efetiva reduzida devido a recalibrações atrasadas ou pouco frequentes
examples.translation: o computador quântico pode experimentar estabilidade efetiva reduzida devido a recalibração atrasada ou pouco frequente
examples.why: "experimentar" for "to experience" is a classic English calque; in Portuguese a device "apresenta" or "sofre" reduced stability. The plural on "recalibrações" also reads more naturally.

examples.source: the single-qubit gates: sx, x, rx (fractional)
examples.suggested: os gates de qubit único: sx, x, rx (fracional)
examples.translation: os gates de qubit único: sx, x, rx (fracionais)
examples.why: The English parenthetical qualifies only rx; the Portuguese plural "(fracionais)" can be read as labelling all three gates fractional, which sx and x are not.

editor_note: Accurate and readable overall — informal "você" is consistent throughout, packaging vocabulary is stable and correct ("ambiente virtual", "fixação"/"fixar" for pin, "candidato a lançamento" for release candidate, "grafo de dependências", "dependências transitivas"), and the tricky Troubleshooting reasoning survives intact. Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) A tense/claim shift: EN "A Qiskit v1.0 release candidate, version 1.0.0rc1, will be released on 1 February 2024" becomes "foi lançado em 1º de fevereiro de 2024" — the source's forward-looking statement is asserted as accomplished fact; harmless today, but it is not what the English says and it sits oddly next to the following sentence's "Você deve testar seu pacote em relação a ele". (2) Scattered translationese in the explanatory notes: "não era conhecido que ela suportava o Qiskit v1.0 ainda" is a word-order calque of "it was not known to support…"; "(mais preferível para menos)" reproduces "(most preferable to least)" literally; "ao tentar `import`ar um módulo" welds a Portuguese verb ending onto the English keyword; "um de seus repositórios com checkout" calques "checked out repositories". Also "Você pode incluir pacotes adicionais" silently drops the EN "optionally", and "todos os pacotes que você precisa" needs the regency "de que você precisa". None of these mislead a learner.

examples.source: A Qiskit v1.0 release candidate, version 1.0.0rc1, will be released on 1 February 2024.
examples.suggested: Um candidato a lançamento do Qiskit v1.0, versão 1.0.0rc1, será lançado em 1º de fevereiro de 2024.
examples.translation: Um candidato a lançamento do Qiskit v1.0, versão 1.0.0rc1, foi lançado em 1º de fevereiro de 2024.
examples.why: Future tense turned into a completed past event. The claim is no longer what the source makes, and it clashes with the next sentence's forward-looking advice to test against it as soon as possible.

examples.source: it was not known to support Qiskit v1.0 yet, so it marked that in its requirements
examples.suggested: ainda não se sabia se ela era compatível com o Qiskit v1.0, então ela declarou isso em seus requisitos
examples.translation: não era conhecido que ela suportava o Qiskit v1.0 ainda, então marcou isso em seus requisitos
examples.why: Direct calque of the English passive plus a stranded 'ainda' at the end of the clause; no Portuguese technical writer would order it this way. The dropped subject in 'então marcou' also reads as an unfinished sentence.

examples.source: in approximate order of preference (most preferable to least)
examples.suggested: em ordem aproximada de preferência (da mais recomendada para a menos recomendada)
examples.translation: em ordem aproximada de preferência (mais preferível para menos)
examples.why: Word-for-word rendering of an English elliptical construction that does not survive in Portuguese; the parenthetical as written is nearly meaningless without mentally restoring the English.

examples.source: when trying to `import` a module
examples.suggested: ao tentar importar um módulo
examples.translation: ao tentar `import`ar um módulo
examples.why: Splicing a Portuguese verb ending onto an inline-code English keyword produces a token that is neither valid Python nor idiomatic Portuguese, and it renders as `import`ar on the page.

examples.source: You can optionally include additional packages by including them as arguments.
examples.suggested: Opcionalmente, você pode incluir pacotes adicionais passando-os como argumentos.
examples.translation: Você pode incluir pacotes adicionais como argumentos.
examples.why: The explicit 'optionally' qualifier is dropped. 'Pode' carries most of it, but in a step-by-step install procedure the English deliberately signals that this step is skippable.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities; core terminology is correct and consistent (stare fundamentală, funcție de undă, subspațiu, valoare proprie/vector propriu, Hamiltonian, configurații electronice, eșantionate, shot-uri kept in English). What a native editor would change is cosmetic-but-visible glossary/typo residue: "circuit" and "qubit" are sporadically capitalized mid-sentence and the article is hyphenated in the German/English manner — "un Circuit cuantic", "Circuit-ul este apoi executat", "parametrii Circuit-ului cuantic", "mai mulți Qubiți" — while the same words appear correctly lowercase as "trei opțiuni de circuit cuantic" and "pentru fiecare circuit cuantic" two lines away. Line 65 is the only place in the file where diacritics are dropped ("subspatiului", "control computational"), a plain spelling error against the file's own "subspațiului"/"computațional". Also "adecvabilității sale generale" is a coinage (Romanian has "adecvării"/"potrivirii"), "dacă ceva merge greșit" is a calque of "if something goes wrong", and "workload" is rendered two ways ("workload-ul tău Qiskit Function" line 163 vs "sarcina ta de lucru" line 279). Informal "tu" holds everywhere ("Consultă", "autentifică-te", "Te rog să reții", "poți căuta"), no dumneavoastră.

examples.source: The circuit is then executed on a quantum device … the quantum circuit does not need to approximate the full ground state … the quantum circuit parameters are updated
examples.suggested: Circuitul este apoi executat … circuitul cuantic nu trebuie … parametrii circuitului cuantic
examples.translation: Circuit-ul este apoi executat pe un dispozitiv cuantic … Circuit-ul cuantic nu trebuie să aproximeze întreaga stare fundamentală … parametrii Circuit-ului cuantic sunt actualizați
examples.why: Glossary-leak artifact: mid-sentence capital C plus a hyphen between a native Romanian noun and its enclitic article ("Circuit-ul"), which is not Romanian orthography. The same word appears correctly as lowercase "circuit cuantic" in the same paragraphs, so the file contradicts itself. Same pattern on "mai mulți Qubiți" (line 73) vs lowercase "qubiți" everywhere else.

examples.source: Its unique subspace construction techniques help make configuration selection more efficient, so that users have greater computational control
examples.suggested: …de construire a subspațiului … un control computațional mai mare
examples.translation: Tehnicile sale unice de construire a subspatiului ajută la eficientizarea selecției configurațiilor, astfel încât utilizatorii să aibă un control computational mai mare
examples.why: Two missing diacritics in one sentence — "subspatiului" and "computational" — and this is the only line in the file where they are dropped (every other occurrence is "subspațiu"/"computațional"), so it reads as an uncorrected typo rather than a convention.

examples.source: The optimization is initialized close to the Hartree-Fock reference state due to its general suitability.
examples.suggested: …datorită adecvării sale generale / pentru că este în general potrivită.
examples.translation: Optimizarea este inițializată aproape de starea de referință Hartree-Fock datorită adecvabilității sale generale.
examples.why: "Adecvabilitate" is not a Romanian word; it is a mechanical -ability→-abilitate coinage from "suitability". A native technical writer would use "adecvare" or rephrase. Meaning still recoverable, hence minor.

examples.source: It is a good idea to print the Function job ID so that it can be provided in support requests if something goes wrong.
examples.suggested: …dacă ceva nu merge bine / dacă apare o problemă.
examples.translation: Este o idee bună să afișezi ID-ul jobului funcției, astfel încât să poată fi furnizat în solicitările de suport dacă ceva merge greșit.
examples.why: "Merge greșit" is a word-for-word calque of "goes wrong"; Romanian says "nu merge bine" or "apare o problemă". Grammatical but audibly translated.

examples.source: HI-VQE has been utilized to estimate the accurate potential energy surface curve of the intermolecular interaction between FeP and NO
examples.suggested: …pentru a estima cu acuratețe curba suprafeței de energie potențială…
examples.translation: HI-VQE a fost utilizat pentru a estima curba exactă a suprafeței de energie potențială a interacțiunii intermoleculare dintre FeP și NO
examples.why: "Accurate" becomes "exactă" (exact), which slightly overstates the claim — and the same file uses "exact/exactă" as the technical opposite of approximate ("soluția exactă", "Dimensiunea exactă a matricei", "E(diff) față de exact"), so the word collides with an established sense here. Not misleading enough to change what a learner concludes, but a native editor would use "acuratețe", the word used for "chemical accuracy" elsewhere in the same paragraph.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the tensor/expand subsystem indexing, `A.compose(B)` = B·A vs `front=True` = A·B, the "linear combinations do not preserve unitarity" point and the final CP caveat on process fidelity are all rendered correctly, so nothing misleads. What a native editor would fix is surface: three headings are left half- or fully-English ("## Combine Operators" untranslated, "Conversie implicită la Operators", "Compară Operators"); the first prose paragraph (line 53) carries glossary-leak artifacts with mid-sentence capitalized English nouns ("un Circuit cuantic", "Dacă Circuit-ul conține", "descompunere în Gate-uri", section title "Utilizarea Operatorilor în Circuit-uri") where plain "circuit(e)"/"porți" is the normal Romanian; and there are two outright grammatical slips a native would never write — "un poartă" (poartă is feminine → "o poartă", line 53), the invented plural "poartă-uri Pauli" (line 141, correct plural is "porți"), and "doi canale cuantice" (canal is neuter → "două canale", line 354). Register also splits: informal "Reține"/"poți"/"Explorează" in some paragraphs vs the polite-plural "Rețineți" in most others (166, 184, 232, 234, 317, 342, 370).

examples.source: If the circuit contains any unsupported operations, an exception is raised. Unsupported operations are: measure, reset, conditional operations, or a gate that does not have a matrix definition or decomposition in terms of gate with matrix definitions.
examples.suggested: Dacă circuitul conține operații nesuportate, se ridică o excepție. Operațiile nesuportate sunt: measure, reset, operații condiționale sau o poartă care nu are o definiție matriceală ori o descompunere în porți cu definiții matriceale.
examples.translation: Dacă Circuit-ul conține operații nesuportate, se ridică o excepție. Operațiile nesuportate sunt: measure, reset, operații condiționale sau un poartă care nu are o definiție de matrice sau o descompunere în Gate-uri cu definiții de matrice.
examples.why: Glossary leak leaves common nouns capitalized in English mid-sentence ("Circuit-ul", "Gate-uri", and "un Backend simulator" earlier in the same paragraph), and "un poartă" is a gender error — poartă is feminine. Recognizable, so not misleading, but no Romanian technical writer would produce this line.

examples.source: will be converted into a sequence of single-qubit Pauli gates
examples.suggested: va fi convertit într-o secvență de porți Pauli pe un singur qubit
examples.translation: va fi convertit într-o secvență de poartă-uri Pauli cu un singur qubit
examples.why: "poartă-uri" is a non-existent hybrid plural formed by bolting the English "-s"-style suffix onto the Romanian singular; the plural of poartă is porți. The same paragraph's heading uses "Circuit-uri" for circuite.

examples.source: Note that the last point means you can use… / Note that if both A and B are single-qubit operators…
examples.suggested: Reține că… (consistently, throughout)
examples.translation: Reține că ultimul punct înseamnă că poți folosi… / Rețineți că, dacă atât A cât și B sunt operatori pe un singur qubit…
examples.why: The file alternates between the informal "tu" convention (Reține, poți, Explorează, folosești) and the polite-plural "Rețineți" used in most later paragraphs (166, 184, 232, 234, 317, 342, 370). Within-file register split, not misleading.

examples.source: This is an information-theoretic quantity for how close two quantum channels are to each other
examples.suggested: Aceasta este o mărime din teoria informației care măsoară cât de apropiate sunt două canale cuantice unul de celălalt
examples.translation: Aceasta este o cantitate din teoria informației care măsoară cât de apropiați sunt doi canale cuantice unul de celălalt
examples.why: Agreement error: canal is neuter, so "două canale … apropiate", not "doi canale … apropiați". Also "mărime" is the standard Romanian term for a physical/information-theoretic quantity; "cantitate" is a literal calque of "quantity".

examples.source: ## Combine Operators / ### Implicit conversion to Operators / ## Compare Operators
examples.suggested: ## Combinarea operatorilor / ### Conversie implicită la operatori / ## Compararea operatorilor
examples.translation: ## Combine Operators / ### Conversie implicită la Operators / ## Compară Operators
examples.why: One heading was left entirely in English and two retain the English plural "Operators" as if it were the class name (the class is `Operator`, singular — here it is plain prose). Every other heading in the file is properly translated, so this is an internal inconsistency the reader will notice.

examples.source: Hence, for two operators A and B you have A.expand(B) = B⊗A
examples.suggested: Astfel, pentru doi operatori $A$ și $B$, avem `A.expand(B)` = $B\otimes A$
examples.translation: Astfel, pentru doi operatori $A$ și $B$ ai `A.expand(B)` = $B\otimes A$
examples.why: Bare "ai" as a calque of English existential "you have" is not idiomatic Romanian in a mathematical statement; "avem"/"obții" is what a native technical writer uses. Meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the negations and caveats all survive intact (e.g. "ตัวเลือกทั้งหมดยกเว้น shots จะถูกละเว้นเมื่อรันบน local simulator", the caution "จำลองได้เฉพาะบางส่วนเท่านั้น ดังนั้นจึงมีแนวโน้มว่าจะรุนแรงน้อยกว่า noise บน QPU จริง", and the `"unitary"`/`"superop"` measurement/reset restrictions), and the heavy keep-in-English convention (backend, circuit, noise model, shots, transpile, Sampler/Estimator) is the right one for Thai Qiskit docs. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) the comparative in "higher-performance simulation" is flattened to a plain absolute "ให้การ simulation ประสิทธิภาพสูง" — the Aer-vs-fake-backend contrast that motivates the bullet disappears; (2) line 135 loses the sentence boundary and reads as a stuttering "…และส่งไปยัง Aer Aer จะสร้าง noise model…", which a Thai writer would break with a period or ซึ่ง/โดย; (3) English terms are cased inconsistently within the file — "Backend"/"backends", "Circuit"/"circuits", "Session"/"sessions" — so the same token looks like two different things; (4) small dropped qualifiers/stiffness, e.g. "specify one of the fake backends" → bare "ระบุ fake backends", and "transpile locally in the Transpile section" → the clumsy double-ใน "transpile ในเครื่องในส่วน [Transpile]". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Simulators from Qiskit Aer provide higher-performance simulation that can handle larger circuits and custom noise models.
examples.suggested: Simulators จาก Qiskit Aer ให้การ simulation ที่มีประสิทธิภาพสูงกว่า รองรับ circuits ที่ใหญ่กว่าและ custom noise models
examples.translation: Simulators จาก Qiskit Aer ให้การ simulation ประสิทธิภาพสูงที่รองรับ circuits ขนาดใหญ่และ custom noise models
examples.why: "higher-performance" and "larger" are comparatives against the fake backends described in the previous bullet; rendered as plain absolutes (ประสิทธิภาพสูง / ขนาดใหญ่) the reason to prefer Aer over a fake backend is lost. Qualifier softening, not a false statement.

examples.source: …specify a QPU (quantum hardware) and submit it to Aer.  Aer builds a noise model based on the calibration data from that QPU…
examples.suggested: …ให้ระบุ QPU (ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม) แล้วส่งไปยัง Aer ซึ่ง Aer จะสร้าง noise model จากข้อมูล calibration ของ QPU นั้น…
examples.translation: …ให้ระบุ QPU (ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม) และส่งไปยัง Aer Aer จะสร้าง noise model จากข้อมูล calibration ของ QPU นั้น…
examples.why: Thai has no sentence period here, so the English sentence break collapses into a stuttering "Aer Aer". A Thai technical writer would join with ซึ่ง/โดย or start the new clause with จากนั้น. Same run-on pattern in the note bullet at line 74 ("`pip install qiskit-aer` fake backends ใช้ Aer simulators เบื้องหลังหากมี…").

examples.source: backend / circuit / session
examples.suggested: Pick one casing per term across the file — lowercase backend, circuit, session throughout, matching the code and the API names.
examples.translation: "ชื่อ Backend" and "Qiskit Aer Backend" vs "fake backends"; "ตาม Circuit และ noise model" and "ที่ท้าย Circuit" vs "circuits ขนาดใหญ่"; "หรือ Session" vs "ตัวอย่างกับ sessions"
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency in how the same kept-English term is written. Recognizable either way, so not misleading, but it reads as two passes merged rather than one authored document.

examples.source: specify one of the fake backends from qiskit_ibm_runtime.fake_provider … Learn how to transpile locally in the Transpile section.
examples.suggested: ให้ระบุ fake backend ตัวใดตัวหนึ่งจาก ``qiskit_ibm_runtime.fake_provider`` … เรียนรู้วิธี transpile บนเครื่องตัวเอง ได้ที่ส่วน [Transpile]
examples.translation: ให้ระบุ fake backends จาก ``qiskit_ibm_runtime.fake_provider`` … เรียนรู้วิธี transpile ในเครื่องในส่วน [Transpile]
examples.why: "one of the" is dropped, so the plural reads as if several must be given; and "ในเครื่องในส่วน" stacks two ใน- phrases in a row, which a native writer would break up. Both are stiffness/dropped-qualifier level, not meaning errors.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the domain vocabulary is sound and consistent (quantum circuit, Bell state, Qubit, entangled/entangle, histogram all kept in English, as Thai quantum writing normally does; register is casual with no ครับ/ค่ะ). Four things a native technical editor would still change. (1) "This result is a signature of quantum entanglement" is rendered "ผลลัพธ์นี้เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของ quantum entanglement" — สัญลักษณ์ means "symbol/emblem", not "hallmark/telltale sign"; ลักษณะเฉพาะ or เครื่องบ่งชี้ is the right word and keeps the teaching point (the 00/11-only split IS the evidence of entanglement). (2) In the PyPI paragraph the passive is flipped to active: "เวอร์ชัน Python ใดบ้างที่รองรับรุ่นล่าสุด" reads "which Python versions support the latest release", the reverse of "which Python versions are supported by the most recent release" — same practical set, wrong direction of support. (3) "navigate to your project directory" is calqued as "นำทางไปยังไดเรกทอรีโปรเจกต์" (นำทาง = give directions/guide someone); Thai devs write "ไปที่" or "เข้าไปที่". (4) The Next-steps link label was replaced: EN "Run your first circuit on hardware" guide became just "[Hello world]", dropping the descriptive label (target URL is unchanged).

examples.source: This result is a signature of quantum entanglement.
examples.suggested: ผลลัพธ์นี้เป็นลักษณะเฉพาะที่บ่งชี้ถึง quantum entanglement
examples.translation: ผลลัพธ์นี้เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของ quantum entanglement
examples.why: สัญลักษณ์ = symbol/emblem. "Signature" here means a characteristic hallmark that identifies the phenomenon; the Thai reads as if the histogram merely symbolizes entanglement rather than being evidence of it, flattening the punchline of the whole exercise.

examples.source: check the "Programming Language" section on the Qiskit PyPI project page to determine which Python versions are supported by the most recent release
examples.suggested: ...เพื่อดูว่ารุ่นล่าสุดรองรับ Python เวอร์ชันใดบ้าง
examples.translation: ตรวจสอบส่วน "Programming Language" ใน [หน้าโปรเจกต์ Qiskit บน PyPI] ก่อน เพื่อดูว่าเวอร์ชัน Python ใดบ้างที่รองรับรุ่นล่าสุด
examples.why: The passive is inverted into an active with the wrong subject: the Thai says the Python versions support the latest release, whereas the release is what supports the Python versions. The reader lands on the same list, so it does not mislead, but the relation is backwards.

examples.source: To set up a virtual environment, navigate to your project directory and create a minimal environment...
examples.suggested: ในการสร้าง virtual environment ให้เข้าไปที่ไดเรกทอรีโปรเจกต์ของคุณ แล้วสร้าง...
examples.translation: ในการสร้าง virtual environment ให้นำทางไปยังไดเรกทอรีโปรเจกต์ของคุณ แล้วสร้างสภาพแวดล้อมขั้นต่ำ...
examples.why: นำทาง is "to guide/lead someone"; used for a cd into a directory it is a direct calque of English "navigate to" that no Thai developer writes.

examples.source: Follow the steps in the [Run your first circuit on hardware](/guides/hello-world) guide to run a circuit on real quantum hardware.
examples.suggested: ทำตามขั้นตอนในคู่มือ [รันวงจรแรกของคุณบนฮาร์ดแวร์](/guides/hello-world) เพื่อรัน Circuit บน quantum hardware จริง
examples.translation: ทำตามขั้นตอนใน [Hello world](/guides/hello-world) เพื่อรัน Circuit บน quantum hardware จริง
examples.why: The descriptive link label from the source was swapped for the bare page name and the word "guide" dropped, so the reader loses the cue about what that page teaches. URL and destination are unchanged, so nothing breaks.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats (e.g. "Tandaan na ang mga user ng Open Plan ay hindi makakapagsumite ng mga session job" correctly preserves the negation, and the PUB explanation "Ang bawat PUB ay isang tuple na naglalaman ng isang circuit at ng data na ibino-broadcast sa circuit na iyon" matches the English). Domain terms are kept in English per the field convention and used consistently (circuit, observable, expectation value, primitive, transpile → "mag-transpile", error mitigation), and the register is correctly informal ("iyong", "mo", no po/opo). Two things a native technical editor would still change: "backend" is capitalized mid-sentence as "mga available na Backend" in both parallel passages (lines ~41 and ~282) while it appears lowercase everywhere else, and "by working through the Cost function lesson" is rendered "sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng [Cost function lesson]", which reads as "by creating the lesson" rather than working through it.

examples.source: view available backends
examples.suggested: tingnan ang mga available na backend
examples.translation: tingnan ang mga available na Backend
examples.why: "Backend" is capitalized mid-sentence in both occurrences while the term is lowercase in every other context in the file (and in code); the inconsistent capitalization makes it look like a proper noun or product name rather than the generic device/backend.

examples.source: Practice with primitives by working through the Cost function lesson
examples.suggested: Magsanay gamit ang mga primitive sa pamamagitan ng pagdaan sa [Cost function lesson]
examples.translation: Magsanay gamit ang mga primitive sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng [Cost function lesson]
examples.why: "paggawa ng" literally means "making/creating", so the sentence reads as if the learner should create the lesson; "pagdaan sa" or "pag-aaral ng" carries the English "working through" sense a native technical writer would use.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads: every conditional, quantity and outcome tracks the English (if→1/X gate→"dapat na 0 na may 100% na posibilidad"; switch 0→X, 1→Z→"dapat na 1"; case(0b000,0b011)→Z, 0b001→Y, DEFAULT→X; "isa lamang sa mga block ang isinasagawa. Walang fallthrough"), and register is correctly casual (kami/namin, no po/opo). What a native technical editor would change: the programming sense of "method" is over-translated and split — "ipinapatupad bilang isang **paraan** sa `QuantumCircuit`" then "Ang bawat isa sa mga **pamamaraang** ito"; Tagalog Qiskit prose keeps "method". "Exploratory representation" becomes the non-idiomatic calque "eksplorasyon na representasyon", and "Such expressions can be built up" becomes "maaaring **itayo**" (itayo = erect a structure; buuin is the natural verb). The parity paragraph adds a clause the English does not have ("— ibig sabihin, katumbas ng 1"), which is factually right but unsourced, and the same sentence has a grammar slip ("Pagkatapos ay **susukat ng** mga target qubit" instead of "susukatin mo ang"). "In addition to conditioning on a **single** classical bit" also loses "single".

examples.source: each implemented as a method on QuantumCircuit … Each of these methods returns a context manager
examples.suggested: bawat isa ay ipinapatupad bilang method sa QuantumCircuit … Ang bawat isa sa mga method na ito ay nagbabalik
examples.translation: bawat isa ay ipinapatupad bilang isang paraan sa QuantumCircuit … Ang bawat isa sa mga pamamaraang ito ay nagbabalik
examples.why: Programming 'method' is kept in English in Tagalog technical writing; 'paraan'/'pamamaraan' reads as generic 'way' and is additionally split into two renderings within the same passage.

examples.source: contains an exploratory representation of runtime operations on classical values
examples.suggested: naglalaman ng isang eksperimental (exploratory) na representasyon ng mga runtime operation sa mga classical value
examples.translation: naglalaman ng eksplorasyon na representasyon ng mga runtime operation sa mga classical value
examples.why: 'eksplorasyon na representasyon' is a direct calque; a noun cannot modify a noun this way in natural Tagalog, so the phrase reads as machine output.

examples.source: You apply X to every unmeasured site for which the parity of all preceding bits is odd.
examples.suggested: Mag-aaplay ka ng X sa bawat hindi nasukat na site kung saan gansal (odd) ang parity ng lahat ng naunang bit.
examples.translation: Mag-aaplay ka ng X sa bawat hindi nasukat na site kung saan gansal (odd) ang parity ng lahat ng naunang bit — ibig sabihin, katumbas ng 1.
examples.why: The trailing gloss is not in the English. It happens to be correct (odd parity = 1), but it is content injected by the translator rather than translated content.

examples.source: You then measure the target qubit of all prior CNOT gates and reset each measured qubit to the state |0>.
examples.suggested: Pagkatapos ay susukatin mo ang mga target qubit ng lahat ng naunang CNOT gate at iri-reset ang bawat nasukat na qubit sa estado |0>.
examples.translation: Pagkatapos ay susukat ng mga target qubit ng lahat ng naunang CNOT gate at iri-reset ang bawat nasukat na qubit sa estado |0>.
examples.why: 'susukat ng' leaves the sentence without an actor and mis-marks the object; the surrounding sentences use the 'mag-aaplay ka' second-person frame, so the focus shift is a grammar slip, not a stylistic choice.

examples.source: In addition to conditioning on a single classical bit, it's also possible to condition on the value of a classical register composed of multiple bits.
examples.suggested: Bukod sa pag-condition sa iisang classical bit lamang, posible rin ang pag-condition sa halaga ng isang classical register na binubuo ng maraming bit.
examples.translation: Bukod sa pag-condition sa isang classical bit, posible rin ang pag-condition sa halaga ng isang classical register na binubuo ng maraming bit.
examples.why: 'single' carries the contrast with the multi-bit register that follows; 'isang' alone reads as the indefinite article and flattens the one-vs-many point the sentence is making.

editor_note: No semantic drift — every claim, caveat and quantity (50 qubits ceiling, 15 May 2024 retirement, "sessions supported but ignored", Open Plan restriction, 0.22.0+) matches the English, and the informal "ти" convention holds throughout ("вкажи", "дивись", "Використовуй", "твоя робота"). The real defect is glossary leakage plus inconsistency: "circuit" is rendered as Ukrainian "схема" in some places ("Схеми Кліффорда", "більші схеми", "стабілізаторних схем") and as bare capitalized English "Circuit" in others ("реалізацій Circuit", "Circuit Кліффорда", "Розмір Circuit", "стабілізаторні Circuit") — sometimes inside the same table row ("**Розмір Circuit** | ... | Може обробляти більші схеми"); "Backend", "Transpiler" and "Gate" leak the same way ("базові Gate", "фейкових Backend", "поведінки конкретного QPU ... Тестування Transpiler"). "basis gates" as "базові Gate" reads as "basic gates" rather than basis gates ("базисні вентилі/гейти"). Register also drifts colloquial: "quantum hardware" is consistently "квантове залізо" — IT slang rather than the neutral "квантове обладнання/апаратне забезпечення" a documentation editor would use in teaching material — and "custom" is flattened to "довільна/довільні" ("arbitrary") in "Довільна або на основі калібрувальних даних" and "довільні моделі шуму".

examples.source: circuit implementations / Clifford circuits / Circuit size / Large stabilizer circuits
examples.suggested: реалізацій схем / схеми Кліффорда / Розмір схеми / Великі стабілізаторні схеми
examples.translation: реалізацій Circuit / Схеми Кліффорда / Розмір Circuit / Великі стабілізаторні Circuit
examples.why: "circuit" is split between Ukrainian "схема" and untranslated capitalized "Circuit" within the same file — even within one table row ("Розмір Circuit" vs "Може обробляти більші схеми"). Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native editor would unify on one rendering.

examples.source: The snapshots contain important information about the QPU, such as the coupling map, basis gates, and qubit properties
examples.suggested: …карту зв'язності, базисні вентилі та властивості кубітів
examples.translation: Знімки містять важливу інформацію про QPU: карту зв'язків, базові Gate та властивості кубітів
examples.why: "basis gates" becomes "базові Gate" — "базові" means basic/fundamental, not "basis"; combined with the untranslated "Gate" it reads as a leak rather than a term. The conventional rendering is "базисні вентилі" (or "базисні гейти").

examples.source: quantum hardware / requires actual hardware
examples.suggested: квантове обладнання / потребує реального обладнання
examples.translation: квантове залізо / потребує реального заліза
examples.why: "залізо" is Ukrainian IT slang for hardware. It is consistent and understandable, but it lowers the register of teaching documentation below what the English maintains; it appears ~10 times, including in section headings ("Робота з квантовим залізом розвиває унікальні навички").

examples.source: Custom or based on real QPU calibration data / custom noise models
examples.suggested: Власна (користувацька) або на основі калібрувальних даних / власні моделі шуму
examples.translation: Довільна або на основі калібрувальних даних реального QPU / довільні моделі шуму
examples.why: "довільний" means "arbitrary/any", not "custom" (user-defined). The nuance that you build and supply the noise model yourself is flattened into "any noise model" — a lost qualifier rather than a false statement.

examples.source: The following code block will return an error for users on the Open Plan
examples.suggested: …для користувачів плану Open
examples.translation: Наступний блок коду поверне помилку для користувачів плану Open Plan
examples.why: "плану Open Plan" duplicates the word "plan" in both languages — a calqued construction a native technical writer would trim; the same doubling repeats in the next sentence ("Навантаження на плані Open Plan").

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no semantic drift, no dropped caveat or inverted claim, and the informal "ty" register holds consistently ("Než začneš", "ujisti se", "Věnuj chvíli"). The file does, however, split in two: up to line ~209 it uses correct Czech domain terms ("obvody", "jednoqubitové rotace", "backendy", "hradla"), but from line 209 onward a glossary leak substitutes capitalized, undeclined English nouns mid-sentence — "kvantový Circuit", "Trotterizovaných Circuitů", "dynamiky Circuit", "systému s 41 Qubity", "magnetizaci každého Qubitu", "jednoQubitového operátoru", "pak Backend vypočítá", "odesíláme přímo do Backend IBM" — which is ungrammatical Czech (no case endings) and makes obvod/Circuit and qubit/Qubit inconsistent within one file; the concepts stay identifiable, so MINOR rather than FAIL. Smaller items: "korelátoři" uses the animate-masculine plural (should be "korelátory", line 41); "dvoququbitové"/"dvoququbitová" is a repeated typo for "dvouqubitové" (lines 22, 169); "shots" is rendered "výstřelů" (literally gunshots, line 352); "performance management" is "řízení výkonu" in the title and lines 22/29 but "správu výkonu" at line 393; and "Na skutečném hardware" should be "hardwaru" (line 296), with heading 293 breaking the file's nominal heading style ("Generování", "Barvení", "Spuštění") with an imperative "Odhadni".

examples.source: The list of Trotterized circuits is executed using the `matrix_product_state` simulator with an arbitrary choice of $4096$ shots. The MPS method provides an efficient approximation of the circuit dynamics...
examples.suggested: Seznam Trotterizovaných obvodů je spuštěn pomocí simulátoru `matrix_product_state` s libovolně zvoleným počtem 4096 shotů. Metoda MPS poskytuje efektivní aproximaci dynamiky obvodu...
examples.translation: Seznam Trotterizovaných Circuit je spuštěn pomocí simulátoru `matrix_product_state` s libovolně zvoleným počtem $4096$ výstřelů. Metoda MPS poskytuje efektivní aproximaci dynamiky Circuit...
examples.why: Glossary leak: 'circuit' is left as an undeclined capitalized 'Circuit' twice in one paragraph, so it cannot take Czech genitive endings, and it clashes with 'obvody' used correctly in lines 22/27/192/209. 'shots' as 'výstřelů' is a literal calque meaning gunshots.

examples.source: We submit the Trotterized circuits directly to an IBM® backend while Fire Opal handles the noise-aware execution.
examples.suggested: Trotterizované obvody odesíláme přímo na backend IBM®, zatímco Fire Opal se stará o spouštění s ohledem na šum.
examples.translation: Trotterizované Circuit odesíláme přímo do Backend IBM®, zatímco Fire Opal se stará o spouštění s ohledem na šum.
examples.why: Both 'Circuit' and 'Backend' appear capitalized and uninflected, producing a sentence no Czech technical writer would produce; line 41 already uses the correctly declined 'šumovými backendy'.

examples.source: ### Estimate single-qubit magnetizations $\langle Z_i \rangle$ / To study the dynamics of the model, we want to measure the magnetization of each qubit...
examples.suggested: ### Odhad magnetizací jednotlivých qubitů $\langle Z_i \rangle$ / Abychom mohli studovat dynamiku modelu, chceme měřit magnetizaci každého qubitu...
examples.translation: ### Odhadni magnetizace jednotlivých Qubitů $\langle Z_i \rangle$ / Abychom mohli studovat dynamiku modelu, chceme měřit magnetizaci každého Qubitu...
examples.why: 'qubit' is capitalized mid-sentence as 'Qubitů'/'Qubitu'/'Qubity' from here to the end, while lines 27/39/395 use the correct lowercase 'qubit'/'jednoqubitové'. The heading also switches to an imperative ('Odhadni') against the file's nominal heading style.

examples.source: ...yielding more reliable estimates of spin observables like $\langle Z_i \rangle$ and correlators $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$.
examples.suggested: ...čímž se získávají spolehlivější odhady spinových observablů, jako jsou $\langle Z_i \rangle$ a korelátory $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$.
examples.translation: ...čímž se získávají spolehlivější odhady spinových observabilních veličin, jako jsou $\langle Z_i \rangle$ a korelátoři $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$.
examples.why: 'korelátoři' uses the animate-masculine nominative plural, as if correlators were people; the inanimate form is 'korelátory'. A native physicist would not write this.

examples.source: ...entangling two-qubit interactions ... apply two-qubit gates in parallel
examples.suggested: ...dvouqubitové provázací interakce ... aplikovat dvouqubitová hradla paralelně
examples.translation: ...dvoququbitové provázací interakce ... aplikovat dvoququbitová hradla paralelně
examples.why: Repeated typo 'dvoququbitové' (stray 'qu') in both occurrences, against the correctly formed 'jednoqubitové' in the same paragraph.

examples.source: ...extends the standard Qiskit Runtime Estimator primitive with automated error suppression and performance management.
examples.suggested: ...rozšiřuje standardní primitivum Qiskit Runtime Estimator o automatické potlačení chyb a řízení výkonu.
examples.translation: ...rozšiřuje standardní primitivum Qiskit Runtime Estimator o automatické potlačení chyb a správu výkonu.
examples.why: 'performance management' is 'řízení výkonu' in the title and lines 22 and 29, but 'správu výkonu' here — an inconsistent rendering of the tutorial's own core concept.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every quantity, condition and caveat survives intact (zero usage on system error vs. consumo up to the point of a user error/cancellation; 250 microsegundos default rep_delay; "una medición… puede tardar 56 veces más que una compuerta `x`"; the 28-día rolling vs. 28-día-completo Instancias/Análisis distinction; the NOT-for-billing note on `scheduler_timing`). Register is consistently informal tú (Consulta, Ten en cuenta, Ejecuta, Usa, Revisa, Establece). What a native editor would change: "overhead" is rendered two ways inside the file — "la sobrecarga incurrida para preparar la QPU" (line 27) vs. English "overhead" in prose at lines 53 and 60 ("es un overhead de aproximadamente 2 segundos", "tienen un overhead mucho mayor") — pick one (I'd keep "sobrecarga" in prose, leaving the formula placeholder as-is). Plus two calques: "para quienes tengan la autoridad correspondiente" for "the proper authority" (it means permisos/accesos, not autoridad) and the stiff "la sobrecarga incurrida" for "the overhead incurred".

examples.source: including the overhead incurred to prepare the QPU … / is an overhead of approximately 2s per sub-job / come with much higher overhead
examples.suggested: Unify on "sobrecarga" in prose: "es una sobrecarga de aproximadamente 2 segundos por sub-trabajo" / "conllevan una sobrecarga mucho mayor" (the `<overhead por sub-trabajo>` formula placeholder can stay as-is).
examples.translation: incluida la sobrecarga incurrida para preparar la QPU … / es un overhead de aproximadamente 2 segundos por sub-trabajo / tienen un overhead mucho mayor
examples.why: The same concept is split between a Spanish term and the raw English word within one short page, so the reader cannot tell whether "sobrecarga" and "overhead" are the same thing. Recognizable, not misleading — MINOR.

examples.source: or, for those with the proper authority, the Analytics page
examples.suggested: o, para quienes tengan los permisos adecuados, en la página [Análisis]
examples.translation: o, para quienes tengan la autoridad correspondiente, en la página [Análisis]
examples.why: "Authority" here is an access right, not authority in the Spanish sense; "la autoridad correspondiente" is a calque no Spanish-speaking technical writer would use for account permissions.

examples.source: including the overhead incurred to prepare the QPU to run the job
examples.suggested: incluida la sobrecarga necesaria para preparar la QPU y ejecutar el trabajo
examples.translation: incluida la sobrecarga incurrida para preparar la QPU para ejecutar el trabajo
examples.why: "Incurrida" is a literal transfer of "incurred" and the doubled "para … para …" makes the sentence clunky; the meaning is right but the phrasing reads as translated rather than written.

editor_note: Faithful, natural French API-reference prose with consistent informal "tu" ("les paramètres que tu peux définir", "Consulte la documentation"); domain/infra terms are correctly and consistently handled — "fair-share scheduler" → "ordonnanceur à partage équitable (fair-share)", "allow-list" → "liste d'autorisation", and backends/QPU/Open plan/Pay-As-You-Go rightly kept in English, with the 10-minute Open-Plan default and the "`[]` signifie aucun backend" caveat preserved exactly.

Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner: the caveat "cette méthode ne retourne pas de résultats précis pour les circuits dynamiques" is preserved intact, "scheduling" is correctly and consistently rendered as "ordonnancement", "stylesheet" as "feuille de style", and qubit/backend/Qiskit Runtime are left in the conventional English forms; the informal "tu" register holds everywhere ("tu pourrais vouloir visualiser", "utilise la méthode", "Consulte la référence API"). The one thing a native technical editor would change is the calque "la base de code du dessinateur de circuits ordonnancés" for "the codebase of the scheduled circuit drawer" — in French "dessinateur" denotes a person who draws, so an agent-noun calque of "drawer" reads as translationese for a software component; "du module de dessin / du traceur de circuits ordonnancés" is the natural rendering. Everything else (title "Visualiser le timing d'un circuit", headings "Afficher avec la feuille de style par défaut", "Prochaines étapes") is idiomatic and matches the English emphasis.

examples.source: without modifying the codebase of the scheduled circuit drawer
examples.suggested: sans modifier le code du module de dessin des circuits ordonnancés (ou : du traceur de circuits ordonnancés)
examples.translation: sans modifier la base de code du dessinateur de circuits ordonnancés
examples.why: "dessinateur" is an agent noun that in French designates a person (draughtsman/illustrator), so calquing "drawer" this way reads as machine translation for a software component; French docs use "module de dessin", "traceur" or simply keep the API name.

editor_note: No semantic inversions or dropped caveats — the Premium/Open-plan caveat, the convergence-diagnosis paragraph, and the QUBO→Hamiltonian derivation all carry the English meaning faithfully, and core terms (המילטוניאן העלות, מצב היסוד, אופרטור הערבוב (mixer), דיכוי/הפחתת שגיאות, ansatz kept in English) are correct and consistent. The main defect is "parametrized" rendered as **מפורמט** ("formatted") twice — "Circuit ansatz מפורמט" (~l.120) and "ה-Circuit המפורמט של QAOA" (~l.152); the intended word is מפורמטר/פרמטרי, and as written it is a meaningless adjective (the surrounding text "ארבעה פרמטרים: β₀…γ₁" is what rescues the concept). Second, "circuit" is split within the file between the English **Circuit** (ll. 96, 120, 152, 172, 265, 267) and Hebrew **מעגל** (ll. 27, 36, 56, 151, 641), and "session" is likewise split between **סשנים** (ll. 22, 60) and English **session** (ll. 54, 197, 526). Third, a cluster of literal-but-wrong renderings a native technical editor would rewrite: "unconstrained" in the QUBO expansion as **בלתי מוגבלת** ("unbounded" — should be ללא אילוצים), "hardware-native instructions" as **הוראות מקוריות לחומרה** ("original instructions"), the calqued **עיבוד-לאחר / עבד-לאחר** for post-process, and **משהו במעלה הזרם** for "something upstream". Register is consistently informal-imperative (ראה, בצע, חשב) with no biblical slips.

examples.source: QAOA uses a parametrized ansatz circuit to prepare candidate ground states of $H_C$. … Use `QAOAAnsatz` to construct the parametrized QAOA circuit
examples.suggested: מעגל ansatz פרמטרי / מעגל ה-QAOA הפרמטרי (או: המעגל התלוי-בפרמטרים)
examples.translation: ו-QAOA משתמש ב-Circuit ansatz מפורמט כדי להכין מצבי יסוד מועמדים של $H_C$. … השתמש ב-`QAOAAnsatz` כדי לבנות את ה-Circuit המפורמט של QAOA
examples.why: מפורמט means "formatted", not "parametrized" (מפורמטר/פרמטרי). Parametrization is the load-bearing idea of the whole variational loop; as written the adjective is inert nonsense and the reader has to infer the concept from the parameter list that follows.

examples.source: circuit / circuits
examples.suggested: Pick one convention — either מעגל throughout, or Circuit throughout — and apply it in prose consistently.
examples.translation: ה-Circuit, **Circuits** (ll. 96, 120, 152, 172, 265, 267) alongside מעגל / מעגלים קוונטיים / דיאגרמת מעגל / אופטימיזציית מעגלים (ll. 27, 36, 56, 151, 641)
examples.why: The same core object is named two ways within one file, sometimes in adjacent sentences (l. 151 heading 'מעגל ה-QAOA ansatz' immediately followed by l. 152 'ה-Circuit המפורמט'). Same split affects session: סשנים (ll. 22, 60) vs session (ll. 54, 197, 526).

examples.source: a **Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO)** problem
examples.suggested: בעיית **אופטימיזציה בינארית ריבועית ללא אילוצים (QUBO)**
examples.translation: בעיית **אופטימיזציה בינארית בלתי מוגבלת ריבועית (QUBO)**
examples.why: בלתי מוגבלת back-translates as "unbounded", a different (and in optimization, contradictory) notion from "unconstrained"; the standard Hebrew is ללא אילוצים. The word order also strands ריבועית at the end of the chain, away from the noun it modifies.

examples.source: Transpile the abstract circuit into hardware-native instructions.
examples.suggested: בצע טרנספילציה של המעגל המופשט להוראות נייטיביות של החומרה (לשערי הבסיס של החומרה).
examples.translation: בצע Transpile של ה-Circuit המופשט להוראות מקוריות לחומרה.
examples.why: מקוריות means "original", not "native" in the hardware/basis-gate sense; the reader loses the point that transpilation targets the device's own gate set. Also note the file uses both 'בצע Transpile' and 'טרנספילציה' for the same operation.

examples.source: Post-process and return result in desired classical format … map, transpile, execute, post-process … Post-process the sampled distribution
examples.suggested: עיבוד התוצאות (or עיבוד שלאחר ההרצה); imperative: עבד את ההתפלגות שנדגמה
examples.translation: עיבוד-לאחר והחזרת תוצאה בפורמט קלאסי רצוי … מיפוי, טרנספילציה, ביצוע, עיבוד-לאחר … עבד-לאחר את ההתפלגות שנדגמה
examples.why: עיבוד-לאחר is a word-for-word calque of the English compound; the hyphenated verb form עבד-לאחר is not Hebrew a native technical writer would produce. Reads as machine output in an otherwise fluent file.

examples.source: usually indicates that something upstream needs attention … COBYLA is derivative-free and fairly robust to moderate noise
examples.suggested: מצביעה על כך שמשהו מוקדם יותר בתהליך זקוק לתשומת לב … COBYLA היא שיטה נטולת-נגזרות (אינה נדרשת לנגזרות) ועמידה למדי לרעש מתון
examples.translation: מצביעה על כך שמשהו במעלה הזרם זקוק לתשומת לב … COBYLA הוא חסר נגזרת ועמיד למדי לרעש מתון
examples.why: במעלה הזרם is a literal calque of "upstream" that reads hydrologically rather than as pipeline-stage language; חסר נגזרת says COBYLA "lacks a derivative" instead of "does not require derivatives". The rest of this paragraph is genuinely well written, which makes these two stand out.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads: the technical content is faithful throughout — the tensor-factor-on-the-right note, the "right/left come from spin, not from qubit position" caveat, the control/target assignment in CX, the Bell-state result, and the "Qiskit numbers qubits from 0, right to left" parenthetical are all rendered correctly. Three things a native technical editor would still change. (1) "qubit" is rendered three ways inside one file — lowercase Latin "qubit" (lines 14, 163, 170), capitalized "ה-Qubit" (65, 147, 162), and the hybrid plural "Qubitים" (15, 65, 171); keeping the term in English is a defensible convention, but it should be one casing, and the Hebrew-suffixed "Qubitים" is the least natural of the three. (2) "ספין קוונטי מכני" (line 65) is a word-for-word calque of "quantum mechanical spin" — "מכני" alone reads as "machine-like"; a Hebrew physicist writes "ספין במכניקת הקוונטים" or simply "ספין קוונטי". (3) "ניתן לפתח מצבים מורכבים" (line 138) uses "לפתח" transitively for "evolve", which a Hebrew reader parses first as "to develop/build", flattening the physics sense of applying an operator to evolve a state.

examples.source: ...operations and measurements on single qubits. In this section, we'll use these classes to explore the behavior of multiple qubits.
examples.suggested: Pick one form and use it everywhere, e.g. "...פעולות ומדידות על קיוביטים בודדים. בחלק הזה, נשתמש במחלקות אלה כדי לחקור את ההתנהגות של קיוביטים מרובים."
examples.translation: ...פעולות ומדידות על qubit בודד. בחלק הזה, נשתמש במחלקות אלה כדי לחקור את ההתנהגות של Qubitים מרובים.
