examples.why: The core term of the lesson appears in three different forms in the same file — "qubit", "ה-Qubit", and "Qubitים". The concept stays identifiable, so this is not misleading, but the inconsistent casing and the English-stem-plus-Hebrew-plural hybrid look unedited.

examples.source: Here, "+", "-" or "right" and "left" come from the context of quantum mechanical spin, in which a component of spin may point to the left or the right in an experiment
examples.suggested: כאן, "+", "-" או "right" ו-"left" מגיעים מההקשר של ספין במכניקת הקוונטים, שבו רכיב של הספין יכול להצביע שמאלה או ימינה בניסוי
examples.translation: כאן, "+" ,"-" או "right" ו-"left" מגיעים מהקשר של ספין קוונטי מכני, שבו רכיב ספין יכול להצביע שמאלה או ימינה בניסוי
examples.why: "ספין קוונטי מכני" is a word-for-word calque of "quantum mechanical"; standing alone, "מכני" reads as mechanical in the machinery sense, which no Hebrew physicist would write. "רכיב ספין" without the construct "של הספין" is likewise clipped.

examples.source: Compound states can be evolved using compound operations as we would expect — just like we saw for single systems in the previous lesson.
examples.suggested: אפשר להפעיל פעולות מורכבות על מצבים מורכבים ולפתח אותם, בדיוק כפי שהיינו מצפים — כמו שראינו עבור מערכות בודדות בשיעור הקודם.
examples.translation: ניתן לפתח מצבים מורכבים באמצעות פעולות מורכבות כפי שהיינו מצפים — בדיוק כפי שראינו עבור מערכות בודדות בשיעור הקודם.
examples.why: Transitive "לפתח" is read first as "to develop/construct" rather than as evolution under an operator; this is the one sentence that draws the compound-vs-single-system parallel, so the intuition should not blur. Meaning stays recoverable from the code that follows, hence minor.

editor_note: Nothing misleading: the two directional claims that matter — lowering `rep_delay` shortens QPU execution time at the cost of a higher state-preparation error rate, and `rep_delay=0` + `init_qubits=False` making circuits "merge" — are both rendered correctly, and the informal "kamu"/"-mu" register holds throughout. The defects are editorial. "circuit" is split three ways inside two sentences: "sebuah sirkuit dieksekusi" (line 32), then "di awal Circuit" and "Setiap Backend" with stray mid-sentence capitals (lines 32, 34), then plain lowercase "circuit"/"circuit-circuit" everywhere after — a native editor would settle on one form. The PUB caveat is also loosely worded: "tidak ada jaminan urutan circuit dari PUB akan dieksekusi" reads as "no guarantee the order... will be executed" instead of "no guarantee about the order in which they are executed", and the following example drops the head noun ("mungkin tidak dijalankan sebelum `pub2`" compares circuits to a PUB, not to circuits from pub2). "circuit-circuit tersebut 'menggabung'" is also non-idiomatic — "menyatu" is what an Indonesian writer would use for intransitive "merge".

examples.source: When a circuit is executed on an IBM® quantum processing unit (QPU), an implicit reset is typically inserted at the beginning of the circuit… Each backend has a different default `rep_delay`
examples.suggested: Saat sebuah circuit dieksekusi … reset implisit di awal circuit … Setiap backend memiliki …
examples.translation: Saat sebuah sirkuit dieksekusi pada unit pemrosesan kuantum (QPU) IBM®, biasanya dilakukan reset implisit di awal Circuit… Setiap Backend memiliki `rep_delay` default yang berbeda
examples.why: Three renderings of the same term within two sentences ('sirkuit', capitalized 'Circuit', lowercase 'circuit'), plus a stray capitalized 'Backend' mid-sentence. Recognizable but inconsistent; the rest of the file uses lowercase 'circuit'/'backend'.

examples.source: there is no guarantee on the order the circuits from PUBs are executed
examples.suggested: tidak ada jaminan mengenai urutan eksekusi circuit dari PUB
examples.translation: tidak ada jaminan urutan circuit dari PUB akan dieksekusi
examples.why: Calqued word order makes 'urutan' read as the object of 'dieksekusi' ('no guarantee the order will be executed') rather than as the thing not guaranteed. Grammatically parseable, but a native technical writer would restructure it.

examples.source: circuits from `pub1` might not run before those from `pub2`
examples.suggested: circuit dari `pub1` mungkin tidak dijalankan sebelum circuit dari `pub2`
examples.translation: circuit dari `pub1` mungkin tidak dijalankan sebelum `pub2`
examples.why: The head noun is dropped, so the sentence compares circuits to a PUB rather than to the circuits belonging to that PUB. Meaning is recoverable from context, but the parallel the English sets up is lost.

examples.source: the circuits "merge" together
examples.suggested: circuit-circuit tersebut "menyatu"
examples.translation: circuit-circuit tersebut "menggabung"
examples.why: 'menggabung' is not idiomatic Indonesian for intransitive 'merge' — the verb is normally transitive ('menggabungkan'). 'menyatu' or 'tergabung menjadi satu' is what a native writer would use here.

editor_note: One sentence strengthens a hedged claim into a false absolute: EN "repeating the entanglement layer four times is not likely to yield a substantially better match" becomes "mengulang lapisan keterikatan empat kali TIDAK MUNGKIN menghasilkan kecocokan yang jauh lebih baik" (line 209) — "tidak mungkin" means "cannot possibly / is impossible", not "unlikely", so the learner is taught that 4 reps categorically cannot beat 2–3 reps. The same paragraph proves the translator has the right hedge available ("kemungkinan" for "likely" in the very same sentence, "Kemungkinan besar" at line 177), so this is a modality error, not a house style. Secondary (non-misleading) issues: "entanglement/entangle" is rendered three ways in the file — noun "keterikatan" (lines 42, 73, 84, 112, 127, 138, 175), verb "menjalin" (73, 84) and verb "terjerat" (177) — and "keterikatan" itself is a nonstandard choice for the field's "keterjeratan"/"entanglement"; plus "keduanya" ("the two of them") is used twice where the referent is not two things (line 73 "n lapisan keterikatan, dengan lapisan SU(2) di antara keduanya"; line 138 "tidak ada yang ajaib tentang keduanya" for several pre-made circuits), and line 127 keeps English word order verbatim ("perbedaan dalam keterikatan (dan total circuit) kedalaman"), which is ungrammatical in Indonesian. Register is fine throughout: consistent informal "kamu", no bapak/ibu slips.

examples.source: repeating the entanglement layer four times is not likely to yield a substantially better match to the target state than two or three repetitions
examples.suggested: mengulang lapisan keterikatan empat kali kemungkinan besar tidak akan menghasilkan kecocokan yang jauh lebih baik dengan keadaan target dibandingkan dua atau tiga repetisi
examples.translation: mengulang lapisan keterikatan empat kali tidak mungkin menghasilkan kecocokan yang jauh lebih baik dengan keadaan target dibandingkan dua atau tiga repetisi
examples.why: "tidak mungkin" = "impossible", turning the English hedge ("not likely") into an absolute. As written the page asserts that four repetitions CANNOT do better than two or three, which is false and stronger than the source's heuristic advice.

examples.source: CX entanglements / entangling 0 & 1 / the last qubit is not entangled with the others
examples.suggested: Pick one root and keep it: keterjeratan CX / menjeratkan (menjerat) 0 & 1 / tidak terjerat dengan yang lainnya
examples.translation: keterikatan CX / menjalin 0 & 1 / qubit terakhir sama sekali tidak terjerat dengan yang lainnya
examples.why: The single concept "entanglement" appears under three unrelated Indonesian roots (ikat, jalin, jerat) within one lesson. "keterikatan" (attachment/bond) is also not the conventional field term; the concept stays recognizable, so this is a consistency/terminology defect rather than a false concept.

examples.source: Settings `reps = n` corresponds to `n` entanglement layers, with SU(2) layers between them and on each end.
examples.suggested: ... dengan `n` lapisan keterikatan, dengan lapisan SU(2) di antara lapisan-lapisan tersebut dan di kedua ujungnya.
examples.translation: Pengaturan `reps = n` bersesuaian dengan `n` lapisan keterikatan, dengan lapisan SU(2) di antara keduanya dan di setiap ujungnya.
examples.why: "di antara keduanya" means "between the two of them", contradicting the generalisation to n layers that the same sentence just made. The same wrong-number "keduanya" recurs at line 138 ("tidak ada yang ajaib tentang keduanya") where English "them" refers to all three pre-made circuit families.

examples.source: Note the difference in entanglement (and total circuit) depth between this pauli_two_design and, for example, the efficient_su2.
examples.suggested: Perhatikan perbedaan kedalaman keterikatan (dan kedalaman circuit total) antara pauli_two_design ini dan, misalnya, efficient_su2.
examples.translation: Perhatikan perbedaan dalam keterikatan (dan total circuit) kedalaman antara pauli_two_design ini dan, misalnya, efficient_su2.
examples.why: English noun-stacking ("entanglement ... depth") is carried over word-for-word, leaving the head noun "kedalaman" stranded after the parenthesis. No Indonesian writer would produce this order; it reads as raw MT. Line 112 "Seseorang bisa menggunakan" (calque of "One could use", where "Kita bisa" is idiomatic) and line 177 "seharusnya baik terjerat ... atau dihapus" (calque of "either ... or"; "baik" requires "maupun") are the same class.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, informal "tu" holds consistently ("Puoi usare le opzioni...", "Fai clic sulla scheda appropriata"), and the technical prose is correct ("Se reimpostare i qubit allo stato fondamentale per ogni shot", "Il ritardo tra una misurazione e il circuito quantistico successivo"). The one real defect is that "dynamic circuits" is rendered two ways in the same file: the ungrammatical half-translated "Circuit dinamici" (tab label plus the bullets under Dynamic/ZNE/PEA/PEC) versus the correct "circuiti dinamici" (Dynamical decoupling and Fractional gates tabs) — a native editor would normalize all of them to "circuiti dinamici". Secondary: the tab label "Twirling dei Gate" capitalizes Gate while the body text uses lowercase "twirling dei gate", and under `environment.job_tags` the feminine "Nessuna" is attached to the masculine "**Predefinito**" ("**Predefinito**: Nessuna"), where "Nessuno" is required. None of these mislead a learner; they are polish-level.

examples.source: Dynamic circuits / dynamic circuits
examples.suggested: Circuiti dinamici / circuiti dinamici
examples.translation: Circuit dinamici
examples.why: The noun is left in English but given an Italian plural adjective, producing a non-word combination; the same concept is correctly rendered "circuiti dinamici" in the Dynamical decoupling and Fractional gates tabs, so the file splits one term two ways. Recognizable, hence minor, but no Italian technical writer would leave "Circuit dinamici".

examples.source: Gate twirling
examples.suggested: Twirling dei gate
examples.translation: Twirling dei Gate
examples.why: Tab label capitalizes "Gate" mid-phrase while the surrounding prose uses lowercase "twirling dei gate"; Italian does not capitalize common nouns mid-sentence and the inconsistency is visible within the same tab.

examples.source: **Default**: None
examples.suggested: **Predefinito**: Nessuno
examples.translation: **Predefinito**: Nessuna
examples.why: Gender disagreement — "Predefinito" is masculine, so the pronoun must be "Nessuno". (The neighbouring "**Scelte**: Nessuna" is fine, agreeing with feminine "Scelte".)

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, negation and quantity is faithful (the "questo NON è il tempo utilizzato per la fatturazione (tempo QPU)" caveat, the v0.43.0 version floor, the "gate X applicato al qubit 10 a 1161 dt" example all match), and the informal "tu" register holds throughout (puoi, imposta, usa, convertili, Ti consigliamo). The real defect is a glossary leak on "circuit": the English noun is left capitalized and undeclined in prose as "Circuit" — in the title/sidebar ("Visualizza il timing del Circuit"), in "i [Circuit dinamici]" and "il supporto ai Circuit dinamici" (line 36), in "convertili in Circuit ISA" (line 154) and "(Circuit dinamici)" (line 237) — while the very same sentence and the rest of the file correctly use "circuito/circuiti" ("utile per i circuiti statici", "dati di timing del circuito", "Visualizza i circuiti"). "Circuit dinamici" is not just inconsistent, it is ungrammatical Italian (English noun with an Italian plural adjective) and a native editor would replace all six prose occurrences with "circuito/circuiti". Two smaller items: "su qualche canale" is a calque of "on some channel" (Italian would say "su un determinato canale"), and "in unità di secondi _dt_" inverts "in units of _dt_ seconds" into something that reads as "units of seconds dt".

examples.source: Visualize circuit timing
examples.suggested: Visualizza il timing del circuito
examples.translation: Visualizza il timing del Circuit
examples.why: The page title leaves "circuit" untranslated and capitalized, producing a hybrid noun phrase no Italian technical writer would use, while the body of the same page says "circuito" everywhere.

examples.source: ...it might not accurately reflect the timing of dynamic circuits ... As part of dynamic circuit support, Qiskit Runtime returns...
examples.suggested: ...il timing dei [circuiti dinamici] ... Come parte del supporto ai circuiti dinamici...
examples.translation: ...potrebbe non riflettere accuratamente il timing dei [Circuit dinamici] ... Come parte del supporto ai Circuit dinamici, Qiskit Runtime restituisce...
examples.why: Within one sentence the file writes both "i circuiti statici" and "i Circuit dinamici"; the English plural noun carrying an Italian plural adjective is ungrammatical and splits a core term against itself.

examples.source: First, set up the environment, define the circuits and convert them to ISA circuits
examples.suggested: Innanzitutto, configura l'ambiente, definisci i circuiti e convertili in circuiti ISA
examples.translation: Prima, configura l'ambiente, definisci i circuiti e convertili in Circuit ISA
examples.why: The same clause uses "i circuiti" and then "Circuit ISA" two words later — the leak is visible side by side, and "circuiti ISA" is the established Italian rendering used elsewhere in the corpus.

examples.source: Each string represents a single instruction on some channel ... The instruction's duration, in units of _dt_ seconds
examples.suggested: Ogni stringa rappresenta una singola istruzione su un determinato canale ... La durata dell'istruzione, in unità di _dt_ (in secondi)
examples.translation: Ogni stringa rappresenta una singola istruzione su qualche canale ... La durata dell'istruzione, in unità di secondi _dt_
examples.why: "su qualche canale" is a word-for-word calque of "on some channel" and reads vague rather than technical; "in unità di secondi _dt_" reverses the modifier so it parses as "units of seconds dt" instead of "units of dt, expressed in seconds".

editor_note: Faithful and generally natural — the math-heavy walkthroughs (제어-NOT: X가 제어, W가 타깃; 열↔입력, 행↔출력; nm개의 행과 nm개의 열) are all correct, and 유니터리 / 완전 위상 소거 / 완전 탈분극 / 등거리 사상(isometry) / 양의 준정부호 / 최대 얽힘 are correct, consistent choices. Two things a native editor would change. (1) The "faithful" claim at line 609 flattens "if and only if" into a one-directional "두 채널이 동일한 경우에만 Choi 행렬도 동일합니다" — the load-bearing direction (same Choi ⇒ same channel) survives, so it does not mislead, but the biconditional should be stated as 필요충분조건. (2) Several within-file term splits: "partial trace" is 부분 추적 (lines 37/48/101/173/201/219) but 부분 대각합 at 303 and 대각합으로 제거 at 368; "lesson" is 수업 (79, 101, 174) / 강의 (406) / 단원 (700); "classical state" is 고전 상태 (50, 69, 227) vs 고전적 상태 (385, 396, 409, 607, 617, 636); and the retained English term is cased inconsistently as qubit vs Qubit, often within one sentence (line 104 "작업 공간 qubit", line 101 "입력 Qubit"). Minor omissions: "are all common" dropped at 406, and "단순함을 위해" added at 624 where the EN has no such qualifier. Register is uniform -습니다 (합쇼체), the norm for Korean technical docs, with no 드리/honorific slips.

examples.source: Choi matrices provide a *faithful* representation of channels, meaning that two channels are the same if and only if they have the same Choi matrix.
examples.suggested: … 즉, 두 채널이 동일할 필요충분조건은 두 채널의 Choi 행렬이 동일한 것입니다.
examples.translation: Choi 행렬은 채널의 *충실한(faithful)* 표현을 제공합니다. 즉, 두 채널이 동일한 경우에만 Choi 행렬도 동일합니다.
examples.why: "if and only if" becomes "…인 경우에만", which in Korean states only one direction. The direction that survives (same Choi matrix ⇒ same channel) is the one the next sentence relies on, so a learner is not misled, but the biconditional that defines faithfulness is weakened and should be rendered with 필요충분조건.

examples.source: Finally the workspace system W is traced out. / … the input state ρ gets moved to the bottom qubit and then traced out.
examples.suggested: … $\mathsf{W}$에 대한 부분 추적을 수행합니다. / … 아래쪽 Qubit으로 옮긴 후 부분 추적으로 제거합니다.
examples.translation: 마지막으로 작업 공간 시스템 $\mathsf{W}$에 대한 부분 대각합(partial trace)을 수행합니다. / … 아래쪽 Qubit으로 옮긴 후 대각합으로 제거합니다.
examples.why: The same operation is 부분 추적 everywhere else in the file (including the Stinespring definition at 37/48 and the worked example at 173/201/219). Switching to 부분 대각합 / 대각합 in two places makes the reader wonder whether a different operation is meant; both renderings are recognizable, so this is inconsistency rather than a wrong term.

examples.source: …as we will see by the end of the lesson. / discussed in the previous lesson / in this lesson for the sake of simplicity
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "lesson" (e.g. 이 단원) and use it in all four places.
examples.translation: 이는 수업 마지막에 확인할 수 있습니다. / 이전 수업에서 설명한 … / 이 강의에서는 간결함을 위해 … / 이는 이 단원의 끝 부분에서 확인하게 될 것입니다.
examples.why: "lesson" is rendered three ways (수업 / 강의 / 단원) within one file, including two forward-references to the same end-of-lesson result (lines 79 and 700), which reads as if they point at different units of the course.

examples.source: …and not necessarily single qubits. / a workspace qubit, W. / the qubit reset channel
examples.suggested: Use one casing throughout — lowercase qubit (or 큐비트) — including in headings.
examples.translation: 반드시 단일 Qubit인 것은 아닙니다. / 두 와이어는 모두 단일 Qubit을 나타내므로 / 첫 번째 단계는 작업 공간 qubit $\mathsf{W}$의 도입입니다. / 위쪽 qubit $\mathsf{X}$는 오른쪽에 / ### qubit 리셋 채널 … Qubit 리셋 채널은
examples.why: The retained English term alternates between qubit and Qubit, sometimes in adjacent sentences and even between a heading and its first line (362 vs 364). Mid-sentence capitalisation of a common noun is not something a Korean technical writer would produce; it reads as machine-mixed casing.

examples.source: These different ways of naming these matrices, which are called *Kraus matrices*, are all common and can be convenient in different situations — but we'll stick with the names A_0,…,A_{N-1}…
examples.suggested: … 이름을 붙이는 이러한 방식들은 모두 흔히 쓰이며, 상황에 따라 각각 편리할 수 있습니다. …
examples.translation: *Kraus 행렬*이라 불리는 이 행렬들에 이름을 붙이는 방식은 상황에 따라 다양하게 쓰일 수 있습니다. 이 강의에서는 …
examples.why: "are all common" is dropped, so the reassurance that the learner will meet every one of these indexing conventions in the literature is lost; the Korean only says the naming can vary by situation.

editor_note: No misleading content: every quantity, condition and caveat survives intact — the shot-count tiers (16개 미만/16-18개/18개 초과), the four samples-per-batch bullets (600/1500/6000/16000), the (14e,12o) active space, the S-CORE "올바른 입자 섹터" rationale and the dummy-device disclaimer are all faithful, and 오류 억제 (suppression) vs 오류 완화 (mitigation) is correctly kept distinct. What a native technical editor would change: "lone pair" is rendered 고독 쌍 ("lonely pair"), a literal calque — the chemistry term is 비공유 전자쌍 / 고립 전자쌍 (the parenthetical gloss saves it from being misleading); "electron configurations" splits between 전자 배치 (lines 38, 42) and 전자 구성 (line 75) within the same file; the second Accordion title "SQD 옵션 구성에 대한 자세한 내용은 클릭하세요" is ungrammatical (topic marker 은 with an imperative — needs 내용을 보려면), unlike the parallel first one at line 52 which is correct. Several sentences read as fluent MT rather than Korean-authored prose: "그 전자 구조는 명시적으로 시뮬레이션되고" (calqued from "the electronic structure of which"), "중요하게도" as a sentence opener, and "…기본 오류 완화 옵션 세트와 함께 인스턴스화됩니다". Also 편극 가능 연속 모델 (missing 체 for "continuum") and 적분 방정식 형식 (formalism = 형식론) are literal renderings, and the English glossary tokens Circuit/Qubit are cased inconsistently (Qubit는/두-Qubit vs lowercase "qubit 레이아웃" at lines 28 and 54).

examples.source: we only include the $\sigma$, $\sigma^{*}$, and lone pair orbitals in the active space
examples.suggested: 활성 공간에는 $\sigma$, $\sigma^{*}$, 비공유 전자쌍(lone pair) 오비탈만 포함합니다
examples.translation: 활성 공간에는 $\sigma$, $\sigma^{*}$, 그리고 고독 쌍(lone pair) 오비탈만 포함합니다
examples.why: 고독 쌍 is a word-for-word calque ('lonely pair'); Korean chemistry uses 비공유 전자쌍 or 고립 전자쌍. Recognizable thanks to the English gloss, so imperfect rather than misleading.

examples.source: electron configurations
examples.suggested: 전자 배치로 통일
examples.translation: 전자 배치 (lines 38, 42) vs 전자 구성 (line 75: 충분한 다양한 전자 구성을 포함하도록)
examples.why: The same concept is rendered two ways inside one file; 전자 배치 is the correct chemistry term, 전자 구성 reads as a generic 'configuration'. Within-file split, not a concept-breaking one.

examples.source: Click to expand for more information about configuring the SQD options:
examples.suggested: SQD 옵션 구성에 대한 자세한 내용을 보려면 클릭하세요:
examples.translation: SQD 옵션 구성에 대한 자세한 내용은 클릭하세요:
examples.why: Ungrammatical: the topic marker 은 leaves the imperative 클릭하세요 without an object. The parallel title at line 52 gets it right (…내용을 보려면 클릭하세요), so this is an isolated slip.

examples.source: a methanol molecule as the solute, the electronic structure of which is simulated explicitly
examples.suggested: 용질인 메탄올 분자의 전자 구조는 명시적으로 시뮬레이션하고
examples.translation: 용질로 메탄올 분자를 사용하는 템플릿을 활용하며, 그 전자 구조는 명시적으로 시뮬레이션되고
examples.why: '그 전자 구조는' transplants the English non-restrictive relative clause; Korean would restructure. Grammatical but unmistakably translated rather than written.

examples.source: A Sampler primitive is then instantiated with a default set of error mitigation options to manage the execution.
examples.suggested: 그런 다음 실행을 관리할 기본 오류 완화 옵션으로 Sampler 프리미티브를 인스턴스화합니다.
examples.translation: 그런 다음 Sampler 프리미티브가 실행을 관리하기 위한 기본 오류 완화 옵션 세트와 함께 인스턴스화됩니다.
examples.why: English passive + '…와 함께' is textbook translationese; a Korean technical writer would use the active form and drop '세트'.

examples.source: the integral equation formalism polarizable continuum model (IEF-PCM) of solvent
examples.suggested: 용매의 적분방정식 형식론 분극 연속체 모델(IEF-PCM)
examples.translation: 용매의 적분 방정식 형식 편극 가능 연속 모델(IEF-PCM)
examples.why: '형식' renders formalism as 'format', and 연속 모델 drops the 체 that makes it 'continuum'. Both are literal-but-recognizable given the IEF-PCM acronym, so MINOR.

examples.source: These can provide actionable information about the progress… / instances with smaller Hilbert spaces require fewer shots
examples.suggested: 실행 중 조치를 취할 수 있는 정보 / 힐베르트 공간이 더 작은 사례(instance)일수록
examples.translation: 이 로그는 … 유용한 정보를 제공합니다 / 일반적으로 힐베르트 공간이 작은 경우 더 적은 수의 측정이 필요합니다
examples.why: 'actionable' flattens to the generic '유용한', and 'instances' disappears, softening the emphasis slightly. No factual change, but the English teaches a touch more precisely.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities; the spectral-theorem statement, the |λ|=1 derivation and the θ→1 wrap-around remark all say exactly what the English says, and core terms are right and consistent (nilai eigen, vektor eigen, penguraian spektral, matriks unitari, bulatan unit, keadaan kuantum, litar kuantum, pemfaktoran integer). What a native Malay technical editor would change is lexical polish. (1) Several Indonesian-leaning choices rather than Malay: "menyiratkan" for "implies" (used 3×; Malay math prose uses "membayangkan"/"mengimplikasikan"), "pengurutannya" (Malay: susunannya/tertibnya), "relevansi praktikalnya" (Malay: kerelevanan/kaitan praktikalnya), "bergerak lawan jam" (Malay: melawan arah jam). (2) Literal-but-wrong verb choices in the math prose: "ia bertukar ganti dengan transpos konjugatnya" for "commutes with" (standard: kalis tukar tertib), "memelihara norma Euclidean" for "preserve" (mengekalkan), "kita boleh membatalkannya dari kedua-dua belah" for cancelling a factor from both sides (menghapuskan/memotong), and the calqued "Biarkan $M$ adalah…" for "Let M be…" (Biar/Andaikan $M$ ialah…). (3) "approximate/approximation" is split within the file between "menganggarkan" (paras before the Figure) and "penghampiran" (the Figure output line and remarks 2–3), and "qubit" is capitalized mid-sentence as "Qubit" / "$n$-Qubit" throughout the problem-statement section, which reads like an untouched glossary artifact. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: is said to be a *normal* matrix if it commutes with its conjugate transpose
examples.suggested: …jika ia kalis tukar tertib dengan transpos konjugatnya
examples.translation: dikatakan sebagai matriks *normal* jika ia bertukar ganti dengan transpos konjugatnya
examples.why: "bertukar ganti" means "interchangeable/swapped", not the algebraic "commutes"; the DBP/standard Malay rendering for commuting matrices is "kalis tukar tertib". Recognizable in context, so minor, but it is not the field's term.

examples.source: Let $M$ be a normal $N\times N$ complex matrix. … The theorem implies that $\mathbb{I}$ can be written…
examples.suggested: Andaikan $M$ ialah matriks kompleks normal $N\times N$. … Teorem ini membayangkan bahawa $\mathbb{I}$ boleh ditulis…
examples.translation: Biarkan $M$ adalah matriks kompleks normal $N\times N$. … Teorem ini menyiratkan bahawa $\mathbb{I}$ boleh ditulis…
examples.why: "Biarkan … adalah" is a word-for-word calque of "Let … be" (biarkan = leave alone) and "adalah" should be "ialah" before a noun; "menyiratkan" is Indonesian rather than Malay for mathematical "implies". Together they make the theorem prose read as translated rather than written.

examples.source: so we can cancel it from both sides to obtain
examples.suggested: jadi kita boleh menghapuskannya daripada kedua-dua belah untuk memperoleh
examples.translation: jadi kita boleh membatalkannya dari kedua-dua belah untuk memperoleh
examples.why: "membatalkan" is "to annul/void" (as in cancelling a booking), not the algebraic cancellation of a common factor; "menghapuskan"/"memotong" is the mathematical sense. The learner still follows the derivation, so this is minor.

examples.source: our goal is to compute or approximate the eigenvalue … an approximation to the number $\theta$ … a very precise approximation to $\theta$
examples.suggested: pick one family and hold it — e.g. menganggarkan / anggaran throughout (matching the title "Masalah anggaran fasa"), or hampiran / menghampiri throughout
examples.translation: matlamat kita adalah untuk mengira atau menganggarkan nilai eigen … penghampiran kepada nombor $\theta$ … penghampiran yang sangat tepat kepada $\theta$
examples.why: The same concept (approximate/approximation of θ) is rendered by two unrelated stems within one short file — "anggar-" in the body paragraphs and "hampir-" in the Figure and remarks 2–3 — so the reader cannot tell whether they name the same operation. Also note "$n$ Qubit"/"$n$-Qubit" is capitalized mid-sentence throughout this section and should be lowercase "qubit".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped dates or qubit counts (1,121/1,386+/4,000, 127-qubit Eagle, 433-qubit Osprey, 133→156 Heron all correct), and the two "Benar atau salah" answers keep the English logic intact. What a native technical editor would change is a layer of calque and Indonesian-flavoured lexis: "laws of quantum mechanics" is rendered "undang-undang mekanik kuantum" (legal statutes) instead of "hukum"; "The roadmap lays the course" becomes "Peta jalan menetapkan kursus" ("kursus" = a training course, not a heading/haluan); "Key takeaways" is the literal "Pengambilan utama" rather than "Intipati/Rumusan utama"; "some areas" is "kawasan" (geographic) instead of "bidang". Two small fidelity slips: "a mathematician then at AT&T Bell Labs" is rendered "yang kemudian di AT&T Bell Labs", which reads as "who was later at Bell Labs" rather than "who at that time was at", and "significantly improved gate time" drops the qualifier, becoming just "masa gate yang lebih baik". Register is consistently "Anda" but capitalised Indonesian-style, alongside Indonesian lexis ("enkripsi", "mengamankan", "berbondong-bondong", "dunia nyata", "lebih dari" for "lebih daripada"). None of this teaches a false concept — core domain terms (qubit, litar, penggandeng boleh laras, superkomputer berpusatkan kuantum, penindasan dan mitigasi ralat) are correct and consistent.

examples.source: Quantum computing harnesses the laws of quantum mechanics to solve complex mathematical problems.
examples.suggested: ... memanfaatkan hukum mekanik kuantum ...
examples.translation: Pengkomputeran kuantum memanfaatkan undang-undang mekanik kuantum untuk menyelesaikan masalah matematik yang kompleks.
examples.why: "Undang-undang" is legislation/statute law. Physical laws in Malay are "hukum" (hukum fizik, hukum Newton). A recognizable but wrong-register calque of English "laws".

examples.source: The roadmap lays the course for hitting a milestone of a 1,121 qubit quantum computer in the year 2023
examples.suggested: Peta jalan itu menetapkan haluan ke arah pencapaian komputer kuantum 1,121 qubit pada tahun 2023
examples.translation: Peta jalan menetapkan kursus untuk mencapai pencapaian komputer kuantum 1,121 qubit pada tahun 2023
examples.why: "Kursus" in Malay means a training course; "lays the course" needs "haluan"/"arah". Also "mencapai pencapaian" is a tautology no native writer would produce.

examples.source: Peter Shor, a mathematician then at AT&T Bell Labs in New Jersey, proved that ...
examples.suggested: Peter Shor, seorang ahli matematik yang ketika itu di AT&T Bell Labs di New Jersey, ...
examples.translation: Peter Shor, seorang ahli matematik yang kemudian di AT&T Bell Labs di New Jersey, membuktikan bahawa ...
examples.why: "Then" here means "at that time", not "afterwards". "Yang kemudian" tells the learner he joined Bell Labs later, which misplaces where the 1994 result was done.

examples.source: having half the gate error rate, practically zero crosstalk, and significantly improved gate time
examples.suggested: ... dan masa gate yang jauh lebih baik
examples.translation: dengan separuh kadar ralat gate, hampir sifar crosstalk, dan masa gate yang lebih baik
examples.why: The qualifier "significantly" is dropped, weakening the claimed Heron-over-Eagle improvement relative to the two quantified gains it sits beside.

examples.source: Key takeaways / Some areas considered particularly promising
examples.suggested: Intipati utama / Beberapa bidang yang dianggap sangat menjanjikan
examples.translation: Pengambilan utama / Beberapa kawasan yang dianggap sangat menjanjikan
examples.why: "Pengambilan" is the act of taking (or recruitment) — a literal calque of "takeaways"; "kawasan" is a geographic area, whereas a field of application is "bidang".

examples.source: you / securing private communications / Scientists piled into the field / more than / conceptualized
examples.suggested: anda / melindungi komunikasi peribadi / Saintis berpusu-pusu / lebih daripada / dikonsepsikan; enkripsi → penyulitan
examples.translation: Anda (capitalised) / mengamankan komunikasi peribadi / Saintis berbondong-bondong / lebih dari / dikonseptualisasikan
examples.why: Consistent "anda" is right, but capitalised "Anda", "lebih dari", "enkripsi", "mengamankan", "berbondong-bondong" and "dunia nyata" are Indonesian conventions in an ms file; a Malay technical writer would use the Malaysian forms.

editor_note: The prose is otherwise fluent, informal-"ty" throughout ("Jeśli chcesz uruchomić", "Pamiętaj, że", "Zwróć uwagę"), and semantically faithful — the 5/9 vs 4/9 and 556/444 counts, the global-phase passage ("równoważne z dokładnością do globalnej fazy") and the norm-equal-1 caveat all survive intact. The one real defect is a glossary leak: from the "A preview of quantum circuits" section onward, "quantum circuit" is left as the undeclined English noun glued to a Polish adjective — "Zapowiedź Circuit kwantowych", "Circuit kwantowe zostaną formalnie wprowadzone", "macierzy unitarnej odpowiadającej temu Circuit", "z powyższego Circuit" (8 prose occurrences, lines 298–347) — even though the same file already uses the correct "Obwody kwantowe" for the link label at line 238; it should be obwód/obwody kwantowe declined normally. Secondary: "qubit" is split within the file ("wektorom stanu qubit" l.53, "operacji qubitowych" l.300 vs "wektora stanu kubitu" l.198), "Python" is left undeclined in Polish prepositional phrases ("w Python", lines 48/50/52/105/141/208, while l.319 correctly has "Pythona"), "renderer" is rendered as the process noun "renderowanie" instead of a renderer ("z renderowaniem `mpl`", "renderowanie tekstowe"), and the hedge in "is likely to get closer and closer" is dropped to a flat assertion at line 255.

examples.source: A preview of quantum circuits / Quantum circuits won't be formally introduced until the Quantum circuits lesson / the unitary matrix corresponding to this circuit / the state obtained from the circuit above
examples.suggested: Zapowiedź obwodów kwantowych / Obwody kwantowe zostaną formalnie wprowadzone dopiero w lekcji [Obwody kwantowe] / macierzy unitarnej odpowiadającej temu obwodowi / stan uzyskany z powyższego obwodu
examples.translation: Zapowiedź Circuit kwantowych / Circuit kwantowe zostaną formalnie wprowadzone dopiero w lekcji [Circuit kwantowe] / macierzy unitarnej odpowiadającej temu Circuit / stan uzyskany z powyższego Circuit
examples.why: Untranslated English 'Circuit' left undeclined inside Polish noun phrases in 8 prose spots, while the very same file uses the correct 'Obwody kwantowe' as the link label at line 238. A native writer would never mix these; the term also fails to inflect for case, so the sentences are ungrammatical.

examples.source: the qubit state vectors |0> and |1> / the same qubit state vector v / composing qubit unitary operations
examples.suggested: Pick one convention (kubit, declined) throughout: "wektorom stanu kubitu", "wektora stanu kubitu", "unitarnych operacji kubitowych"
examples.translation: wektorom stanu qubit $\vert 0\rangle$ i $\vert 1\rangle$ / tego samego wektora stanu kubitu `v` / układaniem unitarnych operacji qubitowych
examples.why: Both spellings 'qubit' and 'kubit' appear in one file, and at line 53 'stanu qubit' is left undeclined where Polish requires the genitive.

examples.source: Vectors and matrices in Python / matrix and vector computations in Python / In Python, matrix and vector computations can be performed
examples.suggested: Wektory i macierze w Pythonie / obliczeń na macierzach i wektorach w Pythonie / W Pythonie obliczenia...
examples.translation: Wektory i macierze w Python / obliczeń na macierzach i wektorach w Python / W Python obliczenia na macierzach i wektorach można wykonywać
examples.why: 'Python' is a masculine noun that Polish declines; the file itself gets it right once ('biblioteki wizualizacji dla Pythona', l.319). The undeclined form reads as machine output, not as a Polish technical writer.

examples.source: with the `mpl` renderer (short for Matplotlib) ... This is the only renderer we'll use ... including a text-based and a LaTeX-based renderer
examples.suggested: z rendererem `mpl` ... Jest to jedyny renderer, którego będziemy używać ... renderer tekstowy i oparty na LaTeX-u
examples.translation: z renderowaniem `mpl` (skrót od `Matplotlib`) ... Jest to jedyne renderowanie, którego będziemy używać ... renderowanie tekstowe i oparte na LaTeX
examples.why: 'renderer' is a component (an argument value you pass), not the process; 'renderowanie' names the activity, so 'jedyne renderowanie' misdescribes what `output="mpl"` selects.

examples.source: With more and more samples, the fraction of samples for each possibility is likely to get closer and closer to the corresponding probability.
examples.suggested: Wraz ze wzrostem liczby próbek udział każdej możliwości będzie prawdopodobnie coraz bardziej zbliżał się do odpowiadającego jej prawdopodobieństwa.
examples.translation: Wraz ze wzrostem liczby próbek udział każdej możliwości coraz bardziej zbliża się do odpowiadającego jej prawdopodobieństwa.
examples.why: The English hedge 'is likely to' is dropped, turning a probabilistic statement into a flat assertion — a mild strengthening in a paragraph whose whole point is the law of large numbers as a statistical tendency.

editor_note: The 2020 roadmap row mistranslates the core NISQ term: "the noisy, small-scale quantum computers of the day" becomes "od głośnych, małoskalowych komputerów kwantowych" — "głośny" means acoustically loud; the required term is "zaszumionych". A Polish learner is taught a false concept (noisy hardware = loud machines) precisely where the roadmap narrative depends on understanding quantum noise, so this is misleading, not merely stiff. Beyond that, "superconducting" is split within the file between the calque "superprzewodzących qubitów" (2005 row) and correct "nadprzewodzącego/nadprzewodzących" (2015 caption, 2022 row), and "qubit" is spelled "qubit" everywhere except "kubitach" in the tipping-point bullet. Several passages are audible translationese — "słynnie zakończył swoje przemówienie kluczowe" (calqued "famously" + "keynote speech"), "popularną metodę zabezpieczania prywatnych komunikacji" and "regularnemu komputerowi" in the 1994 row, the garbled BQP gloss "ograniczonym błędem kwantowego czasu wielomianowego", the undeclined "algorytmu Shor" (should be "Shora"), and "capacity" rendered as "przepustowości" (throughput). Informal "ty" register holds correctly throughout ("cię", "Rozważ", "zastanów się").

examples.source: a development roadmap to go from the noisy, small-scale quantum computers of the day to the million-plus qubit quantum computers of the future
examples.suggested: plan rozwoju, opisujący drogę od zaszumionych, małoskalowych komputerów kwantowych tamtych czasów do komputerów kwantowych przyszłości, wyposażonych w ponad milion qubitów
examples.translation: plan rozwoju, opisujący drogę od głośnych, małoskalowych komputerów kwantowych tamtych czasów do komputerów kwantowych przyszłości, wyposażonych w ponad milion qubitów
examples.why: "Głośny" means acoustically loud. The domain sense of "noisy" (quantum noise / NISQ) is "zaszumiony"; as written the learner forms a false belief about what limited early quantum hardware.

examples.source: several types of superconducting qubits … the largest to date using superconducting qubits
examples.suggested: kilka typów nadprzewodzących qubitów … (use "nadprzewodzący" everywhere, matching "nadprzewodzącego komputera kwantowego" in the 2015 caption)
examples.translation: kilka typów superprzewodzących qubitów … największy ówcześnie istniejący procesor oparty na qubitach nadprzewodzących
examples.why: "Superprzewodzący" is a calque; standard Polish physics term is "nadprzewodzący", and the file uses both, so the same hardware class appears under two names.

examples.source: he famously closed his keynote speech with the statement
examples.suggested: zakończył swoje słynne wystąpienie otwierające (keynote) słowami
examples.translation: słynnie zakończył swoje przemówienie kluczowe słowami
examples.why: "Słynnie" is a direct calque of the English sentence adverb "famously", which Polish does not use this way, and "przemówienie kluczowe" is a literal word-for-word rendering of "keynote speech" that no Polish technical writer would produce.

examples.source: a theoretical list of the problems that a quantum computer can easily solve called BQP — bounded-error quantum polynomial time
examples.suggested: zwanej BQP — kwantowy czas wielomianowy z ograniczonym błędem (bounded-error quantum polynomial time)
examples.translation: zwanej BQP — ograniczonym błędem kwantowego czasu wielomianowego (bounded-error quantum polynomial time)
examples.why: The acronym expansion is restructured into "bounded error OF quantum polynomial time"; the head of the phrase is the complexity class (czas wielomianowy), not the error, so the gloss no longer explains the acronym.

examples.source: RSA encryption, a popular means of securing private communications … what might take a regular computer the lifetime of the universe
examples.suggested: szyfrowanie RSA — popularną metodę zabezpieczania prywatnej komunikacji … co zwykłemu komputerowi zajęłoby czas życia wszechświata
examples.translation: szyfrowanie RSA — popularną metodę zabezpieczania prywatnych komunikacji … co regularnemu komputerowi mogłoby zająć czas życia wszechświata
examples.why: "Prywatnych komunikacji" copies the English plural into an unidiomatic Polish plural, and "regularny komputer" is a false friend for "regular" (Polish needs "zwykły").

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, probability, syndrome table and the "p < 1/2" / "p > 1/2" reversals track the English exactly, and the pedagogy (majority decoding, no-cloning caveat, "this code actually increases the phase-flip probability") lands as clearly as the source. The defects are lexical. First, the English glossary term "Circuit" leaks untranslated and capitalized mid-sentence — "pelo seguinte Circuit quântico" (line 80), "usar o seguinte Circuit quântico" (line 106), plus four image alt texts ("Circuit de codificação...", "Circuit simplificado de detecção...") — while the very next sentences correctly use "circuito" ("Este circuito mede de forma não-destrutiva...", "o circuito de detecção de erros anterior"), so the same term is split two ways within one file. Second, "experience" is calqued as "experimentar" three times ("se o qubit do meio experimentar uma inversão de bit", "qual qubit experimentou", "poderiam potencialmente experimentar erros"); in Portuguese "experimentar" means to try/taste — a native writer writes "sofrer uma inversão de bit". Third, scattered translationese a Brazilian technical editor would rewrite: "o efeito líquido" for "net effect" (line 179), "Crucialmente," opening line 122, "qubits de espaço de trabalho" for "workspace qubits" (line 80), and "o código de repetição ordinário de 3 bits" (line 200). The informal-register convention holds throughout (first-person plural "podemos/veremos", no o senhor/vossa).

examples.source: This encoding is easily implemented by the following quantum circuit, which makes use of two initialized workspace qubits and two controlled-NOT gates.
examples.suggested: Essa codificação é facilmente implementada pelo seguinte circuito quântico, que utiliza dois qubits auxiliares inicializados e dois gates CNOT.
examples.translation: Essa codificação é facilmente implementada pelo seguinte Circuit quântico, que faz uso de dois qubits de espaço de trabalho inicializados e dois gates CNOT.
examples.why: "Circuit" is an untranslated, capitalized English glossary leak, and the file itself uses the correct "circuito" elsewhere (line 107 "Este circuito mede...", line 189 "o circuito de detecção de erros anterior") — the same term split two ways within one file. "qubits de espaço de trabalho" is a literal calque of "workspace qubits"; the field says "qubits auxiliares".

examples.source: For instance, if the middle qubit experiences a bit-flip, the state of the three qubits is transformed into this state:
examples.suggested: Por exemplo, se o qubit do meio sofrer uma inversão de bit, o estado dos três qubits é transformado neste estado:
examples.translation: Por exemplo, se o qubit do meio experimentar uma inversão de bit, o estado dos três qubits é transformado neste estado:
examples.why: "experimentar" is a false-friend calque of "to experience" — in Portuguese it means to try out or taste something. The idiomatic verb for undergoing an error is "sofrer". The same calque recurs at line 112 ("qual qubit experimentou uma inversão de bit") and line 158 ("poderiam potencialmente experimentar erros de inversão de fase").

examples.source: ...so the net effect is that the single qubit state α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ is encoded as
examples.suggested: ...de modo que o efeito final é que o estado de um único qubit α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ é codificado como
examples.translation: ...de modo que o efeito líquido é que o estado de qubit único α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ é codificado como
examples.why: "efeito líquido" is a word-for-word rendering of "net effect" that belongs to accounting/finance register in Portuguese; in a physics explanation a native writer says "o efeito final" or "o resultado é que". Same class as "Crucialmente," opening line 122, where Portuguese prefers "O ponto crucial é que...".

examples.source: The behavior is similar to the ordinary 3-bit repetition code for bit-flips.
examples.suggested: O comportamento é semelhante ao do código de repetição de 3 bits comum para inversões de bit.
examples.translation: O comportamento é semelhante ao código de repetição ordinário de 3 bits para inversões de bit.
examples.why: "ordinário" carries a pejorative sense (vulgar, low-quality) in everyday Brazilian Portuguese outside fixed collocations like "equação diferencial ordinária"; "comum" or "padrão" is the neutral word here. The missing "ao do" also leaves the comparison grammatically clipped.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — tensor/expand subsystem indexing, `A.compose(B)` = $B.A$ vs `front=True` = $A.B$, the "combinações lineares não preservam" unitarity caveat, and the CP caveat on process fidelity all survive intact, and the informal "você" register holds. What a native editor would fix: (1) the gender agreement error "um porta" appears twice ("ou um porta que não possui uma definição de matriz", "compor um porta de dois qubits") — "porta" is feminine, so "uma porta"; (2) "gate" is rendered inconsistently in the very same sentence ("um porta … em termos de gates com definições de matriz") and again as "gates de Pauli", so the file never settles on porta vs gate; (3) plain English nouns are capitalized as if they were class names where the EN has lowercase prose — "chamar um Backend simulador", "que é adicionado ao Circuit", "inserido diretamente no próprio Circuit" — while the same word is correctly "circuito quântico" earlier, and (4) "uma quantidade teórica da informação" is a calque of "information-theoretic quantity" (a Portuguese writer would say "uma grandeza da teoria da informação"), alongside the repeated "uma exceção será levantada" calque where PT convention is "lançada".

examples.source: …without having to call a simulator backend. … Unsupported operations are: measure, reset, conditional operations, or a gate that does not have a matrix definition or decomposition in terms of gate with matrix definitions.
examples.suggested: …sem precisar chamar um backend simulador. … ou uma porta que não possui uma definição de matriz ou decomposição em termos de portas com definições de matriz.
examples.translation: …sem precisar chamar um Backend simulador. … As operações não suportadas são: measure, reset, operações condicionais, ou um porta que não possui uma definição de matriz ou decomposição em termos de gates com definições de matriz.
examples.why: Gender error ('um porta' — porta is feminine) plus the same term rendered two ways one clause apart ('porta' then 'gates'); 'Backend' is also needlessly capitalized mid-sentence as if it were a class name.

examples.source: …converts the `Operator` into a `UnitaryGate` object, which is added to the circuit. … the `Pauli` object may also be directly inserted into the circuit itself
examples.suggested: …que é adicionado ao circuito. … pode ser inserido diretamente no próprio circuito
examples.translation: …converte o `Operator` em um objeto `UnitaryGate`, que é adicionado ao Circuit. … o objeto `Pauli` também pode ser inserido diretamente no próprio Circuit
examples.why: The EN 'circuit' here is ordinary prose, not the class name (which is `QuantumCircuit`); leaving a capitalized bare 'Circuit' contradicts 'circuito quântico' used earlier in the same file.

examples.source: This is an information-theoretic quantity for how close two quantum channels are to each other
examples.suggested: Esta é uma grandeza da teoria da informação que mede quão próximos dois canais quânticos estão um do outro
examples.translation: Esta é uma quantidade teórica da informação que mede quão próximos dois canais quânticos estão um do outro
examples.why: 'quantidade teórica da informação' is a word-for-word calque that parses as 'theoretical quantity of information'; a Portuguese physicist writes 'grandeza da teoria da informação' / 'grandeza teórico-informacional'.

examples.source: an exception is raised
examples.suggested: uma exceção será lançada / é lançada uma exceção
examples.translation: uma exceção será levantada / uma exceção é levantada
examples.why: 'levantar uma exceção' is a literal rendering of 'raise'; Portuguese programming convention is 'lançar uma exceção'. Repeated four times, so it sets the file's tone.

editor_note: The "5k challenge" section swaps the unit that gives the section its name: EN "Imagine what is possible with 5,000 quantum gates in a single computation" becomes "cu 5.000 de circuite cuantice într-un singur calcul" — 5,000 *circuits* instead of 5,000 *gates*. That is misleading in a section whose whole point is gate count/depth in one circuit, and it contradicts the file's own correct rendering "porți cuantice" ("100 de milioane de porți cuantice pe 200 de qubiți logici"). Secondary issues, all minor: "Layer Fidelity" is rendered two ways within the file ("Fidelitatea nivelului" in the metric list vs "fidelitate la nivel de strat" in Key takeaways); "quantum computing group" becomes "grupul de calculație cuantică" ("calculație" is accounting/costing arithmetic in Romanian, not computing — everywhere else the file correctly uses "calcul cuantic"); "unbiased observables" is calqued as "observabile nebiasate" (native: "nedeplasate"/"fără biasare"); and the opening paragraph has a dangling gerund with no subject ("Combinând calculatoarele noastre cuantice de clasă mondială cu Qiskit, le permite utilizatorilor..."), where a native writer would use the nominalization "Combinarea ... le permite". Register is correctly informal "tu" throughout (asigură-te, imaginează-ți, verifică-ți, poți proteja) with no dumneavoastră slips, and the NYC tourist analogy is rendered faithfully and readably.

examples.source: Imagine what is possible with 5,000 quantum gates in a single computation.
examples.suggested: Imaginează-ți ce este posibil cu 5.000 de porți cuantice într-un singur calcul.
examples.translation: Imaginează-ți ce este posibil cu 5.000 de circuite cuantice într-un singur calcul.
examples.why: "gates" is rendered as "circuite" (circuits). This swaps the quantity being described: the 5k challenge is about 5,000 gates inside ONE computation, not 5,000 separate circuits. A learner takes away a false picture of the milestone, and it clashes with the same paragraph's talk of circuit depth and with line 144's correct "100 de milioane de porți cuantice".

examples.source: **Layer Fidelity** - Measured by **EPLG (Errors Per Layered Gate)** ... / four key metrics: scale, quality, speed, and layer fidelity.
examples.suggested: Use one rendering in both places, e.g. "fidelitatea stratului" / "fidelitate la nivel de strat".
examples.translation: **Fidelitatea nivelului** ... / patru metrici cheie: scară, calitate, viteză și fidelitate la nivel de strat.
examples.why: The same named metric is given two different Romanian names in the metric list and in the Key takeaways summary, so the learner cannot tell that the fourth bullet in the recap is the same metric introduced earlier.

examples.source: reach out to your institution's quantum computing group
examples.suggested: iei legătura cu grupul de calcul cuantic al instituției tale
examples.translation: iei legătura cu grupul de calculație cuantică al instituției tale
examples.why: "calculație" in Romanian means cost accounting/arithmetic reckoning, not computing; the rest of the file consistently and correctly uses "calcul cuantic". Recognizable in context, but no native technical writer would use it here.

examples.source: Combining our world-class quantum computers with Qiskit enables our users to explore how quantum computing can be useful in the world, today.
examples.suggested: Combinarea calculatoarelor noastre cuantice de clasă mondială cu Qiskit le permite utilizatorilor noștri să exploreze...
examples.translation: Combinând calculatoarele noastre cuantice de clasă mondială cu Qiskit, le permite utilizatorilor noștri să exploreze modul în care calculul cuantic poate fi util în lume, astăzi.
examples.why: Calqued English gerund-as-subject: the Romanian gerund "Combinând" leaves "le permite" without a subject, which is ungrammatical. A native writer nominalizes ("Combinarea ... le permite").

examples.source: a tool capable of calculating unbiased observables of long, high-quality circuits
examples.suggested: ...să calculeze observabile nedeplasate (fără biasare) ale unor circuite lungi...
examples.translation: un instrument capabil să calculeze observabile nebiasate ale unor circuite lungi și de înaltă calitate
examples.why: "nebiasate" is an English calque; the established Romanian statistical term for an unbiased estimator/quantity is "nedeplasat". Understandable, but not the conventional term.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner: meaning tracks the English section by section, the informal "tu" convention holds throughout ("Dă click mai jos", "dacă voiai să experimentezi", "Scopul acestui curs este să îți permită"), and core terms are stable (qubiți, calcul/avantaj/utilitate cuantică, atenuarea erorilor, toleranță la erori, entanglement). The main editorial defect is a glossary-leak style in the terminology: "gate" is left as a capitalized English noun with a Romanian hyphenated article throughout the "Starea tehnologiei" section ("Calitatea Gate-urilor", "fidelitatea Gate-urilor cu 2 qubiți", "Gate-urile care rulează pe qubiți individuali") where standard Romanian is "porțile (cuantice)", and the same happens once for "qubiții și Circuit-urile cuantice" instead of "circuitele cuantice". Layered on that are several grammar/agreement slips ("să stăpânim această nouă tehnologie și să bată calculul clasic", "este prea costisitor și nepractice"), a wrong-sense rendering ("an advancing technology" → "o tehnologie în avans", i.e. "ahead of schedule" rather than "in progress"), visible calques ("Pe cât de bine înțelegem", "O modalitate de a gândi la aceasta", "ipotezat a fi", "a le debloca potențialul"), and a "metric" split between "măsură" (in "doar o măsură de care ne interesăm") and "metrică"/"metrici" two sentences later. One hedge is dropped: "a phase-transition of sorts" becomes the flat "o tranziție de fază".

examples.source: assumes a basic familiarity with qubits and quantum circuits … Gate quality has also dramatically improved … 2-qubit gate fidelity … Gates that run on single qubits
examples.suggested: …cu qubiții și circuitele cuantice … Calitatea porților s-a îmbunătățit dramatic … fidelitatea porților cu 2 qubiți … Porțile care rulează pe qubiți individuali
examples.translation: presupune o familiarizare de bază cu qubiții și Circuit-urile cuantice … Calitatea Gate-urilor s-a îmbunătățit dramatic … fidelitatea Gate-urilor cu 2 qubiți … Gate-urile care rulează pe qubiți individuali
examples.why: 'gate' and 'circuit' are left as capitalized English nouns glued to Romanian hyphenated articles (Gate-urilor, Circuit-urile) — a glossary-protection artifact, not a domain convention. Romanian quantum writing uses 'poartă/porți (cuantice)' and 'circuit(e)'. Recognizable, so not misleading, but no native technical editor would leave it.

examples.source: we cannot realistically expect to master this new technology and beat classical computing right out of the starting gate
examples.suggested: nu ne putem aștepta în mod realist să stăpânim această nouă tehnologie și să batem calculul clasic din prima
examples.translation: nu putem să ne așteptăm în mod realist să stăpânim această nouă tehnologie și să bată calculul clasic de la bun început
examples.why: Subject agreement breaks mid-sentence: 'să stăpânim' (1pl) is coordinated with 'să bată' (3sg), so the second verb loses its subject. The same sentence also stacks 'cerințe extreme asupra controlului nostru asupra sistemelor' — two 'asupra' in a row, which a native writer would rephrase ('cerințe extreme controlului pe care îl avem asupra sistemelor').

examples.source: although they represented publicly accessible stepping stones in an advancing technology
examples.suggested: deși au reprezentat trepte accesibile publicului în cadrul unei tehnologii în plină dezvoltare
examples.translation: deși au reprezentat trepte accesibile publicului în cadrul unei tehnologii în avans
examples.why: 'în avans' in Romanian means 'ahead of time / in advance', not 'advancing/progressing'. The intended sense (a technology that is moving forward) is lost; the reader gets a phrase that does not parse in context.

examples.source: This represents a phase-transition of sorts, into a new era of quantum computing technology
examples.suggested: Aceasta reprezintă un fel de tranziție de fază, într-o nouă eră a tehnologiei de calcul cuantic
examples.translation: Aceasta reprezintă o tranziție de fază, într-o nouă eră a tehnologiei de calcul cuantic
examples.why: The hedge 'of sorts' is dropped, turning a deliberately loose physics analogy into a flat assertion that a literal phase transition occurs. A dropped qualifier rather than an inverted claim, so minor — but the English is careful here for a reason.

examples.source: To the best of our understanding … One way to think about this … the methodologies to unlock their potential … that's just one metric we care about … which is hypothesized to be one of the physics phenomena
examples.suggested: Din câte înțelegem … Un mod de a privi acest lucru … metodologiile care să le valorifice potențialul … este doar una dintre metricile care ne interesează … despre care se presupune că este unul dintre fenomenele fizice
examples.translation: Pe cât de bine înțelegem … O modalitate de a gândi la aceasta … metodologiile pentru a le debloca potențialul … aceasta este doar o măsură de care ne interesăm … care este ipotezat a fi unul dintre fenomenele fizice
examples.why: A cluster of word-for-word calques a Romanian technical writer would not produce: 'a gândi la' instead of 'a privi/a înțelege', 'debloca potențialul' for 'unlock', the non-standard participle 'ipotezat', and the malformed reflexive 'de care ne interesăm'. That last one also splits terminology — 'metric' is 'măsură' here but 'metrici'/'metrică' in the very next sentences.

editor_note: Physics is intact (no inverted conditions, swapped quantities, or hallucinations) and the English-retention convention for qubit/measurement/observable/phase estimation is consistent, but the file reads as competent MT in several spots. The math idiom "up to a phase factor / unique up to the ordering" is rendered three times as "ตาม phase factor" / "unique ตามลำดับของ eigenvalues" — "ตาม" means "according to", not "up to", so the qualifier's sense flips from "the only remaining freedom is X" to "as determined by X"; Thai wants "ต่างกันเพียง…" / "ยกเว้น…". The claim in line 67 is self-contradictorily hedged: EN "is always ±i times…" becomes "มักเป็น … เสมอ" (often … always). Add calques a native technical editor would rewrite — "In words" → "พูดเป็นคำพูด", "projections satisfying" → "projections ที่ตอบสนอง" (respond-to sense), "in the natural way" → "ในทิศทางธรรมชาติ" — plus the ungrammatical "เราเชื่อมโยงกับ $A$ ซึ่ง projective measurement …" and within-file splits (expression/นิพจน์; "โค้ด" for error-correcting code in line 90 vs English "code" in line 246).

examples.source: multiplying two different non-identity Pauli matrices together is always ±i times the remaining non-identity Pauli matrix
examples.suggested: …เข้าด้วยกันจะได้ $\pm i$ คูณกับ Pauli matrix ที่ไม่ใช่ identity ที่เหลือเสมอ
examples.translation: การคูณ Pauli matrices ที่ไม่ใช่ identity สองตัวที่ต่างกันเข้าด้วยกันมักเป็น $\pm i$ คูณกับ Pauli matrix ที่ไม่ใช่ identity ที่เหลือเสมอ
examples.why: 'มัก' (usually/tends to) contradicts the trailing 'เสมอ' and softens an unconditional algebraic identity into a tendency. Drop the hedge.

examples.source: up to a phase factor, Y is equivalent to XZ … Such an expression of a matrix is unique up to the ordering of the eigenvalues.
examples.suggested: $Y$ เทียบเท่ากับ $XZ$ โดยต่างกันเพียง phase factor … การเขียน matrix ในรูปนี้เป็นหนึ่งเดียว ยกเว้นการเรียงลำดับของ eigenvalues
examples.translation: ตาม phase factor $Y$ เทียบเท่ากับ $X Z$ … expression ดังกล่าวของ matrix เป็น unique ตามลำดับของ eigenvalues
examples.why: 'ตาม' = 'according to', which is not the Thai rendering of the mathematical 'up to'; the caveat that the only remaining freedom is the phase / the ordering is lost, and line 158 can be read as saying the ordering is what makes it unique.

examples.source: In words, the possible outcomes are … / projections satisfying … / generalizes … in the natural way
examples.suggested: กล่าวง่าย ๆ คือ … / projections ที่สอดคล้องกับ … / ขยายไปยัง … ได้โดยธรรมชาติ
examples.translation: พูดเป็นคำพูด ผลลัพธ์ที่เป็นไปได้คือ … / projections ที่ตอบสนอง … / ขยายไปยัง … ในทิศทางธรรมชาติ
examples.why: Three word-for-word calques: 'พูดเป็นคำพูด' is not idiomatic Thai, 'ตอบสนอง' is the 'respond to' sense rather than mathematical 'satisfy', and 'ทิศทาง' (direction) mistranslates 'way/manner'.

examples.source: When we refer to A as an observable, we're associating with A a certain uniquely defined projective measurement.
examples.suggested: …เรากำลังเชื่อมโยง projective measurement ที่นิยามได้อย่างเฉพาะเจาะจงเพียงหนึ่งเดียวเข้ากับ $A$
examples.translation: เมื่อเราอ้างถึง $A$ ในฐานะ *observable* เราเชื่อมโยงกับ $A$ ซึ่ง projective measurement ที่กำหนดไว้อย่างชัดเจนหนึ่งตัว
examples.why: The relative pronoun 'ซึ่ง' leaves the clause without an object and the sentence ungrammatical; 'uniquely defined' also flattens to 'อย่างชัดเจน' (clearly defined), losing the uniqueness that the spectral-theorem argument rests on.

examples.source: quantum error correcting codes … 3-bit repetition code / Such an expression … Based on this expression
examples.suggested: รหัสแก้ไขข้อผิดพลาดเชิงควอนตัม (or keep 'code' throughout) / นิพจน์ ทั้งสองที่
examples.translation: โค้ดแก้ไขข้อผิดพลาดเชิงควอนตัม … 3-bit repetition code / expression ดังกล่าว … จากนิพจน์นี้
examples.why: Within-file splits: 'โค้ด' reads as program code for a coding-theory code and is inconsistent with the English 'code' kept elsewhere; 'expression' is left in English one sentence and translated 'นิพจน์' the next.

editor_note: The translation systematically renders "output" as "อินพุต" (input) — at least five times — which teaches a false picture of how circuits work. Line 23 says "และสายทางด้านขวาคืออินพุต" ("the wire on the right-hand side is the input") right after stating that information flows left to right, so the learner is told both wires are inputs and the circuit has no output; line 85 turns "The output value is 1 in this case" into "ค่าอินพุตในกรณีนี้คือ 1"; line 118 collapses "input or output states" into "สถานะอินพุตหรืออินพุต" (input or input); and line 248 renders "outputs a classical bit" / "outputting the qubit in its post-measurement state" both as "ให้…เป็นอินพุต", destroying the whole measurement-as-a-gate intuition. Secondary defects: "any number of qubit wires" becomes "สายควอนตัมจำนวนเท่าใดก็ได้" (quantum wires, losing the qubit/classical-bit-wire contrast the very next clause depends on), "The two small, solid circles" drops the count ("วงกลมเล็กๆ ทึบ"), and the basis pair is split — "ฐานมาตรฐาน" translated but "Bell basis" left in English in the same sentence. Register is correctly casual throughout, with no ครับ/ค่ะ.

examples.source: and the wire on the right-hand side is the output.
examples.suggested: และสายทางด้านขวาคือเอาต์พุต
examples.translation: และสายทางด้านขวาคืออินพุต
examples.why: "output" rendered as "อินพุต" (input). Directly contradicts the left-to-right flow described in the same sentence; the learner is told the Boolean circuit has two input wires on the left and another input on the right, and never learns where the result comes out.

examples.source: The output value is $1$ in this case, which is the correct value for the XOR: $0 \oplus 1 = 1.$
examples.suggested: ค่าเอาต์พุตในกรณีนี้คือ $1$ ซึ่งเป็นค่าที่ถูกต้องสำหรับ XOR: $0 \oplus 1 = 1$
examples.translation: ค่าอินพุตในกรณีนี้คือ $1$ ซึ่งเป็นค่าที่ถูกต้องสำหรับ XOR: $0 \oplus 1 = 1$
examples.why: The worked example is broken: the inputs were just fixed at X=0 and Y=1, so calling 1 the "input value" makes the XOR check incoherent — the learner cannot see that 1 is the computed result.

examples.source: a gate that takes a qubit as input and outputs a classical bit (as opposed to outputting the qubit in its post-measurement state and writing the result to a separate classical bit)
examples.suggested: gate ที่รับ qubit เป็นอินพุตและให้บิตแบบคลาสสิกเป็นเอาต์พุต (แทนที่จะให้เอาต์พุตเป็น qubit ในสถานะหลังการวัด และเขียนผลลัพธ์ลงในบิตแบบคลาสสิกแยกต่างหาก)
examples.translation: gate ที่รับ qubit เป็นอินพุตและให้บิตแบบคลาสสิกเป็นอินพุต (แทนที่จะให้ qubit ในสถานะหลังการวัดเป็นอินพุต และเขียนผลลัพธ์ลงในบิตแบบคลาสสิกแยกต่างหาก)
examples.why: Two more output→input inversions in one sentence. The whole point — the compact notation consumes a qubit and emits a classical bit — is erased; as written the gate takes three inputs and produces nothing.

examples.source: Sometimes we may wish to explicitly indicate the input or output states of circuits.
examples.suggested: บางครั้งเราอาจต้องการระบุสถานะอินพุตหรือเอาต์พุตของ circuit อย่างชัดเจน
examples.translation: บางครั้งเราอาจต้องการระบุสถานะอินพุตหรืออินพุตของ circuit อย่างชัดเจน
examples.why: "input or output states" becomes "input or input states" — a nonsensical pair that also removes the setup for the very next sentence, which shows the resulting output state.

examples.source: quantum circuits can contain any number of qubit wires. We may also include *classical bit* wires
examples.suggested: quantum circuit สามารถมีสาย qubit จำนวนเท่าใดก็ได้ เรายังสามารถรวม *สายบิตแบบคลาสสิก* ด้วย
examples.translation: quantum circuit สามารถมีสายควอนตัมจำนวนเท่าใดก็ได้ เรายังสามารถรวม *สายบิตแบบคลาสสิก* ด้วย
examples.why: "qubit wires" flattened to "สายควอนตัม" (quantum wires), losing the qubit-wire vs classical-bit-wire opposition the sentence is built on; "qubit" is kept in English everywhere else in the file, so this is also inconsistent.

examples.source: it provides us with a way to convert the standard basis to the Bell basis.
examples.suggested: มันให้วิธีแปลงฐานมาตรฐานไปเป็นฐาน Bell
examples.translation: มันให้วิธีแปลงฐานมาตรฐานไปเป็น Bell basis
examples.why: The two bases in one clause are handled inconsistently — "standard basis" translated as ฐานมาตรฐาน, "Bell basis" left as bare English — which obscures that both are bases of the same space.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift found (the negation "ginagamit lamang kapag hindi tinukoy ang `target`", the "hindi hihigit sa 3" bound, the permissive "Pinapayagan din na magbalik ng `None`", and the backward-compatibility caveat all match the English), and the informal register holds with no po/opo. Three editor-level issues remain. (a) The English's single "we/our" is rendered with both the inclusive and exclusive first person, flipping between adjacent sentences: "metadata ng ating Python package" then "na file ng aming package" (repeated in all three plugin sections), plus "Ang aming plugin" against "gumagawa tayo". (b) "qubit" is capitalized in some places ("listahan ng mga Qubit", "3 na Qubit") but lowercase in others ("mga physical na qubit"), and "3 na Qubit" is an awkward construction. (c) "Ang mga sumusunod na keyword argument ay naroroon:" is a word-order calque of "The following keyword arguments are present:" — a native technical writer would open with "Narito ang mga sumusunod na keyword argument:".

examples.source: Now, we expose the plugin by adding an entry point in our Python package metadata. ... We edit the pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, or setup.py file of our package
examples.suggested: ... na file ng ating package
examples.translation: Ngayon, i-expose natin ang plugin sa pamamagitan ng pagdaragdag ng entry point sa metadata ng ating Python package. ... Ie-edit natin ang `pyproject.toml`, `setup.cfg`, o `setup.py` na file ng aming package
examples.why: Inclusive 'ating' and exclusive 'aming' both render the same English 'our' two sentences apart, and the same flip recurs in all three plugin sections plus 'Ang aming plugin' at line 65 against 'gumagawa tayo' at line 61. A native technical writer picks one voice (the inclusive 'natin/ating' fits this walk-through-together tutorial) and holds it.

examples.source: qubits specifies the list of qubits over which the high-level object is defined ... objects of type Clifford that have at most 3 qubits
examples.suggested: ... listahan ng mga qubit ... na may hindi hihigit sa 3 qubit
examples.translation: Ang `qubits` ay tumutukoy sa listahan ng mga Qubit kung saan tinukoy ang high-level na object ... mga object ng uri Clifford na may hindi hihigit sa 3 na Qubit
examples.why: 'Qubit' is capitalized mid-sentence in two places but lowercase at line 346 ('mga physical na qubit') — the same term rendered two ways within the file. The capitalized form also reads like an API class name rather than the physical unit, and '3 na Qubit' is an awkward ligature after a numeral.

examples.source: The following keyword arguments are present:
examples.suggested: Narito ang mga sumusunod na keyword argument:
examples.translation: Ang mga sumusunod na keyword argument ay naroroon:
examples.why: Direct transposition of the English subject-then-'are present' order. Tagalog technical prose fronts the existential ('Narito ang...' / 'Ang mga sumusunod ay ang mga keyword argument:'); 'ay naroroon' for 'are present' reads as translationese in a parameter-list header.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner: every step, link, product name and caveat is preserved (the OVHcloud regional-availability Admonition, the "maliban na kailangan mong i-install ang Qiskit nang manu-mano" exception, the qBraid ENVS/+ADD click path), and the informal register holds throughout ("mo", "iyong", "ka" — no po/opo). Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) Line 46 renders EN "the setup instructions are similar" as "magkapareho ang mga tagubilin sa pag-setup", i.e. "identical" rather than "similar" — a small strengthening of a hedged claim (the exception clause that follows keeps it from misleading). (2) Line 24 has "maaaring magkakaiba ang hitsura ng mga user interface": the modal "maaaring" should take the plain reciprocal "magkaiba", not the distributive-plural "magkakaiba" — a grammar slip a native writer would not make. Also mildly stiff is the passive calque on line 17 ("ay maaaring gamitin kasama ang Qiskit sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa naaangkop na mga tagubilin"), which tracks EN word order rather than a natural Tagalog instruction sentence; not counted as a defect on its own.

examples.source: For platforms without Qiskit preconfigured, the setup instructions are similar, except that you must install Qiskit manually.
examples.suggested: ...halos katulad ang mga tagubilin sa pag-setup, maliban na kailangan mong i-install ang Qiskit nang manu-mano.
examples.translation: Para sa mga platform na walang naka-preconfigure na Qiskit, magkapareho ang mga tagubilin sa pag-setup, maliban na kailangan mong i-install ang Qiskit nang manu-mano.
examples.why: "magkapareho" asserts the instructions are the SAME; the English only says "similar". The trailing exception keeps this from misleading, but the hedge is lost.

examples.source: Additionally, user interfaces might look different in different regions.
examples.suggested: Bukod dito, maaaring magkaiba ang hitsura ng mga user interface sa iba't ibang rehiyon.
examples.translation: Bukod dito, maaaring magkakaiba ang hitsura ng mga user interface sa iba't ibang rehiyon.
examples.why: The modal "maaaring" takes the plain reciprocal "magkaiba"; the distributive-plural "magkakaiba" already carries its own aspect and reads ungrammatical after "maaaring".

examples.source: Additional online Jupyter notebook environments like IBM Watson Studio, Google Colab, and Microsoft Azure Machine Learning Studio can be used to work with Qiskit by following the appropriate instructions.
examples.suggested: Maaari mo ring gamitin ang iba pang online na Jupyter notebook environment tulad ng ... para magtrabaho sa Qiskit — sundin lang ang naaangkop na mga tagubilin.
examples.translation: Ang mga karagdagang online na Jupyter notebook environment tulad ng ... ay maaaring gamitin kasama ang Qiskit sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa naaangkop na mga tagubilin.
examples.why: Calqued English passive plus "sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod"; a Tagalog technical writer would front the actor and use an active instruction. Also "gamitin kasama ang Qiskit" reads as "used together with" rather than "used to work with".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats (CNOT truth table, 75%/50-50 probabilities, depth 4 and depth 5, Little Endian note and the Bell/GHZ derivations all match the English), and informal "ти" holds with no Ви slips. The defects are editorial. (1) A raw English glossary leak: "gate" is left untranslated inside Ukrainian prose in six places — "Підказки: Gate Z можна застосувати так" (l.483), "Ми застосуємо Gate H до кожного кубіта" (l.640), and "Gate CNOT" as the section heading and four times in the body (ll.761, 763, 798, 799, 825) — while the rest of the file correctly and consistently says "вентиль X / вентиль H / вентиль CNOT". (2) "cell" is split between "комірка коду" (9×, e.g. ll.110–111, 141) and "клітинка коду" (5×, ll.913, 927, 1042, 1094). (3) "utility-scale" is rendered "промислового масштабу" in the intro (l.36) but "корисного масштабу" in the summary (l.1139), and in the same sentence "error mitigation" becomes "методи усунення помилок" (= elimination/correction) rather than the mitigation sense ("пом'якшення"/"зменшення впливу помилок"). (4) Grammar/naturalness slips a native writer would not produce: "застосування квантового вентиля до кубіта еволюціонує квантовий стан" (l.349) uses the intransitive "еволюціонувати" transitively (calque of "evolves the quantum state"); "Глибина найдрібнішої квантової схеми" (l.1064) uses "найдрібніший" (finest/smallest) for "shallowest" instead of "найменшої глибини"; and the inclusive-gender parentheticals in the summary (l.1137, 1139) drop the reflexive particle — "ти дізнав(-лась)" and "ти намагав(-лась)" are non-words (should be "дізнався(-лася)", "намагався(-лася)").

examples.source: A CNOT("controlled NOT" or CX) gate is a two-qubit gate … applying a CNOT gate on |00⟩ did not change the state
examples.suggested: Вентиль CNOT («controlled NOT», або CX) — це двокубітний вентиль … застосування вентиля CNOT до $|00\rangle$ не змінило стан
examples.translation: Gate CNOT («controlled NOT» або CX) — це двокубітний вентиль … застосування Gate CNOT до $|00\rangle$ не змінило стан
examples.why: The English word "Gate" is left untranslated inside Ukrainian prose (also l.483 "Gate Z", l.640 "Gate H") while the same term is correctly rendered "вентиль" everywhere else in the file — a glossary leak plus within-file inconsistency.

examples.source: applying a quantum gate to the qubit evolves the quantum state
examples.suggested: застосування квантового вентиля до кубіта спричиняє еволюцію квантового стану
examples.translation: застосування квантового вентиля до кубіта еволюціонує квантовий стан
examples.why: "Еволюціонувати" is intransitive in Ukrainian; using it with a direct object is a literal calque of English "evolves the state" that no native technical writer would produce.

examples.source: essential for utility-scale quantum computing … an important factor for obtaining a utility scale solution … error mitigation methods
examples.suggested: …корисного (utility) масштабу — в обох місцях однаково; "методи пом'якшення помилок (error mitigation)"
examples.translation: важливий параметр для квантових обчислень промислового масштабу … важливий фактор для отримання рішення корисного масштабу … методи усунення помилок
examples.why: "utility-scale" is rendered two different ways in the same file, and "усунення помилок" reads as error elimination/correction rather than mitigation, blurring a distinction the course later relies on.

examples.source: You have learned … you have reviewed … you have tried to reduce the circuit depth
examples.suggested: Ти дізнався(-лася) … ти намагався(-лася) зменшити глибину схеми
examples.translation: Ти вивчив(-ла) … розглянув(-ла) … ти дізнав(-лась) … ти намагав(-лась) зменшити глибину схеми
examples.why: The inclusive-gender parentheticals drop the reflexive particle: "дізнав" and "намагав" are not Ukrainian word forms (the verbs are дізнатися / намагатися).

examples.source: Write code to prepare this state with the shallowest possible circuit. The depth of the shallowest quantum circuit is 5
examples.suggested: Глибина найменш глибокої (найкоротшої за глибиною) квантової схеми дорівнює 5
examples.translation: Напиши код для підготовки цього стану з якомога меншою глибиною схеми. Глибина найдрібнішої квантової схеми дорівнює 5
examples.why: "Найдрібніша" means finest/tiniest, not shallowest; the sentence still states the depth is 5 so it does not mislead, but the adjective is the wrong one for circuit depth.

editor_note: No semantic drift: negations, the V1-vs-V2 primitives contrasts, the shots/precision distinction and all quantities (0.17.1, 1024 bitstrings, `2\pi` = full cycle) are faithful, and the informal tú register holds throughout ("usa", "consulta", "haz clic", "ten en cuenta") with no usted slips. What a native editor would fix is untranslated glossary leakage that splits terms inside the file: "gate" appears as English "Gate"/"gates" in the QuantumCircuit section ("Los siguientes métodos de Gate…", "que agregan los mismos gates") but as "puertas" in the pulse section ("Inyección de operaciones de puertas de circuito") and again as English in "comandos de gate" / "instrucción de gate"; likewise "circuit" is left English ("un único Circuit", "el número de circuits de entrada", "circuits dinámicos", "En el circuit anterior") beside correct "circuito"/"biblioteca de circuitos" — line 342 mixes both in a single sentence. "parser" is also split between "el parser heredado de OpenQASM 2" and "el analizador … la biblioteca de análisis `ply`", and "pase de Transpiler" keeps the English noun capitalized.
