Two calqued constructions remain ("พัฒนาความไม่ต่อเนื่อง" for "develop discontinuities"; "target loss จะถึงจุดนั้นที่ Step 315"), and "to name a few" plus "giving ample time" are silently dropped. Register is correctly casual — no ครับ/ค่ะ anywhere.

examples.source: you can disable it by setting the `initialization` strategy to `"RANDOM"`
examples.suggested: สามารถปิดใช้งานได้โดยตั้งค่ากลยุทธ์ `initialization` เป็น `"RANDOM"`
examples.translation: สามารถปิดใช้งานได้โดยตั้งค่าสตราเทอีจี `initialization` เป็น `"RANDOM"`
examples.why: "สตราเทอีจี" is a malformed transliteration of "strategy" that is not a real Thai word and appears in no Thai technical register; the standard term is กลยุทธ์ (or leaving "strategy" in English, as the file does for solver/backend).

examples.source: due to the infinitesimal effect of transport
examples.suggested: เนื่องจากผลของการถ่ายเท (transport) ที่เล็กน้อยมาก
examples.translation: เนื่องจากผลกระทบของการขนส่งที่เล็กน้อยมาก
examples.why: การขนส่ง is the logistics/shipping sense of "transport". In fluid dynamics the referent is viscous transport phenomena; a Thai engineer reads this paragraph as being about freight, not momentum transport.

examples.source: ## Background
examples.suggested: ## ความเป็นมา (or ภูมิหลัง)
examples.translation: ## พื้นหลัง
examples.why: พื้นหลัง is the visual-backdrop sense (image background). For a document section giving context, Thai technical writing uses ความเป็นมา/ภูมิหลัง — a classic literal-sense calque.

examples.source: solving non-linear multivariate coupled PDEs with classical tools
examples.suggested: การแก้ PDEs แบบไม่เชิงเส้น หลายตัวแปร และเชื่อมโยงกัน (coupled) ด้วยเครื่องมือแบบคลาสสิก
examples.translation: การแก้ PDEs แบบไม่เชิงเส้น หลายตัวแปรและมีการจับคู่กันด้วยเครื่องมือแบบคลาสสิก
examples.why: จับคู่ means pairing/matching two things up; the mathematical sense of "coupled" equations is เชื่อมโยงกัน/ควบคู่กัน. Recognizable in context but the wrong technical sense.

examples.source: the equation becomes a conservation equation that can develop discontinuities (shock waves)
examples.suggested: สมการจะกลายเป็นสมการอนุรักษ์ ซึ่งอาจเกิดความไม่ต่อเนื่อง (คลื่นกระแทก) ขึ้นได้
examples.translation: สมการจะกลายเป็นสมการอนุรักษ์ ที่สามารถพัฒนาความไม่ต่อเนื่อง (คลื่นกระแทก) ได้
examples.why: "พัฒนา" is a direct calque of English "develop"; in Thai it means to develop/improve something deliberately. A native writer says เกิด for a phenomenon that arises.

examples.source: Then, the target loss is reached at Step 315, loss: 0.0014988397.
examples.suggested: จากนั้นจะไปถึง target loss ที่ Step 315, loss: 0.0014988397
examples.translation: จากนั้น target loss จะถึงจุดนั้นที่ Step 315, loss: 0.0014988397
examples.why: "จะถึงจุดนั้นที่" is a garbled rendering of the English passive — the subject and the reached-point are conflated, producing a redundant, non-idiomatic clause.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every number, hedge and caveat survives (10 milyon executions, 26.8 milyong control-system na instruksyon bawat qubit, 30M RZ / 20M SX / limang milyong two-qubit, the "to try to ensure" hedge kept as "Sinisikap ng serbisyong ito na matiyak"), terminology is consistently Taglish in the conventional way (qubit, gate, circuit, shots, backend, Sampler, PUB kept English; "i-transpile", "limitasyon", "instruksyon"), and the informal register holds with no po/opo. Two things a native technical editor would still change: "kung paano isinalin ng sistema ang mga instruksyon ng ISA circuit" uses the completed aspect for an English habitual present — it should be "isinasalin", since the system does this every time validation runs, not once in the past. And "Kinukuha ng talahanayang ito ang heuristic" is a word-for-word calque of "This table captures the heuristic"; "kinukuha" means literally "takes/fetches" and a native writer would use "Ipinapakita" or "Inilalarawan". Neither misleads a learner; both are surface polish.

examples.source: The following table describes how the system translates instruction set architecture (ISA) circuit instructions to control system instructions when calculating this limit.
examples.suggested: ...kung paano isinasalin ng sistema ang mga instruksyon...
examples.translation: Inilalarawan ng sumusunod na talahanayan kung paano isinalin ng sistema ang mga instruksyon ng instruction set architecture (ISA) circuit sa mga control system na instruksyon kapag kinakalkula ang limitasyong ito.
examples.why: "isinalin" is completed/perfective aspect ("translated", already done), but the English is a habitual present describing what the system does on every validation. The rest of the sentence is imperfective ("Inilalarawan", "kinakalkula"), so the aspect clash also reads inconsistent within the same sentence.

examples.source: This table captures the heuristic used in validation and does not reflect the exact number of instructions used to implement an operation.
examples.suggested: Ipinapakita ng talahanayang ito ang heuristic na ginagamit sa pag-validate...
examples.translation: Kinukuha ng talahanayang ito ang heuristic na ginagamit sa pag-validate at hindi ito sumasalamin sa eksaktong bilang ng mga instruksyon na ginagamit para ipatupad ang isang operasyon.
examples.why: "Kinukuha" is a literal calque of "captures" and in Tagalog means physically taking or fetching something — a table cannot "kumuha" of a heuristic. A native technical writer would use "Ipinapakita" or "Inilalarawan" for the sense of "captures" = presents/summarizes. Not misleading, but visibly translationese.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner: the technically load-bearing claims survive intact ("walang paraan ang makakamit ng mas maliit na measurement overhead" for the optimality bound; the noise-drift caveat "maaaring hindi tumpak sa oras na isinasagawa ang pagtatantya" is fully preserved), and domain terms follow a consistent keep-in-English convention (measurement overhead, noise-inversion map, IC-POVM, two-qubit gates, quantum runtime). Still, a native technical editor would change several things: "mitigating the inevitable noise-induced errors" becomes "inaaayos ang mga hindi maiiwasang error" ("fixing"), slightly stronger than mitigation and clashing with the English "error mitigation" used elsewhere in the same file; "measurement" is split between Tagalog "sukat" ("karagdagang sukat", "Ang sukat na ito") and English "measurement" ("measurement overhead", "measurement data"). There are also grammar/typo slips — singular "ni Filippov et al." and "ni E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, ..." where multi-author citations need "nina", a stray capital in "Ang Circuit ay sinusukat", and the malformed "Malaki ang ipinagpapabuti ng TEM sa katumpakan" — plus a small added gloss "(o ma-reproduce)" not in the source. Informal register holds throughout, no po/opo.

examples.source: With TEM, the user can compute the expectation values of observables mitigating the inevitable noise-induced errors that occur on quantum hardware
examples.suggested: ... habang binabawasan (mitigated) ang mga hindi maiiwasang error na dulot ng ingay ...
examples.translation: maaaring kalkulahin ng gumagamit ang mga expected value ng mga observable habang inaaayos ang mga hindi maiiwasang error na dulot ng ingay na nangyayari sa quantum hardware
examples.why: "inaaayos" = repairing/correcting, a stronger claim than mitigating, and inconsistent with the English "error mitigation" / "noise mitigation" kept everywhere else in the same file.

examples.source: informationally complete measurements / measurement overhead / additional measurements / measurement data
examples.suggested: Pick one convention — keep "measurement" in English throughout, or use "sukat/pagsukat" throughout.
examples.translation: informationally complete na sukat / measurement overhead / karagdagang sukat / measurement data
examples.why: Within-file split of the same core term between Tagalog "sukat" and English "measurement"; recognizable but a native technical editor would unify it.

examples.source: as described in Filippov et al. (2023) ... as described in E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, K. Temme
examples.suggested: ayon sa paglalarawan nina Filippov et al. ... nina E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, at K. Temme
examples.translation: ayon sa paglalarawan ni Filippov et al. (2023) ... ayon sa paglalarawan ni E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, K. Temme
examples.why: Tagalog requires the plural personal linker "nina" for multiple authors; "ni" before a four-author list reads as a grammatical slip a native writer would not make.

examples.source: The circuit is measured with an informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (IC-POVM)
examples.suggested: Sinusukat ang circuit gamit ang isang informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (IC-POVM)
examples.translation: Ang Circuit ay sinusukat gamit ang isang informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (IC-POVM)
examples.why: Stray mid-sentence capital "Circuit", plus the "Ang X ay ..." passive calques the English construction; the verb-initial form is what a Tagalog technical writer would use.

examples.source: Accuracy: TEM significantly improves the accuracy and reliability of digital quantum simulations
examples.suggested: Katumpakan: Malaki ang naipapabuti ng TEM sa katumpakan at pagiging maaasahan ng mga digital quantum simulation
examples.translation: Katumpakan: Malaki ang ipinagpapabuti ng TEM sa katumpakan at pagiging maaasahan ng mga digital quantum simulation
examples.why: "ipinagpapabuti" is a malformed/unidiomatic affixation here; the meaning still lands but the verb form is not one a native technical writer would produce.

editor_note: The physics is faithful throughout — the BB84 tables, the no-cloning argument ("теорема про заборону клонування"), the Eve-interference story and all percentages match the English, and the informal "ти" register holds consistently. The main defect is an omission: Discussion question 2 of the English ("Eve is free to send along any state she likes… is there any choice of bases that could reduce the average percentage of qubits that indicate eavesdropping") is missing entirely — the uk file ends at "Підказка 2". Second, English glossary terms leak inconsistently mid-sentence against Ukrainian equivalents used elsewhere in the same file: "кубіт" (lines 160, 181, 236) vs "Будь-який qubit"/"Ті qubits" (line 460) and "кожен qubit" (T/F question 1); "схема"/"квантову схему" vs capitalised "квантовий Circuit" (lines 304–311, 447, 461, 612); plus "вибрати Backend" (line 388). Third, "whereas" in QKD step 2 is rendered as a conditional "Однак, якщо Аліса використовувала вибір базису для підготовки свого стану…", which turns a contrast into an if-clause. Minor grammar slips remain: "візуалізуємо біти, базиси та схема" (should be "схему"), "матимуть відкидати інформацію" (should be "муситимуть відкинути"), "залишено як підказана вправа" for "left as a guided exercise". Also "fidelity" is split between "точність" (line 182) and "вірність" (lines 514, 706, 798).

examples.source: 2. Assume again that all basis choices are random for all participants, Alice, Bob, and Eve. But now, consider that Eve is free to send along any state she likes after her measurement… Discuss with your partners/neighbors whether you think there is any choice of bases that could reduce the average percentage of qubits that indicate eavesdropping to Alice and Bob.
examples.suggested: 2. Знову припустимо, що всі учасники — Аліса, Боб і Єва — обирають базиси випадково. Але тепер розглянь ситуацію, коли Єва вільна надіслати далі будь-який стан на свій розсуд після вимірювання. Вона може навіть спробувати надсилати стани, несумісні з власними вимірюваннями. Обговори з партнерами/сусідами, чи існує, на твою думку, такий вибір базисів, який міг би зменшити середній відсоток кубітів, що вказують Алісі та Бобу на підслуховування.
examples.translation: (absent — the file ends after "Підказка 2: … з різною імовірністю.")
examples.why: The entire second discussion question is dropped, so the Ukrainian learner never gets the exercise that probes whether an adaptive Eve can lower her detection rate — the pedagogical counterpart to the "Assumptions about Eve" caveat earlier in the module.

examples.source: Any qubit with a state that was prepared and measured in the same basis… / the two communicating partners measure each qubit in the same basis
examples.suggested: Будь-який кубіт, стан якого… / вимірюють кожен кубіт в одному і тому самому базисі
examples.translation: Будь-який qubit, стан якого підготовлено та виміряно в одному базисі… / обидва учасники комунікації вимірюють кожен qubit в одному і тому самому базисі
examples.why: The file already uses "кубіт" in the prose (lines 160, 181, 236) and in the final Critical-concepts and MC questions; leaving bare English "qubit"/"qubits" in the post-processing sections and in T/F question 1 splits the core term of the module within one page.

examples.source: Step 1: Map your problem to a quantum circuit / with the circuit as an argument / constructing a whole new quantum circuit
examples.suggested: Крок 1: відобрази задачу на квантову схему / передавши схему як аргумент / ми будуємо цілком нову квантову схему
examples.translation: Крок 1: відобрази задачу на квантовий Circuit / передавши Circuit як аргумент / ми будуємо цілком новий квантовий Circuit
examples.why: Capitalised English "Circuit" is inflected as a Ukrainian noun mid-sentence while line 367 uses "схема" for the same object; the same leak hits "вибрати Backend" (line 388). No native technical writer would mix the two renderings on one page.

examples.source: However, whereas Alice was using the basis choice to prepare her state, Bob will actually make measurements in these bases.
examples.suggested: Однак, тоді як Аліса використовувала вибір базису для підготовки свого стану, Боб натомість робитиме вимірювання в цих базисах.
examples.translation: Однак, якщо Аліса використовувала вибір базису для підготовки свого стану, Боб насправді робитиме вимірювання в цих базисах.
examples.why: "якщо" turns the English contrast into a conditional, so the sentence reads as though Bob's measuring depends on what Alice did rather than contrasting preparation with measurement.

examples.source: Let's visualize the bits, bases, and circuit. / is left as a guided exercise / will have to toss out the information on those qubits
examples.suggested: Давай візуалізуємо біти, базиси та схему. / залишено як керовану вправу (вправу з підказками) / муситимуть відкинути інформацію про ці кубіти
examples.translation: Давай візуалізуємо біти, базиси та схема. / залишено як підказана вправа / матимуть відкидати інформацію про ці кубіти
examples.why: Three grammatical slips a native editor would fix: wrong case on "схема", a non-existent collocation "підказана вправа", and "матимуть відкидати", which is not a valid Ukrainian obligation construction.
